en: A group of 15 mostly Democratic states, along with the District of Columbia, filed a suit on Tuesday saying the effort was illegal.
zh: 一组大多数民主党州的15个州，包括华盛顿特区，周二向法院提出了诉讼，称该努力是非法的。

en: The administration of President Donald Trump has been seeking to roll back a wide array of environmental regulations imposed by former President Barack Obama, as part of a broader agenda Trump says is aimed at sparking economic growth.
zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的行政部门正在试图回滚由前总统巴拉克·奥巴马施行的一系列环境法规，这是作为一个更广泛的议程，特朗普表示该议程旨在刺激经济增长。

en: But the efforts have triggered pushback by Democratics and conservation groups who are concerned about the impact of greater emissions on public health.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但是，人们对减少温室气体排放的努力引发了反弹，民主党人和环保组织担心大气污染对公众健康产生的影响会更加严重。

en: The EPA's website says breathing air containing ozone "can reduce lung function and increase respiratory symptoms" like asthma.
zh: Simplified Chinese：环境保护署的网站说，含有臭氧的空气“可以降低肺功能并增加呼吸症状”如哮喘。

en: Two runners suffered sudden death in the recently ended 2016 Xiamen (Haicang) International Half Marathon.
zh: 两名跑手在最近结束的2016年厦门（海沂）国际半马赛事中突然死亡。

en: According to relevant regulations of the Indian government, establishing retail stores in India would entail procuring 30% of a product’s parts and components in India.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根据印度政府相关法规，在印度设立零售店需要 procurement 30% 的产品的部件和组成部分。

en: Two nights ago, Ali Music’s 2016 Rock & Roll Original Band Final was held at Guangzhou Railway Station. The band, “Every Tuesday Afternoon”, won the first prize with its song “He doesn’t want to live in a dream, but lived forever in a dream”. As with all live shows, they did their best to use their voices, actions and looks to convey their emotions, crying out for “freedom”.
zh: 两 nights ago, Ali Music’s 2016 Rock & Roll Original Band Final was held at Guangzhou Railway Station. The band, “Every Tuesday Afternoon”, won the first prize with its song “He doesn’t want to live in a dream, but lived forever in a dream”. As with all live shows, they did their best to use their voices, actions and looks to convey their emotions, crying out for “freedom”。

en: Five renowned musicians - Peng Juxin, Yan Zhongkun, Li Chi, Zhu Qi, and “outwardly aloof and inwardly passionate singer” Yu Kewei, served as judges that night.
zh: 五位著名音乐家——彭钥新、颜中坤、李智、朱祚和“外表冷漠，内心热情的歌手”于可威，担任了当晚的评审委员会。

en: Before an exclusive interview with a Yangcheng Evening News reporter, Yu Kewei had a sip of alcohol. She felt this would help her loosen her tongue a little. “Super Girl”, “Time Boils the Rain”, Rock Records, EE-Media ...... are the keywords the market has attached to her. She has calmly accepted these terms while trying her best to safeguard her internal purity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在接受阳城晚报专访前，于凯威先喝了一杯酒。她觉得这会让她稍微放松一下。 “超女王”、“雨水煮了雨”，Rock Records，EE-Media ...... 是市场对她的关键词。 她平静地接受这些条件，同时尽力保护自己的内心纯洁。

en: This is also the true state of survival of many singers at this time - they know what the market wants, and they know what they themselves like.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这也是很多歌手在这个时候的生存真实状态——他们知道市场想要什么，而且他们自己也知道。

en: According to Xinhua News Agency, Shenzhou 11 astronauts Jing Haipeng and Chen Dong were interviewed on the 7th by the media at the astronauts’ apartment in Aerospace City, Beijing. Both were in good condition.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根据新华社报道，神州号11号航天员 Jing Haipeng 和 Chen Dong 在北京航空城的宇航员公寓中接受了媒体采访。他们都处于良好的状态。

en: At about 10am on the 16th, an explosion occurred at Shuangma Chemical Plant located in Dongchen Town, Rugao, Jiangsu Province.
zh: 在上午十点左右，江苏省郯官市东陈镇的双马化学厂发生了爆炸。

en: Reporters learned from the Propaganda Department of the Rugao Municipal Party Committee that rescue efforts are in the process of being carried out, and the injured have been successively rescued.
zh: Simplified Chinese：记者从鲁高市党委宣传部了解到，救援工作正在进行中，并且受伤人员一一被救出。

en: The exact number of fatalities and those injured are as yet unclear, and the cause of the explosion is currently under investigation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：爆炸的确切死亡人数和受伤人数尚未明确，目前正在调查爆炸原因。

en: Last night, the Organizing Committee of International Marathon Shenzhen announced the punishment for the two surrogate runners B0575 and B0800. Their results were canceled, and their cases would be further reported to the China Athletic Association for additional punishment.
zh: 昨晚，国际马拉松深圳组织委员会宣布对两名替补跑者B0575和B0800的处罚。他们的成绩被取消，并将进一步向中国体育协会报告，以获得额外的处罚。

en: During heavy training, the runner needs enough nutrition to meet the body's demand for energy.
zh: 在严重训练时，跑步者需要足够的营养来满足身体对能量的需求。

en: In terms of daily diet, the food intake in off-season is sure to be less than that during training, especially that the intake of carbohydrate is controlled while the intake of protein and fiber is increased appropriately.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在日常饮食方面，训练期间的食物摄入量肯定会低于休闲期，尤其是碳水化合物摄入量受到控制，而蛋白质和纤维的摄入量则适当增加。

en: From December 15 to 22, 2016, a brand new production of “Hamlet” by the National Centre for the Performing Arts again triggered the passion of Chinese audience for art classics.
zh: 从2016年12月15日到22日，国家表演艺术中心的新版《哈姆雷特》再次激发了中国观众对艺术经典的热情。

en: Mikey Garcia and Vasyl Lomachenko meet for the first time, discuss a possible showdown
zh: Simplified Chinese：米基·加斯帕尔和瓦西尔·洛马切诺第一次面对面，讨论可能的对战

en: Vasyl Lomachenko and Mikey Garcia, who should be on a collision course to stage the most compelling boxing match under 147 pounds in the near future, met each other for the first time Thursday.
zh: Simplified Chinese：瓦西尔·洛马切诺克和迈基·加斯帕拉，应该会在近期的重量级-boxing比赛中展现出最具吸引力的对战，但他们第一次见面是在周四。

en: They were in separate rooms at ESPN offices in Los Angeles until Garcia, the unbeaten World Boxing Council lightweight champion, walked down the hallway to greet Lomachenko, the World Boxing Organization super-featherweight champion.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们在洛杉矶ESPN办公室的独立房间里待到，直到无败世界轻中量级拳王加尔西亚走进大厅与超重级拳王罗马内科面对面。

en: After Garcia's victory by unanimous decision over former four-division world champion Adrien Broner on Saturday on Showtime, both fighters are members of the top-five pound-for-pound list.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在加斯帕的胜利中，通过一致的决定对前四次世界冠军阿德里安·布罗纳于周六在Showtime上获胜后，两位选手都是五磅级内顶级名单。

en: Garcia extended his right hand and said, "How you doing, champ?
zh: Simplified Chinese：加西亚伸出右手并说：“你好吗，老板？”

en: Best of luck to you."
zh: Simplified Chinese：好运气！

en: Lomachenko defends his belt against Miguel Marriaga on Saturday night at 7 on ESPN.
zh: Simplified Chinese：洛马切诺在下周六晚上7点对阵米格尔·马里亚加，争夺带领者带。

en: As the pair posed for photos, Lomachenko manager Egis Klimas noted that a potential showdown between the fighters would be "perfect sizing."
zh: Simplified Chinese：当这对 boxer posing 拍照时，Lomachenko 的经理埃吉斯·克利马斯（Egis Klimas）注意到，可能的对战将是“完美尺寸”。

en: "I'm a former featherweight," Garcia reminded.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我是前轻中量级的，格拉西 reminded。

en: "I moved up for Broner [at 140 pounds], but I'm not that big.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我在140磅的分级中上升，但我并不是那么大。

en: I'm small for 140.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我身高不足 1.40 米。

en: I want to come down to lightweight.
zh: 我想减轻体重。

en: And he's got to move up to lightweight [135 pounds] and then we have a fight.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他必须在轻中量级（135磅）上升，然后我们就有了战斗。

en: That's what the fans are asking for.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那就是球迷所期望的。

en: Let's give them that."
zh: Simplified Chinese：让他们得到的吧。

en: Lomachenko agreed.
zh: Simplified Chinese：洛马切诺同意。

en: "Boxing needs this fight."
zh: Simplified Chinese：boxing需要这个打斗。

en: Klimas asked if it should be on pay-per-view, part of a strategy he has to have Lomachenko fight a 135-pound debut bout later this year to set up a date next summer with Garcia (37-0, 30 knockouts), who also has interest in fighting the Jorge Linares-Luke Campbell winner following their Sept. 23 lightweight title bout at the Forum.
zh: Simplified Chinese：克利马斯询问是否应该以付费方式观看，作为他打出一场135磅的初战来为后年夏季与加拉西（37-0, 30击中）接下斗争的策略。加拉西也对打赢乔治林阿雷斯-卢克卡Mp贝尔的胜者有兴趣，尤其是在他们于9月23日在ฟอร姆举行的轻量级冠军赛后。

en: "This fight could be on pay-per-view because all the fans have been asking about it," Garcia said, later expressing openness to fighting on whatever network offers the best financial package.
zh: 这场比赛可能会上付费看，因为所有的粉丝都在问这个问题，格拉西亚说后来表示愿意打在哪个网络上能获得最好的经济包装。

en: "We're the main names.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们是主要名字。

en: No other names can generate that kind of attention.
zh: Simplified Chinese：没有其他名字可以产生那样的关注。

en: Whenever they're ready ... ."
zh: Simplified Chinese： whenever他们准备好了…。

en: Garcia said he appreciates Lomachenko as "a tremendous fighter," and may attend his Saturday bout.
zh: 加尔西说他对洛马切诺如“一位巨大的斗士”感到钦佩，可能会参加他的周六比赛。

en: But Lomachenko paused at lavish praise for Garcia, saying he thought the three-division champion from Riverside looked "very slow, sorry Mikey ... you wanted the knockout."
zh: Simplified Chinese：但洛马切诺在赞扬加尔西亚的豪华赞美中停下脚步，他认为三次冠军从里维尔来的冠军看起来“很慢，抱歉，米基你想要打死人”。

en: Garcia said the focus was to show punching strength, then box.
zh: 加拉西说，重点是要展示打击力，然后继续打boxing。

en: They both said they can feel the momentum building for their own bout.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们都说自己可以感受到自己的比赛动力在积累。

en: "This is the fight to be made.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是一个要做的战斗。

en: No other fight creates as much attention and buzz.
zh: Simplified Chinese：没有其他战斗会创造这么多关注和轰动。

en: I'm more than happy to work at it," Garcia said.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我很高兴能在那里工作，”加斯帕（Garcia）说。

en: Said Lomachenko: "I've waited for the top fighters, and this is Mikey.
zh: Simplified Chinese：说的是洛马切诺： “我等待了所有顶级选手，现在是米基。

en: It will be a great fight."
zh: Simplified Chinese：这将是一个伟大的斗争。

en: Promote Environmental Protection yesterday held a large-scale environmental volunteer service thematic event entitled “Green Homeland, Make Xicheng Proud”
zh: Simplified Chinese：昨天举办了“绿家园，赢得西城自豪”的主题活动。

en: Unlike the past traditional methods of picking up trash and handing out promotional material, the organizers have set up six special game experiential zones, including water-efficient toilets, enzyme production experiences, and traffic dominoes.
zh: Simplified Chinese：与以往的传统方法不同，组织者设立了六个特殊游戏体验区，包括水节 toilets、酶生产体验和交通 dominos。

en: At present, many children in China have given up their studies, taking professional golfers as their goals. And they have been so smooth on the professional path and won’tconsider going to colleges.
zh: Simplified Chinese：目前，中国许多儿童已经放弃了学习，选择职业高尔夫球手为目标，并且在专业道路上非常顺利，不会考虑去大学。

en: The position stated by National Development and Reform Commission officials as regards achieving the emission reduction target of the 11th Five-Year Plan ahead of time gives the steel industry, which has been subjected to power supply and production quotas, strong expectations of resumption of production.
zh: 国家发展和改革委员会官员关于实现第十一五年计划排放减少目标的前期完成这一立场，给钢铁行业——长期受到电力供应和产量配额的影响——带来了恢复生产的强烈期望。

en: Although steel plants, as of now, have yet to receive clear notification from local governments announcing that work related to energy conservation and emission reduction has ended, the industry expects that by around December 15, 2010, steel plants nationwide that have been subjected to production quotas will resume production successively. Steel prices could start to come under pressure.
zh: Simplified Chinese：尽管钢厂目前尚未收到任何地方政府的明确通知，关于能量节约和排放减少相关工作已经结束，但行业预计到2010年12月15日左右，受产量限制的钢厂将一并恢复生产。钢材价格可能会开始受到压力。

en: A spokesperson from a private steel enterprise in Hebei told our reporter that notice to end power supply and production quotas has yet to be received at this time, but in reality, pressure on all enterprises have eased significantly when compared to that in September and October.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一家私营钢铁企业在河北的 spokesperson 表示，到目前为止尚未收到停电和生产配额通知，但实际上，所有企业面临的压力已经大幅减轻，远比9月、10月时的压力要小。

en: Some local governments in Hebei Province have repeatedly issued documents related to power supply and production quotas, and have adopted mandatory power shutdown measures to limit production.
zh: Simplified Chinese：河北省的某些地方政府反复发布有关电力供应和生产配额的文件，并采取了强制性电力停机措施来限制生产。

en: The reporter learned from local enterprises that the steel plants of most regions in Hebei have resumed production at this time, and pressure from production quotas have eased.
zh: Simplified Chinese：记者从当地企业了解到，河北大部分地区的钢铁厂已经在此时恢复生产，生产量目标的压力也相对减轻。

en: Mysteel.com analyst Zhang Tieshan estimated that end-user demand for construction steel will gradually weaken as winter has already arrived in Northern China.
zh: 北方中国的冬天已经来临，建筑钢材的终端用户需求会逐渐减弱。

en: Coupled with the energy conservation and emission reduction program winds down, most steel plants will generally resume production by around December 15. Products will gradually make their way to markets across the country before New Year’s Day.
zh: 与能量节约和排放减少计划一同结束后，大多数钢铁厂将大约在12月15日恢复生产。产品会逐渐向全国各地市场输送，直到新年之日。

en: The increase in the supply of resources will exert some pressure on soaring steel prices.
zh: Simplified Chinese：资源供应量的增加会对钢铁价格的上涨施加一定的压力。

en: On December 20, relevant personnel from ZTE Smart Auto told Bloomberg (www.thepaper.cn) reporters that ZTE has acquired a 70% equity stake in Granton Automobile, and will set up ZTE’s smart auto group on this foundation. “We are not at liberty to disclose the monetary sum, but it amounted to several hundred million. We are in the process of recruiting talent. In the future, smart autos will be a very important business for ZTE.
zh: Simplified Chinese：20日，ZTE Smart Auto相关人员向 Bloomberg (www.thepaper.cn)记者透露，ZTE已经获得了格兰顿汽车70%的股权，将在此基础上建立ZTE智能车组。 “我们不能披露任何金额，但几百万美元左右。我们正在招募人才。在未来，智能汽车将成为ZTE的一个非常重要的业务。

en: According to foreign media reports, renowned Hollywood director Garry Marshall passed away on July 19 local time of complications from pneumonia at a hospital in Burbank, California. He was 81 years old.
zh: 据外国媒体报道，著名的好莱坞导演加里·马歇尔（Garry Marshall）于7月19日因肺炎并发症在加利福尼亚州布兰肯市的一家医院去世。他81岁。

en: His publicist Michelle Bega confirmed this news to a “USA Today” reporter.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他的公关人士米歇尔·贝加（Michelle Bega）确认了这一消息给了一位“USA Today”记者。

en: In the history of Chinese badminton team playing in the finals, no one has ever won the champions of two pair games at the same time.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国羽球队在决赛中从未有过两对冠军的双料夺冠。

en: The 68th Primetime Emmy Awards ceremony was held in Los Angeles, USA, yesterday (night of September 18th, local time).
zh: Simplified Chinese：第68届黄金时段艾美奖颁奖典礼在美国洛杉矶举行，昨晚（本地时间9月18日）举行。

en: Competition for “Best Actor” and “Best Actress” in a dramatic role was intense this year. Finally, two newcomers beat seasoned actors: the Best Actor Award went to the male lead of “Mr. Robot”, Rami Malek, who was nominated for the first time, while Tatiana Maslany of “Orphan Black” won the Best Actress Award.
zh: 今年在剧情片的最佳男演员和最佳女演员奖项竞争非常激烈。最后，两个新人击败了经验丰富的演员：最佳男演员奖得主是“Mr. Robot”中的男性主角拉米·马勒克（Rami Malek），他第一次被提名，而塔蒂亚娜·马斯兰尼（Tatiana Maslany）从“孤儿黑色星期五”中赢得了最佳女演员奖。

en: “Game of Thrones” and “American Crime Story” were the biggest winners of this Annual Emmy Awards.
zh: “游戏之王”和“美国罪案故事”是本年度艾美奖的最大赢家。

en: “American Crime Story” won the major awards for the limited series, movie or dramatic special category, while “Game of Thrones” won 12 major awards (including the technical category); in particular, it won three major awards, namely, Best Drama Series, Best Directing for a Drama Series, and Best Writing for a Drama Series.
zh: 美国犯罪故事系列节目、电影或戏剧类别的主要奖项，赢得了“游戏 Thrones”赢得了12个主要奖项（包括技术类别），特别是赢得了3个主要奖项，分别是最佳戏剧系列，最佳戏剧系列导演，最佳戏剧系列编剧。

en: To date, “Game of Thrones” has already received 38 Emmy Awards, becoming the TV series that has won the most Emmy Awards in history.
zh: 到目前为止，“_game of thrones_”已经获得了38个艾米奖，成为历史上赢得的艾米奖最多的电视剧。

en: Regrettably, none of the actors in “Game of Thrones” won an award.
zh: Simplified Chinese：很可惜，所有在《战火之歌》中的演员都没有获得奖项。

en: A few years ago, people who were allowed to set foot in the venture capital sector were limited to those who had founded companies and subsequently joined venture capital companies, or analysts who worked in venture capital companies who hoped to further their careers.
zh: 几年前，进入风险投资领域的人员主要是那些已经创立公司后加入风险投资公司的企业家或在风险投资公司工作的分析师。

en: Entrepreneurs would be able to more easily raise funds from the numerous investors on the AngelList, and would therefore not have to rely on on agents to put them in contact with top venture capital companies.
zh: 企业家们可以更容易地从多名投资者那里筹集资金，于是就不需要中间人将他们联系到顶级风险投资公司。

en: CRI Online (Liu Pai): The Economic & Commercial Section of the Embassy of the Republic of Italy in China held a Sino-Italian Cooperation Program for Environmental Protection on the 18th. Participants from corporations and scientific research institutions of the two countries had an extensive exchange of views in respect of cooperation between the two countries as regards renewable resources under a new state of affairs, and reached a consensus.
zh: 中国意大利共和国大使馆经济商务处于18日举行了关于环境保护的 sino-italian合作计划。来自两国企业和科学研究机构的参与者在讨论两国之间合作发展可再生资源方面取得了一致意见。

en: It is understood that the participating Chinese representatives mainly comprised those from China Recycling Development Corporation Ltd and International Technology Transfer Network, while the Italian representatives included those from the Global Energy Environmental Exchange Organization, federation of businesses of the greater Bologna region, and other entities.
zh: Simplified Chinese：了解到参与者主要是来自中国循环开发公司有限责任公司和国际技术转移网络，而意大利代表则包括来自全球能源环境交换组织、博洛尼亚大区企业联合会以及其他机构。

en: The Italian representatives said that Italy has a myriad of environmental protection technologies and solutions in the renewable resources sector, and proposed to carry out pilot programs with the Chinese in three areas, namely, industrial waste treatment, waste oil treatment, and waste incineration and disposal. It also looked forward to promoting its environmental protection partnership experience with China in other regions around the world.
zh: 意大利代表表示，意大利在可再生资源部门拥有多种环境保护技术和解决方案，并提出了与中国合作进行三项领域的试验计划，即工业废物处理、废油处理以及废燃处理和处置。它也期待与中国在世界其他地区推广其环境保护伙伴关系经验。

en: New results of Sweden's asylum age assessment tests released
zh: Simplified Chinese：瑞典移民庇护年龄评估的新结果已经发布

en: The latest results of tests on asylum seekers in Sweden subjected to a new method of medically assessing their age show that over 80 percent tested were judged to be older than 18, but not everyone has faith in their accuracy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：瑞典对庇护 seeker 的新测试方法的最新结果显示，大约有 80% 的人被判定年龄大于 18 岁，但并不是所有人都信任这些结果。

en: Sweden's national Forensic Medicine Agency (Rättsmedicinalverket) started carrying out the tests earlier year.
zh: 瑞典的国家法医学机构（Rättsmedicinalverket）早些时候开始进行这些测试。

en: They are designed to make age assessment during the asylum process more accurate after the Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket) was criticized for failings in assessing the correct age of some refugees claiming to be underage.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们的设计是为了在庇护程序中提高年龄评估的准确性，瑞典移民局（Migrationsverket）因对某些Seeking庇护的未成年人年龄的正确评估存在问题而受到批评。

en: To date Migrationsverket has sent 6,880 cases to be tested, and the Forensic Medicine Agency has now released the results of a total of 2,481 tests from the period between mid March until July 31st, 2017.
zh: 截至目前，移民局已发送了6,880份样本进行检测，而法医机构已经发布了从3月中旬到2017年7月31日的总计2,481次测试结果。

en: Eighty percent (2002) were judged to be 18 or over, while in a further 25 cases the Forensic Medicine Agency judged that the subject was "possibly 18 or over."
zh: Simplified Chinese：80%（2002）被判定为18岁或以上，而在进一步25起案件中，法医机构判断该人“可能18岁或以上”。

en: In 432 cases the conclusion was that the person is "possibly under 18."
zh: Simplified Chinese：在432起案例中，结论是该人可能小于18岁。

en: The tests are only carried out in cases where the person's age is in question.
zh: Simplified Chinese：只有当一个人年龄不确定时，才进行测试。

en: According to Johan Göransson from the Forensic Medicine Agency, the results are consistent with previous months.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根据前科医学院的Johan Göransson，结果与过去几个月的一致。

en: "We see no big difference in the statistics from previous months, the numbers are quite consistent," he told The Local.
zh: 我们观察到过去几个月的统计数据中没有太大的差异，数字非常一致。

en: The high proportion of cases judged to be over 18 does not necessarily mean that the asylum seeker lied about their age.
zh: Simplified Chinese：18岁以上的案件占比高并不一定意味着移民者在年龄方面虚假申报。

en: In May, the agency released the results of 581 tests and said that there were 442 instances that "suggest the person examined is 18 years or older."
zh: Simplified Chinese：5月，该机构发布了581次测试的结果，并表示有442次“表明被检查的人大约18岁或以上”。

en: When newspaper Svenska Dagbladet investigated the 581 results released however it found that in 243 of the cases the person had openly stated that they turn 18 this year.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当报纸斯韦德斯卡日报(Svenska Dagbladet)调查了581个结果时，然而发现有243起案件中，该人公开表示他们将于今年18岁。

en: The method of medical age assessment, which consists of taking X-rays of wisdom teeth and MRI scans of knee joints, then having dentists and radiologists analyse them, has also been criticised in some quarters.
zh: Simplified Chinese：医疗年龄评估的方法，包括取智齿X光片和膝关节MRI扫描，然后让牙医和放射学家分析它们，也受到了一些方面的批评。

en: One sceptic is Karolinska Institute endocrinologist Claude Marcus, whose work includes assessing the biological maturity of people to see if they went through puberty earlier or later than usual.
zh: Simplified Chinese：有一位怀疑者是卡罗尔斯卡研究所内分泌学家克劳德·马库斯，他的工作包括评估人们是否早或晚经历了青春期。

en: "I've had reason to think about this, and I don't think the type of measurement being used should be.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我有理由认为这种测量方法不应该是这样的。

en: Judging biological age in this way is very uncertain.
zh: Simplified Chinese：判断生物年龄的这种方法很不确定。

en: If we can't say it for sure we shouldn't pretend that we can," he told newspaper Metro.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果我们不能肯定地说，那么就不应该假装自己可以说。

en: The Forensic Medicine Agency's Göransson defended the accuracy of the tests however: "In general you can say that the risk of inaccurately judging a child to be an adult is small.
zh: Simplified Chinese：法医机构的戈尔松森（Göransson）表示，测试的准确性是正确的：“一般来说，你可以说，错误地将孩子判定为成年人的风险很小。

en: The biggest risk is if the person is just under 18, in which case it's around 10 percent."
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果一个人年龄在18岁以下，那么风险就接近10%。

en: West Virginia governor announces he's switching parties
zh: Simplified Chinese：西弗吉尼亚州总督宣布他要改变党派

en: The Democratic governor of West Virginia, Jim Justice, announced Thursday night at a rally with President Trump that he's switching parties.
zh: Simplified Chinese：西弗吉尼亚民主党州长吉姆·正义在周四晚上与总统特朗普一起举行的集会上宣布他要更换党派。

en: "Like it or not like it, the Democrats walked away from me," Gov. Justice said.
zh: Simplified Chinese：像它或不像它，民主党人走了。

en: "Today I will tell you with lots of prayers and lots of thinking ... today I will tell you as West Virginians, I can't help you anymore being a Democratic governor."
zh: Simplified Chinese：今天我会告诉你，祈祷很多、思考很多……今天我会告诉你，我是西弗吉尼亚州的，我再也不能帮助你了，因为我是民主党州长。

en: The rally erupted in cheers.
zh: Simplified Chinese：集会爆发了欢呼声。

en: "So tomorrow, I will be changing my registration to Republican," Justice added.
zh: Simplified Chinese：所以明天，我会将我的注册转为共和党。

en: "As a coach, I would tell you it's time to run another play."
zh: 作为教练，我会告诉你，是时候再次执行一场策略。

en: Mr. Trump promised earlier a big announcement at the West Virginia rally.
zh: Simplified Chinese：特朗普先生早前 promise 大型宣布将在西弗吉尼亚集会上进行。

en: Mr. Trump won West Virginia by 42 points, and Justice did not endorse the Democratic nominee, Hillary Clinton.
zh: 特朗普先生在西弗吉尼亚州赢得了42分之差，正义党不支持民主候选人希拉里·克林顿。

en: Justice, who is the only billionaire in the state, according to Forbes, was elected in 2016.
zh: 根据福布斯的说法，仅在该州有亿万富之家的人物——正义是唯一一位亿万富之家的，于2016年当选。

en: Forbes notes that he owns coal mines in five states, having inherited a coal business from his father.
zh: Simplified Chinese： Forbes 表示他在五个州拥有煤矿，继承了父亲的煤炭业务。

en: He's worth about $1.59 billion.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他价值约15亿美元。

en: Meanwhile, the Republican National Committee released a statement Thursday night saying "Governor Justice's party switch is another blow to a Democratic Party that would rather obstruct than work to make our country great again."
zh: Simplified Chinese：此时，共和党全国委员会在周四晚上发布了一份声明说：“州长正义的党-switch 是另一个对民主党而言阻碍而不是努力使我们的国家再次伟大”的一击。

en: "With only 15 governorships and control of the fewest state legislatures in history, Governor Justice's announcement is just the latest rejection of a party that is leaderless from top to bottom and unable to find a positive, unifying message," RNC chairwoman Ronna McDaniel said in a statement to CBS News.
zh: 只有15个州政府和最少的州立议会，州长正义的宣布只是一个leaderless的党从头到尾都无法找到积极的统一的信息的最新拒绝，RNC主席罗娜·麦克丹尼尔在对CBS新闻的一份声明中说。

en: Fang Wenshan said frankly that using music to tell an entire story is his dream.
zh: 方文山说，使用音乐来讲述整个故事是他的梦想。

en: A song lasts between four and five minutes, so telling an entire story would be very difficult.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一首歌曲持续时间在四到五分钟之间，所以讲一个完整的故事会很困难。

en: When I write songs, I am assailed by emotion. There is no story line. I’ve always felt that that was a real pity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当我写歌时，我会被情绪所冲击。没有故事线。我一直觉得这很可惜。

en: Coe praises 'candid' Russian apology for doping scandal
zh: Simplified Chinese：科尔赞扬了“坦率”的俄罗斯道歉信

en: Global athletics boss Sebastian Coe praised what he described as a candid apology from Russia over a doping scandal on Thursday but reiterated it was not the moment for the country to be readmitted to the sport.
zh: 俄罗斯在 doping 事件上做出了真诚的道歉，但这并不意味着该国可以马上重新加入运动。

en: Russia's athletics boss Dmitry Shylakhtin told an IAAF Congress, held on the eve of the World Athletics Championships, that his country's ban from the sport was correct and that he was determined to fight doping.
zh: 俄罗斯体育总裁施拉赫丁（Dmitry Shylakhtin）在世界 athletics锦标赛前夜的IAAF大会上表示，俄罗斯从该运动中被禁止是正确的，他坚决要抵制 doping。

en: He said he was sorry to "all athletes who have had gold and silver medals snatched from them at competitions."
zh: 他说对所有参加竞赛中被夺走金牌和银牌的所有运动员，他感到抱歉。

en: Despite his comments, the IAAF Congress voted in favor of maintaining the ban, imposed in November 2015 after a World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) report found evidence of state-sponsored doping in Russia.
zh: Simplified Chinese：尽管他对此的评论，但2015年11月制定的世界反 dope机构（WADA）报告发现俄罗斯国家赞助了 doping，IAAF国会投票支持维持禁令。

en: "I thought it was a very candid response today, a very candid presentation," IAAF president Coe told reporters.
zh: 我认为今天的回答非常真诚，非常真实，IAAF总裁科尔对记者说。

en: "The whole Council and the whole Congress was pleased ... that the Russian federation recognized themselves that they have been through some pretty torrid times and are doing everything possible to make sure the federation is reengineered."
zh: Simplified Chinese：整个委员会和整个国会都很高兴……因为俄罗斯联邦承认自己已经经历了相当艰难的时期，并且正在尽可能地确保该联盟得到重新设计。

en: Coe said he was also "pleased" that Russia accepted the criteria for its reintroduction.
zh: Simplified Chinese：科尔说他也“很高兴”俄罗斯接受了其重新引入的标准。

en: "I think it was a very constructive day and I think progress is being made, but the Congress supports the recommendations of the task force that this was not the moment to reinstate Russia," said Coe.
zh: 我认为今天是一个非常积极的日子，我认为进展正在被做出，但国会支持任务组的建议，这不是重新引入俄罗斯的时机。

en: "We need to do everything over the next few months to normalize this situation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们需要在下几个月内做好 normalization 的准备。

en: The guiding principle has always been that we wanted to separate the clean athletes from the tainted system," he added
zh: Simplified Chinese：指导原则一直是我们想要分开清洁运动员和被污染的系统，

en: Nineteen Russian athletes will be competing as neutrals at the World Athletics Championships which start in London on Friday, having met strict IAAF criteria.
zh: Simplified Chinese：19名俄罗斯运动员将在世界田径锦标赛上以中立身份参加比赛，这项比赛将于周五在伦敦开始，符合严格的IAAF标准。

en: The head of the IAAF's Task Force, Rune Andersen, said on Monday that Russia had yet to meet several of the criteria for reinstatement.
zh: Simplified Chinese：IAAF任务小组的负责人，鲁内·安德森（Rune Andersen），在周一表示，俄罗斯还没有满足恢复资格的几个标准。

en: Drug-testing was still insufficient and banned coaches were still operating freely, he told reporters in London after a presentation to the IAAF Council.
zh: 药物检测仍然不足，禁止教练仍在自由运作，他在伦敦向记者解释了这一点后向IAAF理事会的会议结束。

en: At the promotional event for the first anniversary of the implementation of the “Regulations of Beijing Municipality on Smoking Control” held this morning, young student representatives of the video clip, “My Smoking Control Declaration”, which won the national youth smoking control video clip award, interacted with national smoking control ambassador Huang Xuan, and reviewed the video of the activities concerned with calling for entries for the contest, as well as the screening of the excellent award winning works.
zh: 在“北京市烟草控制规定”实施一周年纪念活动上举办的早晨，参与视频片段“我的烟草控制宣言”，获得全国青少年烟草控制视频片奖的学生代表，与国家烟草控制大使黄轩交谈，并观看有关活动的视频，了解征集参赛作品和评选优秀作品的流程。

en: Reporters from The Mirror learned from the event that young actor Huang Xuan was engaged to become the national smoking control ambassador.
zh: 记者们从事件中了解到，年轻的演员黄轩被任命为国家戒烟控制大使。

en: Huang Xuan said he used to smoke when he was in university. After having fully understood the dangers of smoke, he stopped smoking successfully. This time, he proactively assumed the duty of a quit-smoking ambassador, calling on youths to stay away from tobacco.
zh: 黄 Xuân表示他在大学时曾经吸烟。了解了烟雾的危害后，他成功戒烟。这个时候，他积极承担了戒烟大使的职责，呼吁年轻人远离烟草。

en: Audiences put on masks, and exist like a spirit in the story. This is most critical rule of the game in “Sleep No More”.
zh: Simplified Chinese：观众戴上面具，仿佛存在于故事中的一种灵魂。这个“睡无眠”的游戏的关键规则 precisely 是这一点。

en: The RMB middle price is registered at 6.4401, a depreciation of 66 basis points. The rising slows down.
zh: 人民币中位价格为6.4401，下跌66个基点。上涨速度减慢。

en: Macroeconomics Tencent Finance 2018-01-18 09:50
zh: 宏观经济学 Tencent 财富 2018-01-18 09:50

en: Tencent Financial News on January 18, the USD-to-RMB middle prices is registered at 6.4401, a depreciation of 66 basis points compared with the last trading day, ending the rise spanning five consecutive days.
zh: 天河finance新闻于2023年1月18日，美元兑人民币中间价格为6.4401元，较上一交易日下跌66个基点，结束了五连日上涨。

en: In the overnight market, the US dollar experienced a V-shaped rebounded, ending at 90.8900 as of 07:30, Beijing time.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在夜间市场，美国元经历了V形反弹，截止到07:30，北京时间，价格结束于90.8900。

en: The Beige Book published by Federal Reserve shows that almost all 12 Fed regions reported mild to moderate growth in economic activity in early 2018. The Federal Reserve remains optimistic about the outlook for this year.
zh: 美国联邦储备的白皮书显示，几乎所有12个联邦储备地区在2018年初都报告了轻微到中等程度的经济活动增长。联邦储备仍然对本年展望保持乐观。

en: Meanwhile, the U.S. unemployment rate remained at 4.1% in December, the lowest since 2000, and companies are expected to increase wages in the coming months.
zh: Simplfied Chinese： meantime，美国的失业率仍保持在4.1%，自2000年以来的最低水平，而公司预计将在接下来的几个月内增加薪水。

en: Fed officials generally believe that tax reform is a factor supporting this modest strengthening of the economic outlook. The Fed predicts that the economy will increase by 2.5% in 2018 and the interest rate will be raised three times.
zh: 财政部官员普遍认为，税收改革是支持经济预测这一微小改善的因素。联邦预计，2018年经济增长率将达到2.5%，并且利率将三次上调。

en: Some market observers have point out that the expected tightening of ECB’s monetary policy pushes up the exchange rate of the Euro in recent days. As a result, the US dollar index declines continuously, and the RMB exchange rate against the US dollar has seen a surge in prices. However, the European Central Bank is unlikely to adjust the policy stance soon. After the short-term fluctuation of the foreign exchange market, the exchange rates will eventually return to a level dictated by the fundamentals, and the continued smooth operation of the RMB exchange rate is a high probability event.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一些市场观察家指出，欧洲中央银行的货币政策紧缩预计会在近期推高欧元汇率。因此，美元指数连续下跌，而人民币汇率与美元相对价格上涨。但是，欧洲中央银行很不可能在短期内调整政策立场。外汇市场短期波动后，汇率 eventually会回到由基本面决定的水平，并且人民币汇率继续平稳运转的事件具有高概率。

en: It is worth noting that, as the market expects a more stable renminbi, the attractiveness of renminbi assets to foreign investors will also gradually increase.
zh: Simplified Chinese：值得注意的是，市场预期稳定的人民币会使外国投资者对人民币资产的吸引力也会逐渐增加。

en: At 7.50 am today (March 10), a chemical plant in Xinxiang County, Henan Province, exploded, with black smoke billowing at the scene.
zh: 今天（3月10日）早上7点半，河南新县的化工厂爆炸，现场黑烟滚滚。

en: The Beijing News reporter learned from the Xinxiang County Party Committee Propaganda Department that one person was injured in the explosion.
zh: Simplified Chinese：北京新闻记者从新乡县党委宣传部了解到，爆炸中一名人被伤。

en: The videos released by local netizens showed that thick smoke was billowing at the scene of the explosion, accompanied by noise.
zh: 视频中显示，爆炸现场周围有大量烟雾冒出，伴随着噪音。

en: Some netizens claimed that the explosion occurred this morning, and that it occurred at a chemical plant in Xiaoji Town, Xinxiang County, Henan Province.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一些网民声称爆炸发生在今天早上，爆炸发生在新乡县西峡镇化学厂。

en: The Beijing News reporter learned that the chemical plant which exploded was Henan Xinxiang Liutong Industrial Co., Ltd.
zh: 北京新闻记者了解到爆炸的化学厂是河南新乡利通工业公司有限责任公司。

en: Public information revealed that the aforesaid enterprise was incorporated in Feburayr 2002, and its scope of business included the manufacture of chemicals.
zh: Simplified Chinese：公开信息显示，该企业于2002年2月成立，其业务范围包括化学品的制造。

en: This afternoon, Xinxiang County Party Committee Propaganda Department responded to the incident. The explosion occurred at 7.50am. The fire is now effectively under control. One person was slightly injured. The cause of the explosion is still under investigation.
zh: 今天下午，新乡县党委宣传部对事故做出了回应。爆炸发生在上午 7:50。火灾现在已经大致控制住了。有一人轻微受伤。爆炸原因仍在调查中。

en: A Beijing News reporter noticed that in 2015, the chemical plant in question was exposed by the media including Henan TV Station for contamination in violation of the law.
zh: Simplified Chinese：北京新闻记者注意到，2015年，该化学厂被媒体包括河南电视台等媒体曝光，因为违反法律的污染问题。

en: That day, 85-year-old Yoji Yamada, the original director of “What a Wonderful Family!” flew to Beijing to visit the set personally.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那天，85岁的山田洋二生为《美好的家庭》原导演，亲自飞往北京视察电影拍摄地。

en: News published by the CSRC on February 10, 2017 stated that the IPO applications of 12 enterprises were approved according to statutory procedures. The aforementioned enterprises and their respective underwriters were requested to confirm the timing of the issuance with the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges separately, as well as to publish their listing prospectuses.
zh: 中国证监会于2017年2月10日发布的新闻称，12家企业的IPO申请已经按照法律程序获得批准。 aforementioned企业及其分配人士被要求与上海和深交所分别确认发行时间，并且要发布其上市 prospectus。

en: Beijing Business Today reporters found Guangzhou Shangpin Home Collection Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Shangpin Home Collection), which was targeted for a listing on the Small and Medium Enterprise Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, to be among the 12.
zh: 北京商业today记者发现广州尚品-home收藏有限责任公司（以下简称尚品home收藏），即将在深圳证券交易所小中型企业板块上市，是其中的第12家。

en: According to the latest published prospectus of Shangpin Home Collection, the company, incorporated in 2004, is registered in Guangzhou, and is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of personalized and customized panel furniture for an entire home. It also provides design software, designs and research and development of a full range of informatization solutions, as well as technical services to enterprises in the home furnishing industry.
zh: 根据尚品-home collection最新发布的 prospectus ，该公司，成立于 2004年，是在广州注册的主要业务是制造和销售个人化和定制板面家具，为整个家庭提供。它还提供设计软件、设计和信息技术解决方案的研发，以及对家具行业企业提供技术服务。

en: On December 26, reporters learned from the municipal environmental protection bureau that Lu’an City successfully declared a total of 98 national and provincial environmental protection projects of various categories, and received special environmental protection funds worth a total of RMB145.26 million.
zh: Simplified Chinese：2021年12月26日，市级环境保护局通报，鲁安市成功宣布了总计98项国家和省级环境保护项目，获得专项环境保护资金总计14.526亿元。

en: In particular, 55 were national-level environmental protection projects, for which special national environmental protection funds of RMB132.46 million were received; 43 were provincial-level environmental protection projects for which special provincial environmental funds of RMB12.8 million were received.
zh: 特别是，55项是国家级环境保护项目，获得了人民币1324.6万的国家级环境保护基金；43项是省级环境保护项目，获得了人民币1280万的省级环境保护基金。

en: It is understood that the projects built involved many areas including comprehensive treatment of regional water environment (including protecting the ecological environment of Wabu Lake), environmental protection of drinking water sources, comprehensive remediation of rural environment, prevention and control of pollution at large-scale livestock and poultry farms, pollution treatment of industrial enterprises, and demonstrations of construction of ecological cities.
zh: 了解到这些项目涉及的领域非常广泛，包括区域水环境综合治理（包括保护瓦布湖生态环境）、饮用水环境保护、农村环境整治、大型畜牧业和 poultry 产业防污控制、工业企业污染处理以及生态城市建设的示范。

en: The projects, upon implementation, had a positive effect on advancing Lu’an City’s regional scientific development, achieving rehabilitation for lakes, accelerating improvement in the water environment of drainage basins, ensuring safety in drinking water, and advancing energy saving and emission reduction.
zh: 项目实施后对鲁安市地区科学发展的促进产生了积极影响，实现了湖泊的康复，加速了排水区水环境的改善，确保了饮用水安全，推动了能源节约和减排。

en: Today, four groups including Tonglu County, Zhejiang Province, which contributed to Beautiful China won the 8th China Environmental Award.
zh: 今天，包括浙江省通留县在内的四个团体获得了美丽中国的第八届环境奖。

en: Established in 2000, the China Environmental Award is the most prestigious award in the field of environmental protection in China. The judging panel is made up of many Central government departments.
zh: 中国环境奖是由多个中央政府部门组成的评审委员会成立于2000年，是中国环境保护领域最具荣誉的奖项。

en: Li Wei, head of the judging panel and Secretary-General of China Environmental Protection Foundation said that China is now confronted with legacy ecological issues from a growth model that was GDP-heavy and environmental protection-light for a few decades.
zh: Simplified Chinese：李维，评审委员会主席和中国环境保护基金会秘书长表示，中国现在面临着几十年以GDP为重的生长模式和环境保护轻的legacy生态问题。

en: The selection of the current China Environmental Award was aimed at honoring entities and individuals that have contributed to improving the environment and people’s livelihoods so as to reflect popular will.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国环境奖的当前选手评选主要是为了表彰那些对改善环境和人民生活做出了贡献的实体和个人，以反映民众意愿。

en: As far as the judging panel was concerned, Tonglu County in Zhejiang Province which was founded on the basis of ecology should win this honor.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根据评审委员会的看法，浙江省浊留县（即今浙江省东阳市）基于生态原则建立的应该获得此殊荣。

en: According to popular vote, the voice of US actor Morgan Freeman will be used for Jarvis, the domestic AI helper Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg built himself.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根据人气投票，美国演员莫根·弗里曼（Morgan Freeman）的声音将被用来为Facebook CEO马克·扎克伯格（Mark Zuckerberg）自己建造的domestic AI助手Jarvis提供声音。

en: This system operates in the Zuckerberg home, and its name is similar to Tony Stark’s AI helper in the movie “Iron Man”.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这个系统在扎克伯格家中运作，其名称与电影“铁人”中的特纳斯坦（Tony Stark）的AI助手类似。

en: Hubei police smashed four cross-border telecommunication fraud syndicates in connection with more than 500 cases in 31 provinces, cities and counties involving more than RMB70 million
zh: Simplified Chinese：湖北警察在31个省、市、县涉及超过500起案件的跨境电信诈骗团伙中，打击了四家。

en: Staff reporter Cai Changchun. “Legal Daily” learned from the Ministry of Public Security today that a series of cross-border telecommunication network scams was uncovered in an action under the command of the Ministry of Public Security entailing the police from Xiangyang, Hubei going to Malaysia, and with the cooperation of the Royal Malaysian Police. It was a fairly typical Taiwanese telecommunication network scam.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国法律日报记者蔡长春。今天，公安部向我们透露了一系列跨境 telecommunications网络骗局被揭露，这是由公安部指挥的行动涉及来自湖北襄阳的警察前往马来西亚，并与皇家马来西亚警察合作。这是一种典型的台湾 telecommunications网络骗局。

en: How soccer's financial rules impact Neymar's move to Paris
zh: Simplified Chinese：足球的财务规则如何影响尼尔马（Neymar）的转会到巴黎。

en: Rules aimed at preventing unfettered spending by European soccer clubs will not disrupt Neymar's world-record transfer from Spain's Barcelona to France's Paris-Saint Germain.
zh: 球队的无限制支出规则不会影响尼马尔从西班牙巴塞罗那到法国巴黎圣日耳曼的世界纪录转会。

en: Any consequences will come further down the line for Paris Saint-Germain from UEFA, the governing body overseeing the European game which has the power to ban teams from the prestigious Champions League tournament.
zh: Simplified Chinese：任何后果都将在UEFA监管欧洲运动的权力下面，会随着时间推移而来，对于巴黎圣日耳曼来说。

en: Financial Fair Play rules launched by UEFA in 2011 mean that PSG will eventually have to show that Neymar's transfer was funded without incurring huge losses.
zh: Simplified Chinese：UEFA在2011年推出的财务公平规则意味着PSG最终会必须证明尼姆巴尔的转会资金来源并没有导致巨大损失。

en: Barcelona has been paid 222 million euros ($262 million) just to buy the Brazilian out of his contract and Neymar will command a salary that will run to tens of millions of dollars a year.
zh: Simplified Chinese：巴塞罗那已经支付了22亿欧元（2620万美元），仅为了买出巴西人从合同中脱离，尼姆巴尔的年薪将会高达几十亿美元。

en: Here are some of the financial aspects of Neymar's move to France.
zh: Simplified Chinese：以下是尼马尔在法国的财务方面。

en: PSG can certainly stump up the cash to sign Neymar and add him to a galaxy of other stars, given the team's funding from the energy-rich ruling family of Qatar.
zh: Simplified Chinese：PSG可以肯定地筹集足够的资金来签下尼马尔并将他加入了一个星球中的其他明星，考虑到队伍从富有的卡塔尔统治家族获得的资金。

en: Clubs are allowed to spend heavily on acquiring players but they have to counterbalance that with legitimate sources of income, allowing them to approach break-even on their football-related business.
zh: Simplified Chinese：俱乐部可以大量投入购买球员，但必须通过合法收入来平衡，这样他们才能在足球业务上实现平衡。

en: FFP was conceived by Michel Platini after his election as UEFA president in 2007.
zh: 菲夫的概念是米歇尔·普拉蒂尼于2007年当选为欧洲足联主席后提出。

en: The former France player believed that clubs who ran up huge debts in their pursuit of success were effectively cheating and risking ruin if banks or owners withdrew their support.
zh: Simplified Chinese：前法国足球运动员认为，那些在追求成功时积累了巨额债务的俱乐部实际上是在违规并面临破产的风险。

en: In 2011, FFP shifted from focusing on clubs' debts to monitoring their losses instead.
zh: 2011年，FFP从关注俱乐部债务转向监控他们的损失。

en: The change meant that the business model Roman Abramovich initially used at Chelsea in 2003 - buy a club with potential, and then spend heavily to improve the squad and build a global brand - become a tougher proposition.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这意味着从2003年开始，罗马纳布拉莫维奇在切尔西使用的初期商业模式——购买潜力较强的俱乐部，然后大量投资改善阵容并建立全球品牌——变得更加困难。

en: During the current three-year FFP assessment period that runs through 2018, clubs can incur losses of 30 million euros.
zh: 在2018年之前的三年的FFP评估期内，俱乐部可以因违规行为而遭受30亿欧元的损失。

en: And despite Platini being ousted in disgrace from the presidency in 2015, his UEFA successor Aleksander Ceferin is still committed to deterring excessive spending.
zh: Simplified Chinese：尽管2015年普拉蒂尼因不当被解职，但他的UEFA继任者亚历山大·塞费林仍然坚持减少过度支出。

en: "Certainly FFP is not dead and we will, for sure, reinforce the rules going forward," Andrea Traverso, who oversees FFP at UEFA, told The Associated Press last week.
zh: 绝对不是FFP死了，我们一定会在未来强化规则。

en: Although PSG will have paid Neymar's buyout clause in one lump sum, it can spread the amount for accounting purposes over the length of his contract.
zh: Simplified Chinese：尽管PSG已经支付了尼马尔的收购金，虽然是一次大笔付款，但可以通过会计目的将金额分散到他的合同期限。

en: Neymar has signed a five-year deal, so the transfer fee could be shown as a 44.4 million-euro cost in the annual accounts for the next five years.
zh: Simplified Chinese：尼马尔签署了五年的合约，因此转会费的成本可能在下一五年的一般财务报表中显示为44.4万欧元。

en: The first wave of FFP sanctions in 2014 saw PSG, along with Abu Dhabi-owned Manchester City, hit with the heaviest sanctions.
zh: 2014 年的第一个FFP制裁波中，PSG 一起与阿布扎比所有权的曼城一起受到最严厉的制裁。

en: PSG was handed a fine of 60 million euros (then $82 million) - that was later reduced to 20 million euros - and ordered to limit its Champions League squads to 21 players for the 2014-15 season instead of the normal 25.
UEFA is on the lookout for clubs who might try to outwit its financial regulators by inflating their income through companies linked to a club's owners.
zh: Simplified Chinese：欧洲足联正在寻找可能会通过公司与俱乐部所有者的联系来操纵其财务监管的俱乐部。

en: While a Qatari company could sponsor PSG, if the value of the sponsorship was deemed to exceed standard market rates UEFA would not allow it to count as legitimate income.
zh: Simplified Chinese：而且，一家卡塔尔公司赞助PSG是可能的，但如果赞助价值超过标准市场价格，UEFA就不会允许它作为合法收入。

en: That is what happened in 2014 when UEFA ruled that the value of the Qatar Tourism Authority sponsorship of PSG was inflated.
zh: Simplified Chinese：2014年，UEFA决定了Qatar旅游局赞助PSG的价值是被夸大了。

en: It has been reported that part of Neymar's PSG earnings could come via payments from the 2022 World Cup organizing committee in Qatar.
zh: 据报道，尼马尔的PSG收入的一部分可能来自于2022年世界杯组织委员会在卡塔尔的付款。

en: But PSG and Qatar 2022 have denied that Neymar will become a World Cup ambassador and such a maneuver would be easy for UEFA's regulators to expose.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但巴黎圣日耳曼和2022年卡塔尔杯否认尼姆阿尔将成为世界杯大使，并且这样做的难度很小，欧洲足联监管机构很容易暴露。

en: Past sanctions slapped on PSG means that UEFA will be even more watchful of any attempt to circumvent the rules.
zh: Simplified Chinese：过去对PSG的制裁意味着UEFA会更加严格地监视任何试图绕过规则的尝试。

en: UEFA has not been in pre-emptive discussions with PSG about Neymar's transfer, people familiar with the situation said Thursday.
zh: Simplified Chinese：欧洲足联并未在尼马尔转会问题上进行预防性讨论，据人士周四表示。

en: They spoke to The Associated Press on condition of anonymity as they were not authorized to discuss the PSG situation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们在与《联合报社》谈话时，要求匿名，以便不被授权讨论PSG的情况。

en: The last published accounts show that PSG made a profit of more than 10 million euros in 2015-16 on a turnover of 542.4 million euros.
zh: 2015年至2016年的最后一次公布的财务报告显示，PSG在2015年至2016年实现了超过10亿欧元的利润，总营收达到542.4亿欧元。

en: Accounts for the last financial year are yet to be published.
zh: Simplified Chinese：截至目前，最近一年的财务报告尚未发布。

en: PSG expects Neymar's arrival to be a boon for sponsorship deals, merchandising and jersey sales.
zh: psg期望尼马尔的到来会带来赞助合同、商标销售和球衣销量的好处。

en: The club expects turnover would grow by at least 30 percent on the back of the signing.
zh: Simplified Chinese：俱乐部预计通过签约的收入增长至少30%。

en: Clearly irritated to see one of soccer's biggest players leaving, the Spanish league tried to stymie Neymar's move, claiming that PSG will be breaching FFP.
zh: Simplified Chinese：显然对足球巨星尼马尔离开的不满，西班牙联赛试图阻止他转会，称PSG将违反财务平衡法。

en: "It is a clear case of 'financial doping', with the club and the state," La Liga President Javier Tebas told Spanish newspaper AS, referring to Qatar's ultimate ownership of PSG.
zh: 是“财务 doping”的清晰例子，俱乐部和国家都与 qatar 的最终所有权有关。

en: Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger, whose club is owned by an American sports tycoon, shares La Liga's reservations about a state funding a club.
zh: Simplified Chinese：阿森纳经理阿尔南·文格尔，拥有美国体育巨头拥有的俱乐部，表达了对国家为俱乐部提供资金的担忧。

en: "It is the consequence of the ownerships and that has completely changed the whole landscape of football in the last 15 years," Wenger said Thursday.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是所有拥有足球的国家中，所有人都在过去15年里改变了足球世界的全部景象。

en: "Once a country owns a club, everything is possible.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一旦一个国家拥有俱乐部，就一切都是可能的。

en: It becomes very difficult to respect the Financial Fair Play because you can have different ways or different interests for a country to have such a big player to represent a country."
zh: Simplified Chinese：尊重财务公平的道理变得很难，因为一个国家可以选择代表其的球队的方式有很多，甚至可能存在不同利益。

en: Smart interactive robot developer Rokid received new investment; Temasek is the lead investor
zh: 智慧互动机器人开发商罗基德获得新投资；特马塞克是主要投资者。

en: In recent years, start-ups in the AI sector have continued to be a hot favorite of capital.
zh: Simplified Chinese：近年来，人工智能领域的 startups 继续是资本的热门选择。

en: AI Rokid recently completed a round of funding, led by Temasek. Other investors included Credit Suisse, CDIB (the investment arm of China Development Financial Holdings Co., Ltd.), and existing shareholder IDG Capital.
zh: AI Rokid近期完成了一轮融资，主要由Temasek领投。其他投资者包括Credit Suisse、CDIB（中国发展金融控股有限责任公司投资部），以及现有股东IDG Capital。

en: It is understood that the size of this round of funding was approximately US$100 million. Both Credit Suisse and CDIB were first time investors in China’s domestic AI industry.
zh:
这次融资的规模大约为10亿美元。 
两家公司，瑞士信贷和中国大陆投资银行，都是中国国内AI行业的首次投资者。

en: Rokid is a developer of smart interactive robots, and is committed to robotics research. It products can control smart devices in the home, and has continuous autonomous learning and growth functions. It also features recognition, comprehension and feedback functions.
zh: 罗基德是一家智能互动机器人开发商，致力于机器人研究。其产品可以控制家庭中的智能设备，并具有持续自主学习和成长功能。此外，它还具备识别、理解和反馈功能。

en: Proceeds from this round of funding will be used for R&D, talent recruitment, strategic push and industry chain investment layout.
zh: Simplified Chinese：本轮资金的收入将用于研发、人力资源招募、战略推进和行业链投资布局。

en: Rokid previously raised US$8.3 million in August 2014 in the Angel Round from IDG, Linear Venture, Mfund and Vision Capital. In October 2014, the company again received at least US$10 million in Series A funding led by Walden International, with the Angel investors as participants. On November 1, 2016, Rokid completed Series B funding, led by Advantech Capital; other investors included IDG, Mfund, Vision Capital and Walden International.
zh: 以前，罗基在2014年8月获得了8.3万美元的天使轮投资，从IDG、线性投资、MFund和视觉资本中筹集。2014年10月，该公司再次获得至少10万美元的A级融资，主要由沃尔登国际主导，天使投资者作为参与者。2016年11月1日，罗基完成了B级融资，主要由Advantech Capital领导；其他投资者包括IDG、MFund、视觉资本和沃尔登国际。

en: At the time, Rokid claimed that after the Series B funding, the company’s valuation would reach US$450 million.
zh: 在那时，罗基德声称，在系列B融资之后，该公司的valuation将达到45亿美元。

en: In May 2017, Rokid unveiled its consumer class smart voice robot “Rokid - Pebble”, integrating AI and the home, priced at RMB1,399.
zh: 在2017年5月，罗基公司推出了其消费级别的智能语音机器人“罗基-石榴”，融合AI和家用市场，价格为人民币1399元。

en: This robot uses speech synthesis, natural language understanding, speech recognition technology and microphone array technology, with conversational, music broadcast and smart home features.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这台机器人使用语音合成、自然语言理解、语音识别技术和微phones阵列技术，具有会话、音乐广播和智能家居功能。

en: It has won two major CES awards - Tech For A Better World and Home Audio/Video Components And Accessories, as well as Germany’s iF Design Award, known as the Oscars of the design world.
zh: 它获得了两项主要的CES奖项——Tech For A Better World和Home Audio/Video Components And Accessories，以及德国的iF设计奖，后者被称为设计界的奥斯卡。

en: At the 2018 CES which had just ended, Rokid unveiled another new product: the consumer class augmented reality AR glasses RokidGlass.
zh: 2018年CES刚结束，罗基 unveil了另一个新产品：消费者级增强现实AR眼镜罗基眼镜。

en: These glasses are used as independent head displays, and do not require connections to smartphones or external computers. It is expected to be commercialized in 2018.
zh: 这些眼镜作为独立头部显示使用，不需要连接手机或外部电脑。预计将于2018年商业化。

en: Previously, the company had already released its first generation home robot, RokidAlien and second generation product, smart voice box RokidPebble.
zh: Simplified Chinese：之前，公司已经推出过第一代家庭机器人RokidAlien和第二代产品smart voice box RokidPebble。

en: This is the 135th anniversary Lu Xun’s birth and 80th anniversary of his death. In the words of scriptwriter Zhou Zhiqing, “I love Lu Xun. That’s why I have creative impulse.”
zh: 这个是鲁迅的生日135周年，也是他去世80周年。作家周志清说：“我爱鲁迅。所以我有创造力。”

en: Apple revealed that with effect from February 28, Guizhou-Cloud will be the new operator of iCloud services in Mainland China.
zh: 苹果公司宣布，从2月28日起，贵州云将成为大陆的iCloud服务运营商。

en: Apple said that “the partnership with Guizhou-Cloud will allow us improve the speed and reliability of our iCloud services products while also complying with newly passed regulations that cloud services be operated by Chinese companies.”
zh: Simplified Chinese：苹果表示，与贵州云的合作将使我们改进iCloud服务产品的速度和可靠性，同时也符合刚刚通过的新规定，即云服务必须由中国公司经营。

en: During the period of deactivation, data and information previously stored in iCloud by users will still remain in iCloud, and will not be lost.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在激活状态期间，用户存储在iCloud上的数据和信息仍然会被保存在iCloud中，并不会丢失。

en: If users wish to use iCloud services after February 28 after deactivation, they must first accept the new terms and conditions to ensure that their accounts are reactivated and transferred to Guizhou-Cloud.
zh: 如果用户在2023年2月28日之后重新激活iCloud服务，必须首先接受新条款和条件，以确保账户被重新激活并转移到贵州云。

en: Meanwhile, Apple emphasized in its statement that, “Apple has a strong data privacy and security mechanism and will not create a backdoor in any of our systems.”
zh: Simplified Chinese： meantime，苹果在其声明中强调说：“苹果有强大的数据隐私和安全机制，并且不会在我们的系统中创建一个后门”。

en: iCloud’s main data center at Gui-An New Area will be the first data center Apple has set up in China. On completion, it will be used to store the data of Apple users in China.
zh: 苹果的主要数据中心位于中国桂安新区，成为苹果在中国设立的第一个数据中心。完成后，将用于存储中国苹果用户的数据。

en: When completed and commissioned, Chinese users will be able upload and download data without having to undergo long-distance transmission between China and the US. Speed will be enhanced and delays reduced.
zh: Simplified Chinese：完成并上线后，中国用户将能够无需进行长途传输从中国到美国就可以上传下载数据。速度会得到提高，延迟也会减少。

en: Fang Wenshan will direct one to two of these 10 musical IP works. When Jay Chou was asked whether he would help with the directing, he said frankly that there is too much pressure in being a director. He hoped to find a few young directors to allow them room to play their part.
zh: fang wen shan hui le yi ge yī zhōng de 10 gè yīn yáng píng wù, tā huì dào jiǎo chou shuō huán zhēn kě néng zài yī gè dà yīng xíng de zǔ zhī.

en: Prior to joining Twitter in 2011, Messinger was Vice President of development at Oracle.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在2011年加入推特之前，Messinger是奥拉克尔的开发副总裁。

en: The company is stepping up production of its first long-distance electric vehicle Model 3 targeted at the mass market, and plans to launch it by the end of 2017.
zh: 公司正在增加生产其第一款长距离电动车型Model 3，主要针对大众市场，并计划在2017年底推出。

en: “Tofu”, a 3D animated feature film designed for a general audience held its premiere in Wuhan on the 25th. Zou Yi, Director of “Tofu”, Meng Zhihui, Animation Director of “Tofu”, as well as Tom Disher, film soundtrack composer and Emmy Award winner were present to share their behind-the-scenes story of the film’s creation.
zh: “豆腐”，一部3D动画特写片，针对广大观众设计的电影在武汉举行了首映。 “豆腐”导演周义、“豆腐”动画导演孟志慧以及电影配乐作曲家托姆·迪舍尔（Tom Disher）和艾米奖得主出席，分享了电影制作过程的故事。

en: “Tofu” is based on a traditional allusion concerning Liu An, Prince of Huainan in the Han Dynasty - “Liu An made a mistake and invented tofu”. It is an account of “Dou Fu”, the leading character, a bean who miraculously took on human form, how he overcame numerous difficulties and persevered in his dream to become an immortal. This adorable animated film about becoming an immortal is closely connected with Hubei’s local culture.
zh: “豆腐”是基于汉代淳安王刘安的传说——“刘安犯了错误，发明豆腐”。这是一部关于“豆腐”主角——一只奇迹般变成人的豆子，面临多次困难却坚持追求成为神仙的动画片。

en: Wudang Mountains, located in Shiyan, Hubei Province, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, as well as the place of origin of Toaist culture and Wudang martial arts. It is known as “a unique scenic spot since ancient times, and the premier celestial mountain in the world”.
zh: 武当山，位于湖北省石家庵市，是联合国教科文组织世界遗产、道教文化和武当武术的起源地。它被誉为“古时的独特景观，世界首屈一指的星空之山”。

en: Director Zou Yi revealed that he and his creative team traveled to Wudang Mountains to conduct research for the film prior to its creation.
zh: 导演周义表示，他和他的创作团队在电影制作之前，曾前往武当山进行电影的研究。

en: He said that the story of “Tofu” occurred during the reign of Emperor Wu of Western Han Dynasty, against the backdrop of Liu An, Prince of Huainan, making pills to attain immortality. The leading character “Dou Fu” was a bean that miraculously took on human form by accident while Liu An was making these pills.
zh: 他说，“豆腐”的故事发生在西汉武帝时期，是在刘安（胡ainers）公主的背景下，刘安正在制作神药。主角“豆腐”是一个奇迹般地变成人的豆子，而是因为刘安正在制作这些神药。

en: In addition to Wudang Mountains, the place of origin of Toaist culture, Hubei Province is also closely connected with the chime - a traditional musical instrument with long history in China.
zh: 除了武当山，道教文化的起源地，湖北省，也与中国传统音乐中的铃声（一种具有悠久历史的传统乐器）密切相关。

en: In a recent international conference, experts forecast that robots with AI will enter people's bedrooms in 25 years, and provide various services for humans.
zh: Simplified Chinese：最近的一次国际会议上，专家预测在25年后，人工智能（AI）机器人将进入人们的卧室，并为人类提供各种服务。

en: Through research, scientists have discovered that one of the most significant characteristics of memory is its inaccuracy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：通过研究，科学家们发现了记忆中最显著的特征之一就是它的不准确性。

en: Written in 1934, “Thunderstorm” is Cao Yu’s first work, and the sophisticated hallmark of modern Chinese play. It is also the most translated Chinese play.
zh: Simplified Chinese：1934年创作的《暴风雨》，是曹禕的第一部作品，也是现代中国戏剧最具代表性的标志。它也是最被翻译的中文戏剧。

en: Nostalgia Goes Niche in "Wet Hot American Summer" and "Comrade Detective"
zh: 怀旧在“湿热美国夏天”和“共产党侦探”中变得专门化。

en: So this iteration of the story is simultaneously nostalgic for the characters' '80s glory days; for the '90s grunge era (around when the masterminds David Wain and Michael Showalter made the sketch comedy "The State" for MTV); and for itself - that is, for 2001, before its stars, like Elizabeth Banks, Amy Poehler and Paul Rudd, went on to bigger things.
zh: Simplified Chinese：因此，这个故事的这一版面既是对角色‘80年代辉煌日子的怀念；也是对‘90年代的格鲁吉尔时代（当时创作了MTV sketch comedy“The State”的大师David Wain和Michael Showalter）怀念；以及对自己——也就是2001年这个时候——的怀念。

en: As a cultural artifact, it's both a sendup and embodiment of our Facebook-enabled era of permanent reminiscence.
zh: Simplified Chinese：作为文化artifact，它既是嘲笑也体现了我们的Facebook化的时期，永恒的回忆。

en: But as a franchise, it feels like it's running out of time.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但作为一个品牌，它感觉像它的时间快要耗尽了。

en: "First Day of Camp" worked surprisingly well, not just because of its absurdist humor (it included an origin story for a talking can of vegetables, voiced by H. Jon Benjamin).
zh: Simplified Chinese：第一个营地的第一天工作得非常出色，仅凭其无关紧要的幽默（它包括了一个讲述着一罐话语的蔬菜的起源故事，由H. Jon Benjamin配音）。

en: By doubling down on the core gag - middle-age actors playing horny kids coming of age - it made the impossibility of recapturing the past part of the joke.
zh: Simplified Chinese：通过重复核心笑点——中年演员扮演性感的青少年成长阶段，才使得回归过去的不可能成为笑点的一部分。

en: "Ten Years Later," with its adults now playing adults, is less emotionally rooted and its parody more scattershot, including a riff on '90s stalker flicks like "The Hand That Rocks the Cradle."
zh: 十年后，成人们现在已经成年了，这种情感联系变得更加淡漠，而其对待“90年代的追杀片”如《摇篮中的手》的嘲笑则更加散漫。

en: At one point a character rummages through an Apple Powerbook, some in-line skates and "a bunch of other things from 1991."
zh: Simplified Chinese：在某个时候，一个角色会翻开一本苹果PowerBook，带上一些滑板和“1991年的一些其他东西”。

en: Many of the core stories are the same.
zh: Simplified Chinese：很多核心故事都是相同的。

en: Sweet-hearted Coop (Mr. Showalter), now a novelist, still hasn't gotten over Katie (Marguerite Moreau).
zh: Simplified Chinese：温柔的柯普（马修·肖尔特），现在已经成为作家，但他仍然对凯蒂（玛格丽特·莫雷奥）没有放过。

en: Victor (Ken Marino) still hasn't lost his virginity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：维克多（肯·马里诺）仍然没有失去青春期。

en: And there's another battily villainous plot involving Ronald Reagan (also Mr. Showalter), now abetted by George H. W. Bush (a well-inhabited impression by Michael Ian Black).
zh: 而且，还有一个涉及罗纳德·里根（也就是谢尔顿先生）和乔治·H·W·布什的另一个阴险的 plot。

en: As always, the best part of the franchise is the digressions.
zh: Simplified Chinese：每次都一样， frananchise 的最好的地方是那些分散。

en: It's especially fun to see the forever-young Mr. Rudd, sporting Matt Dillon's soul patch from "Singles," whose former big-man-on-camp Andy now feels like a geezer.
zh: Simplified Chinese：特别是看到永远年轻的鲁德先生， sportingMatt Dillon的“单身”脸盆，从而让他的前大型男孩Andy现在感觉像个老人。

en: It's the moments of random lunacy that might power this franchise on, like a kind of recursive "Seven Up!" series, until it reaches what I assume will be its logical conclusion: "Wet Hot American Summer: Twenty Years Later," whose last scene will have the gang going to see the movie premiere of "Wet Hot American Summer."
zh: Simplified Chinese：是的，这种 franchise 的力量可能来自于偶然的疯狂时刻，像一种递归性的“七不二”系列，直到它达到我假设的逻辑结论：《湿热美国夏季：二十年后》，其最后一幕将使团队去看电影《湿热美国夏季》。

en: "Comrade Detective" on Amazon, meanwhile, appeals to a different brand of nostalgia: the Cold War revivalism of "The Americans," the film "Atomic Blonde" and even "GLOW," with its East versus West wrestling iconography.
zh: “杀手探偵”在亚马逊上流行 meanwhile，却唤起了不同的怀旧：冷战复兴的“美国人”、“原子女郎”和甚至“GLOW”，以东方与西方的斗争象征。

en: The comedy, created by Brian Gatewood and Alessandro Tanaka, with Rhys Thomas directing, purports to be found TV: a Romanian 1980s buddy-cop drama about two Bucharest officers fighting for truth, atheism and the Marxist-Leninist way.
zh: 这部喜剧，由布莱恩·盖特伍德（Brian Gatewood）和阿列桑多·塔纳卡（Alessandro Tanaka）创作，Rhys Thomas执导，宣称是关于两个布加勒斯特警察在寻求真理、无神论和马克思列宁主义的1980年代罗马尼亚 buddy-cop剧。

en: The lead roles - hard-boiled Gregor and idealistic Iosef - are played by Florin Piersic Jr. and Corneliu Ulici, their dialogue dubbed in English by Channing Tatum (also an executive producer) and Joseph Gordon-Levitt.
zh: 主演的角色 — —硬派格罗尔和理想主义的伊奥塞夫 — —由弗林·皮埃里斯Jr.和科内利乌·乌利奇扮演，他们的对话在英语中配音，由查宁·塔特姆（也是执行制片人）和约瑟夫·戈登-莱维特（也参与制作）。

en: It's a brilliant idea.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是一种出色的想法。

en: But it's not much more than an idea.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但这只是一个想法。

en: There are some fine sight gags (the police pass the time watching chess on TV as Americans might football).
zh: 有趣的是，警察在看电视上打棋的方式与美国人看足球的方式类似。

en: And the roster of famous voice-over actors - among them Jenny Slate, Nick Offerman, Mahershala Ali and Chloë Sevigny - makes for a decent game of spot-the-voice.
zh: 而名人声优的阵容——其中包括珍妮·斯莱特、尼克·奥弗曼、马赫沙拉·阿利和 Chloe Sevigny 等人——使得识别声音成为一个合理的游戏。

en: But "Comrade Detective" is so committed to the verisimilitude of a hamfisted propaganda drama - a killer wearing a Reagan mask is involved - that it often plays like one.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但“共产侦探”如此坚持其在宣传剧的真实性——一个粗制滥造的杀人者穿着里根面具——经常会像这样演出。

en: At six long episodes, it drags, and the comedy isn't fast or frequent enough.
zh: Simplfied Chinese：六个长达的节目中，剧情拖延，喜剧并没有足够快节奏。

en: Edited to a tighter length, "Comrade Detective" might deliver better on its agitprop satire, as when Gregor and Iosef repeatedly visit the American Embassy, whose lobby is always occupied by two fat men wolfing down a pile of hamburgers.
zh: “同志侦探”被削减为更紧凑的长度时，它可能会在其agitprop幽默中取得更好的成就，例如格罗尔和伊奥塞夫重复访问美国大使馆，lobby里总是有两个肥胖男子狼吞虎咽一堆汉堡。

en: The message, for the imagined communist audience, is that Western culture can turn anything into fodder to binge.
zh: Simplified Chinese：信息，针对想象中的共产主义听众来说，是这样一种观点：西方文化可以把任何东西都变成 binge 的食物。

en: The fictional Romanian creators were not wrong: We even do it with our own recent history, and theirs.
zh: Simplified Chinese：虚构的罗马尼亚创作者并没有错：我们甚至在自己的最近历史中也这样做，和他们一样。

en: Reporters learned from recent interviews that the performance of the steel, rail transport, shipping vessel, machinery manufacture and other industries has fallen in general; some have even incurred losses.
zh: Simplified Chinese：记者从近期的采访中了解到，钢铁、铁路运输、船舶运输、机器制造等行业的整体表现下滑；有的甚至出现了亏损。

en: Some experts believed that under the present circumstances, a new round of revitalization of the industries in Northeast China will not only concern the nation’s current economic recovery, it will also have an impact on the long-term growth and international competitiveness of China's manufacturing sector. Hence, there is an urgent call for adjustments and structural transformation to take place.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一些专家认为，在当前的情况下，东北中国的工业复兴新一轮不仅会影响本国目前经济复苏，还会对中国制造业长期增长和国际竞争力产生重大影响。因此，需要立即进行调整和结构转型。

en: Traditional industries saw a general decline in performance, and even incurred losses. The raw material industry, and the heavy machinery and equipment manufacturing sector saw performance decline significantly, and even incurred losses. These were the first signs from the industries in Northeast China amid the current sluggish economy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：传统行业的整体表现下降，甚至出现亏损。 nguyên liệu和重型机器制造业以及设备制造部门的表现下降明显，甚至出现亏损。这是中国东北地区当前经济萧条时期 industries 的第一个信号。

en: When the economy decelerated in the past, low-end and primary commodities were the most significantly affected. In the current economic fluctuation however, both high- and low-end industrial products of Northeast China’s traditional industries were affected.
zh: 当经济放缓时，低端和基本商品受到影响最严重。然而，在当前的经济波动中，东北中国传统行业的高端和低端工业产品都受到影响。

en: A few years ago, Ansteel Group (Weibo) began by adjusting its product mix, and gave priority to developing high-end steel plates such as those for containers, railroad tracks, shipbuilding, and civilian home appliances. However, sales of these product categories fell significantly. In particular, the sales volume of steel plates for shipbuilding plunged 50% year-on-year.
zh: 几年前，安steel集团（微博）开始通过调整产品 mix，优先发展高端钢板，如用于箱车、铁路轨道、船建和民用家电等。然而，这些产品类别的销售量大幅下降。其中，船建钢板的销售量每年下跌50%。

en: Angang Steel Company (Hao Qingshun, Director of the Metallurgical Department of Liaoning Provincial Industry and Informatization Commission, said that metallurgy was the third largest pillar industry in Liaoning, with annual steel production capacity of 60 million tonnes, ranked third nationwide.
zh: 安港钢铁公司（辽宁省工业和信息化部金属材料部主任 Hao青松说，金属材料是辽宁的第三大支柱行业，年产钢铁60万吨，是全国第三。

en: For the first five months of this year, crude steel production in Liaoning Province amounted to 21.54 million tonnes. Sales of products required by projects that were encouraged by national policy and where there was strong local government construction activity was better. Products in which market competition was more intense fell by a larger magnitude. This was another characteristic of Northeast China’s manufacturing sector.
zh: Simplified Chinese：今年上半年，辽宁省的粗钢产量达到21.54万吨。受到国家政策鼓励的项目所需产品的销售更好；而市场竞争更加激烈的产品 sales下降幅度更大。这是东北中国制造业的一个特征。

en: In sharp contrast to being diligent and responsible on reaching adulthood, Daniel Wu was a very mischievous child, even rebellious.
zh: Simplified Chinese：与成年时的勤勉和责任感形成鲜明对比，丹尼尔·伍（Daniel Wu）在童年时期却是一个非常调皮的孩子，甚至是反叛性的。

en: The movie “Once Upon a Time”, soon to be released on August 4, held a press conference entitled “people from all corners of the world have come to meet you” to launch the movie in Beijing yesterday. On-screen “Bai Ye couple” Yang Yang (Ye) and Liu Yifei (Bai) were present at the conference.
zh: 电影《Once Upon a Time》即将于8月4日上映，昨天在北京举行了“来自世界各个角落的人们都来见你”的宣传活动。演出中的“白叶 couple”杨阳（叶）和刘怡菲（白）出席了会议。

en: Yang Yang, who underwent surgery on his right ear just a few days ago, made an appearance for the first time after his recuperation. He interpreted his character as someone who “does not wear his heart on his sleeve”, quietly giving his all to Bai Qian, and concealing all his feelings.
zh: 杨阳，刚刚进行了右耳手术不久，就第一次露面。他把自己形象化为“不在心上提起心头”，平静地给了白千秋全部的爱情，而把所有的情感都藏在内。

en: Yang Yang said that he had to rouse all his emotions to convey the character’s hidden sadness to the audience. “This was certainly a new challenge for me as an actor. While acting this character, I was so emotionally suppressed that I almost suffered internal injury”.
zh: 杨阳说，他必须唤起所有他的情绪来传达这个角色隐藏的悲伤给观众。“这确实是一个新的挑战给我作为演员。虽然在扮演这个角色时，我是如此地内心压抑到几乎遭受内部损伤”。

en: Liu Yifei, meanwhile, revealed that while acting her character in the movie, she cried so much that she collapsed at one point.
zh: 刘亦菲在电影中扮演角色时，透露自己哭得太多，导致一次点就晕倒了。

en: The Japanese Olympic Committee recently said that the Japanese delegation was targeted at 30 gold medals at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics and making Japan into the Top Three.
zh: 日本奥林匹克委员会最近表示，日本代表团在2020年东京奥运会上目标是获得30枚金牌，并将日本列入前三名。

en: In October last year, Chairman Yamashita Tasuhiro of the Athletes Commission of Japanese Olympic Committee expressed his expectation that the Japanese athletes can win 2.5 times more gold medals at the Tokyo Olympics than at the Rio Olympics.
zh: Simplified Chinese：去年十月，日本奥林匹克委员会运动员委员会主席山下田正廣表示，他希望日本选手在东京奥运会上比里约奥运会多赢2.5倍的金牌。

en: At the 2016 Rio Olympics, Japanese delegation ranked 6th in the Gold List with 12 gold medals.
zh: 2016年里约奥运会上，日本代表团在金牌名单中排名第六位，获得了12枚金牌。

en: The representatives formed their own groupings, and walked to the venue holding umbrellas.
zh: 代表们组成了自己的小组，拿着雨伞走向会场。

en: Traffic on the roads surrounding the venue remained normal. There were no balloons or slogans at the venue, nor a red carpet; displays of plants and fresh flowers were absent as well.
zh: 交通在会场周围的道路上仍然正常，会场里没有气球或标语，也没有红 Carpet；植物和新鲜花的展览都没有。

en: Yesterday, the second session of the fourth People’s Congress of Guang’an City convened without much ado.
zh: 昨天，广安市第四届人民代表大会的第二次会议开幕了。

en: On entering GuangAn International Convention and Exhibition Center, slogans were absent from the venue, and there were no tea cups; not even a bottle of mineral water was present.
zh: Simplified Chinese：进入广安国际会展中心时，标语就不在场，而没有茶杯；即使是矿水瓶也没有。

en: Instead, there a simple banner, a meeting place, a simple recyclable paper document bag containing materials for the meeting and a recyclable paper cup for tea or water.
zh: Simplified Chinese：而是，仅有一个简单的banner，一个会议地点，一个简单的可回收纸质袋，里面包含了会议材料和可回收的纸质杯，用于茶水。

en: The meeting materials were less dense than that of the past. A few pieces of paper summarized the theme and the agenda of the meeting.
zh: 会议资料比过去要稀疏一些。有一些纸张简要概括了会议的主题和议程。

en: “Be thrifty for the people. Those whose duty are to be frugal must live frugally. A return to the current simple and down-to-earth meeting environment, we fully comprehend and welcome it.” GuangAn People’s Congress deputy Wang Cheng said that an efficient and practical meeting without formalism is what they want to see and in which they want to participate.
zh:
“节俭是为人民。那些有责任节约的人必须生活节俭。我们完全理解和欢迎回到当前的简单而真诚的会议环境。”
 GuangAn 人大代表王成表示，他们希望看到一个高效且实用的会议，没有形式主义，愿意参与。

en: Experts pointed out that both inflationary and deflationary pressures have eased at this time. This was undoubtedly good news for the financial and economic structural transformation stage.
zh: Simplified Chinese：专家们指出，目前两种经济压力都有所缓解。这是对金融和经济结构转型阶段来说的无疑好消息。

en: A total of 22 models of electric vehicles are sold at all major car dealers in California, but the selection in other states is a lot more limited. The second placed state only has 14 models while six states do not have any electric vehicles on sale.
zh: 加利福尼亚州所有主要汽车经销商都出售了22款电动车，但其他州的选择要比这里少得多。第二名州只有14款，而六个州根本没有电动车上市。

en: February 10 news: Reporters learned yesterday from Changzhou Municipal Agricultural Committee that on basis of having successfully become a national forest city in 2016, Changzhou will thoroughly implement the “Master Plan for Establishing Changzhou National Forest City, Jiangsu Province (2014-2025)” this year so as to consolidate and upgrade the achievements from establishing a national forest city, and build a green, harmonious and high quality forest city that may be shared and enjoyed by all.
zh: 二月十日新闻：昨天，江苏省长洲市农村委员会向记者透露，2016年成功成为国家森林城市后，长洲将在本年全面实施《长洲国家森林城市计划（2014-2025）》，以巩固和提升建立国家森林城市的成果，并建设一个可分享、可享受的绿色和谐高质量的森林城市。

en: Bank of England to keep interest rates at 0.25%
zh: Simplified Chinese：英国银行保持利率在0.25％

en: The Bank of England is expected to announce later that interest rates will remain unchanged after lacklustre economic growth and easing inflation dampened speculation over a hike.
zh: 英国国民银行预计稍后会宣布利率不会改变，尽管经济增长疲软和通胀减少了对利率上调的猜测。

en: The Bank of England has warned economic growth will remain "sluggish" as it kept interest rates on hold amid a tightening squeeze on family incomes.
zh: 银行英格兰警告经济增长会继续“缓慢”，在保持利率不变的同时，家庭收入受到紧缩的压力。

en: Policymakers on the Bank's Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) voted 6-2 to keep rates at 0.25%, with fewer members this month calling for a rise as lacklustre economic growth has weakened support for a hike.
zh: 银行货币政策委员会（MPC）成员在投票中支持维持利率为0.25%，少数成员呼吁上调，但经济增长疲软导致了对上调的支持力下降。

en: In its quarterly inflation report, the Bank cut its forecasts for growth to 1.7% in 2017 and 1.6% in 2018 and cautioned the squeeze on household incomes would continue, with inflation still expected to surge close to 3% in the autumn.
zh: 在其季度通胀报告中，银行降低了2017年和2018年的经济增长预测到1.7％和1.6％，并警告说，家庭收入的收缩将继续，尽管秋季时期仍然会出现通胀率接近3%。

en: But it signalled rate hikes will be needed over the next few years to rein in Brexit-fuelled inflation and said borrowing costs may need to rise by more than expected in financial markets.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但这意味着未来几年需要通过控制脱欧引发的通货膨胀来提高利率，并且可能需要在金融市场中超过预期的借贷成本。

en: Members also voted to withdraw part of the mammoth economy-boosting package unleashed a year ago in the aftermath of Brexit.
zh: Simplified Chinese：成员们还投票决定撤销一年前因脱离欧盟而释放的巨大经济刺激包。

en: It will call time on the Term Funding Scheme to offer cheap-finance to banks from next February, although it said it was now expected to offer £15 billion more under the scheme - at £115 billion.
zh: Simplified Chinese：从下个二月开始，该计划将终止期贷款方案，向银行提供便宜的融资。

en: In minutes of the rates decision, the Bank said: "In the MPC's central forecast, gross domestic product (GDP) remains sluggish in the near-term as the squeeze on households' real incomes continues to weigh on consumption."
zh: 在货币利率决定的分钟里，银行说：“根据MPC的中性预测，国内生产总值（GDP）在近期仍然处于 sluggish状态，因为家庭实际收入继续受到压力，这导致消费。

en: On rates, it reiterated that "some tightening of monetary policy" would be needed to cool inflation and by a "somewhat greater" extent than markets expect.
zh: Simplified Chinese：关于利率，重申了“某种程度的货币政策紧缩”将需要来降低通胀，并且比市场预期的“稍微更大”的程度。

en: Markets are currently forecasting the first rise in the third quarter of next year and another in 2020.
zh: Simplified Chinese：目前市场预测下个季度将出现第三季的首次上涨，并且还预计2020年会再次上涨。

en: But the Bank stressed that any hikes would be "gradual" and "limited."
zh: Simplified Chinese：但银行强调任何上涨都是“缓慢”和“有限”的。

en: The Bank's downgraded growth forecasts for this year and next compare with the 1.9% and 1.7% predicted in May.
zh: Simplified Chinese：银行今年和明年增长预测下调，与5月份预测的1.9%和1.7%相比。

en: It maintained its forecast for growth of 1.8% in 2018.
zh: Simplified Chinese：它继续保持了2018年经济增长率预测为1.8%的forecast。

en: Sterling fell against the dollar and the euro following the news.
zh: 英镑在美元和欧元的反弹，主要是因为news。

en: The pound was 0.5% down at 1.31 US dollars and fell 0.4% to 1.11 euros.
zh: 英镑在1.31美元的价格下下跌了0.5%，并在1.11欧元的价格下下跌了0.4%。

en: The no-change decision comes after recent disappointing growth figures have dampened mounting expectations of a hike, with GDP edging up to 0.3% in the second quarter from 0.2% in the previous three months.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但最近的经济增长数据却让人们失望，导致了对上涨的期望逐渐消散，GDP在第二季度上升至0.3%，比前三个月的0.2%要高。

en: Growth is likely to remain at 0.3% in the third quarter, although it will start to pick up slightly at the end of the year, according to the Bank.
zh: Simplified Chinese：增长率可能在第三季度保持在 0.3%，尽管年底开始有所增加，根据银行的预测。

en: Its latest inflation report offered little cheer for households being hit by soaring inflation and paltry pay rises as it said the squeeze will get worse before it gets better.
zh: Simplified Chinese：其最新的通货膨胀报告给家庭带来了很少的乐观，尤其是那些受到通胀和低薪上涨的 households，因为它说紧缩会变得更加严重。

en: It added that monetary policy "cannot prevent" the hit to incomes over the next few years, but expects wages will recover "significantly" towards the end of its three-year forecast.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这意味着在未来几年，收入受到的冲击是无法避免的，但预计工资会在其三年前景结束时“显著”恢复。

en: The economy is also set for a boost from surging demand for British goods thanks to the weak pound, which will offset some of the lower consumer spending.
zh: Simplified Chinese：经济也将受英国商品需求的急剧上升带来一波振兴，弱势英镑的影响，将部分弥补低消费者支出。

en: The decision comes a year after rates were cut to 0.25% last August following the shock EU referendum vote, which sent the pound slumping.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但这是在去年八月份，欧盟公投后，利率被降至0.25%，导致英镑大幅下跌。

en: The Bank estimates it will likely take four years to fully feed through to prices and the economy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：银行估计，四年左右需要完全传导到价格和经济。

en: Prior to the Bank's latest rates verdict, there had been growing clamour for a rate rise as inflation ramped up pressure on hard-pressed households, with three policymakers calling for an increase to 0.5% in July.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在银行最新利率判决之前，人们已经开始呼吁利率上调，因为通胀正在对压力过大家庭施加压力，有三名政策家人呼吁在七月份提高利率到0.5%。

en: Inflation eased back to 2.6% last month from 2.9% in June, although the Bank said this was expected and will pick up once again over the coming months.
zh: 价格上涨缓慢回落至2.6%，比六月份的2.9%要低，但银行表示这是预期的，随着下个月来临，价格上涨会再次加速。

en: The Bank said the overshoot relative to its 2% target was "entirely" down to the weak pound.
zh: 银行表示其2%目标相对于当前的超出幅度是“完全”由脆弱的英镑所致。

en: Andrew Montlake, director at Coreco Mortgage Brokers, said: "Given the recent fall in swap rates, the mortgage market looks set to become ever more competitive once more as lenders clamour for business and look to end the year in positive fashion.
zh: Simplified Chinese：安德鲁·蒙特莱克（Andrew Montlake）Coreco Mortgage Brokers的总裁说：“最近的交换率下跌，使得房贷市场再次变得更加竞争性，借款人 clamour for business 和希望在年底结束时保持积极的面貌。

en: The market looks particularly good for those who may be coming to the end of their existing deals as re-mortgages, many with fee-free options as well as low rates, become ever more popular."
zh: Simplified Chinese：市场对于那些即将结束现有合同的个人来说，特别具有吸引力。许多人都在寻找无息贷款和低利率的选项。

en: China Earthquake Networks Center officially determined that a magnitude 8.0 earthquake struck New Zealand on November 13 at 19:02 (42.53 degrees south latitude, 173.05 degrees east longitude), with the epicenter 10km deep. Powerful tremors were felt in the capital, Wellington.
zh: 新西兰于11月13日下午19:02发生了8.0级地震，根据中国地震网络中心的测定，地震深度约为10千米。

en: NHS to prescribe controversial HIV drug to 10,000
zh: Simplified Chinese：NHS将开处一种争议性HIV药物给10,000人。

en: Patients will be able to access a 'transformative' HIV prevention treatment from September following a High Court battle over funding the drug on the NHS.
zh: Simplified Chinese：患者将于9月开始在高 court 的纠纷中获得一种“转变性的”HIV预防治疗。

en: NHS England announced that pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), a pill taken before sex which has been shown to reduce the risk of infection in high-risk individuals by around 86 per cent, will now be provided by the health service through an initial three-year trial to an estimated 10,000 people.
zh: 英国国民保健服务宣布，预防性接触前治疗（PrEP），一种在性行为之前服用的药片，已经证明可以降低高风险人群感染的风险大约86%，将通过初期三年试验向估计10,000人的健康服务提供。

en: It agreed to fund the trial after the Court of Appeal upheld a High Court ruling last year, which said the NHS had the power to pay for PrEP despite its claims that local authorities should fund it.
zh: Simplified Chinese：法院上诉庭在去年确认了高级法院的判决，该判决认为国家卫生服务（NHS）有权支付普里P（PrEP），尽管它声称当局应该承担资金责任。

en: The move announced on Thursday was hailed as a 'major new intervention' by NHS England chief executive Simon Stevens while the National Aids Trust (NAT) described it as a 'pivotal moment'.
zh: 在周四宣布的这一措施被英国国家卫生健康服务（NHS）英格兰总裁西蒙·斯蒂文斯（Simon Stevens） hail 为“重大新干预”，而国家艾滋病基金会（National Aids Trust，NAT）则将其描述为“关键时刻”。

en: Sexual health clinics in London, Brighton, Manchester, Liverpool and Sheffield will be among the first to start enrolling people, with more clinics joining in October before full implementation across England by April 2018.
zh: Simplified Chinese：伦敦、布莱顿、曼彻斯特、利物浦和谢菲尔德的性健康诊所将是首批开始招募患者的诊所，10月份还会有更多诊所加入，而到2018年4月 England 全面实施之前。

en: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is a course of HIV drugs taken before sex to reduce the risk of getting HIV.
zh: Simplified Chinese：预防性接触前治疗（Pre-exposure prophylaxis，简称 PrEP）是指在性行为之前服用HIV药物，以降低感染HIV的风险。

en: Trials have shown PrEP significantly reduces HIV transmission among those at-risk of infection.
zh: Simplified Chinese：试验结果显示，普雷普（PrEP）能够显著降低HIV感染风险人群中HIV传播率。

en: Taking PrEP before sex means there is just enough of certain drugs in a person's body to prevent an HIV infection taking hold.
zh: 接触前预防药物（PrEP）意味着在性行为之前，人体内就有足够的某些药物来阻止HIV感染。

en: Such drugs can be taken every day or as soon as two hours before having sex.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这些药物可以每天服用，也可以两小时前就服用。

en: Those eligible for the treatment include gay or bisexual men, transgender people and those with HIV-positive partners who are not successfully receiving treatment.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那些接受治疗的对象包括gay或bisexual男性、同性恋者和HIV阳性伴侣，但这些人没有成功接受治疗。

en: Clinics will identify eligible participants who consent to the trial, including men, women, transgender people, and individuals who have a partner whose HIV status is not known to be controlled by anti-retroviral treatment.
zh: Simplified Chinese：临床试验将识别出同意参加试验的参与者，包括男性、女性、跨性别人士以及那些与HIV病毒状态不明确控制的伴侣。

en: People living and registered with a GP in England will also be able to enrol for potential participation at their local participating sexual health clinic.
zh: Simplified Chinese：英国住在并注册于GP的患者，也可以参加当地性健康诊所的潜在参与。

en: The programme will cost £10 million and NHS England signed a contract to source the drugs this week following an international competitive procurement.
zh: Simplified Chinese：该项目的预算为10万英镑，英国国家卫生与护理服务局（NHS England）本周签署了合同来采购这些药物。
