en: The trial is designed to assess the full potential of PrEP by gathering clinical evidence on how it is targeted, taken up, and implemented on a large scale.
zh: Simplified Chinese：该审判旨在评估普EP的全面潜力，通过收集其针对性、接纳率和大规模实施的临床证据。

en: Mr Stevens said: 'This major new intervention should complement and supercharge the wide-ranging and increasingly successful effort to prevent HIV.
zh: Simplified Chinese：斯蒂文斯说：“这项重大新干预应该与预防HIV的广泛且不断成功的努力相协同和加强。

en: It's another milestone in more than three decades' worth of progress in tackling one of humanity's major health challenges.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是解决人类之一重大健康挑战的进步超过三十年的里程碑。

en: Deborah Gold, chief executive at NAT (National Aids Trust), said: 'This is a pivotal moment in the fight against HIV.
zh: Simplified Chinese：道布拉·金（Deborah Gold），国家艾滋病基金会（NAT）首席执行官说：“这是对抗HIV的关键时刻。

en: PrEP, if targeted properly at those in need and at risk, offers the possibility of transforming the English HIV epidemic.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果针对那些需要和风险人群，普EP可以转变英国的HIV流行。

en: From September, people at high risk of HIV will have access via this NHS-funded trial in England to an empowering new tool that is truly individually controlled and not subject to negotiation with a partner, leading to the improvement of many, many lives.
zh: Simplified Chinese：从9月开始，高风险人群将通过在英国的这个NHS资助试验中获得一个真正个性化的工具，这种工具不受伴侣谈判而控制，从而改善了许多人的生活。

en: We warmly welcome this announcement.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们热烈欢迎这一ประกาศ。

en: Ian Green, chief executive of the Terrence Higgins Trust, said: 'The priority must now be to make sure that the trial is rolled out speedily across the country, and that no-one at risk of HIV is left behind.
zh:
Simplfied Chinese:
Ian Green，Terrence Higgins Trust首席执行官说：“现在的优先事项是确保该试验在全国范围内迅速展开，并且不让任何可能感染HIV的人被遗漏。

en: Now that the PrEP trial drug has been procured, we're well on the way to protecting over 10,000 people at risk of HIV.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：现在，普雷P试验药物已经获得了供应，我们正好在保护超过10,000名可能感染HIV的人身上取得了很大的进展。

en: Shadow public health minister Sharon Hodgson said: 'The start of the PrEP trial is welcome and long overdue after months of delays and heel-dragging by the Government.
zh: Simplified Chinese：shadow卫生部长莎罗·霍奇森（Sharon Hodgson）说：“普雷普试验的开始是值得欢迎的，已经过了太多时间，政府拖延和拖延的行为也让人们感到沮丧。”

en: The evidence shows just how transformative this drug can be as part of our approach to HIV prevention and ending the transmission of this life-changing infection.
zh: Simplified Chinese：证据表明，这种药物在我们的HIV预防和终止传播的方法中可以扮演的转变性是多么巨大的。

en: This trial will take us one step closer to fully understanding the benefits of PrEP.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这次审判将使我们一步接近完全了解普EP的益处。

en: Now it is important that this trial is rolled out as quickly as possible across the country to protect individuals who are exposed to HIV and help take us one step closer to ending the spread of HIV in society.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：现在，为了保护因HIV感染而暴露的个人，并帮助我们一步步接近消除HIV在社会中的传播，我们必须尽快将这个试验推广到整个国家。

en: In 2015, for the purpose of technological collaboration or acquisition, Hou Weigui led a team to inspect many auto plants.
zh: Simplified Chinese：2015年，为了促进技术合作或收购，霍维桂领导了一支团队对多家汽车厂进行了检查。

en: Living the high life: mezzanine floor and clever design tricks have transformed this small Earls Court flat into a spacious home
zh: Simplified Chinese：生活在高端：楼梯间和聪明的设计技巧使这个小的爱尔兰公园房子变成了宽敞的家

en: Joanne Leigh, a former banker with a passion for doing up property, downsized from a large home in Knightsbridge to an Earls Court apartment in 2014.
zh: 乔安娜·莱赫是一位退休银行家，热爱改造房产的女性，她于2014年从伦敦的金士桥大宅转移到埃尔斯科特公寓。

en: It is on the first floor of a smart Queen Anne terrace - and it is a testament to the new design that Joanne hasn't packed her bags and sold on.
zh: Simplified Chinese：它位于一栋智慧的QUEEN ANNE地板房 - 且这新设计的体现是乔安娜还没打算离开，卖掉她的行李。

en: "Before this, I was living with my ex in Knightsbridge in a much bigger space," Joanne says.
zh: Simplified Chinese：之前我和前夫住在肯特布里奇，一个比现在的空间大得多。

en: "I was looking for something that was comparable for my price.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我在寻找一个与我的价格相匹配的东西。

en: I was shown this apartment in Earls Court and it had the same high ceilings.
zh: 我在埃尔斯科特的公寓中被展示，这个公寓有相同的高 ceilings。

en: I fell in love with it and put an offer in that day."
zh: Simplified Chinese：我爱上它，于当天就向它提出了offer。

en: Since the first viewing, the 1,000sq ft flat has had a complete overhaul.
zh: Simplified Chinese：自从第一次看过，1000平方英尺的公寓已经进行了全面改造。

en: Originally a one-bedroom property with a convoluted layout - you had to walk through the kitchen to get to the bedroom - Joanne wanted to add storage space and a mezzanine to make the most of the generous ceiling height.
zh: originally是一套一间卧室的房子，布局复杂——你必须通过厨房才能到达卧室——乔安娜希望在高 ceilings 的优势上加上储存空间和半层。

en: "I wanted high ceilings, big windows, lots of light.
zh: 我想要高 ceilings，大窗户，充满光线。

en: That was my requirement," she says.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那就是我的要求，”她说。

en: To this end, she employed Erfan Azadi of Notting Hill-based architecture and design studio Duck & Shed to exploit the 12.5ft ceilings and create a home that wasn't only a development but a place for Joanne to live.
zh: 为了实现这一点，她雇用了位于伦敦诺丁汉的建筑设计工作室Duck & Shed的Erfan Azadi，利用12.5英尺高 ceilings创造出一个不是仅仅是一个发展项目，而是Joanne居住的地方。

en: The ceiling wasn't quite tall enough to add two spaces on top of each other so the architectural challenge was to create a mezzanine that you could stand up in.
zh: Simplified Chinese：天花板并不是足够高的，不能在每个地方都添加两个空格，所以建筑挑战是设计一个可以让你站起来的半层。

en: Erfan had to think creatively to resolve the brief.
zh: Simplified Chinese：Erfan必须想得很创造性来解决这个任务。

en: "The steelwork is quite complicated," he explains.
zh: Simplified Chinese：钢筋工作确实很复杂，他解释说。

en: "We had to arrange the spaces so that they stacked on top of each other without needing to hunch down.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们必须排列空间，使它们可以堆积在一起，而不需要弯腰。

en: It wasn't just building a simple platform, but cranking the steels so that they were at the right height for the function above or below."
zh: Simplified Chinese：仅仅是建立一个简单的平台，而是调整钢材，使其达到适合上方或下方功能的高度。

en: This arrangement allowed Erfan to get two full-height rooms on top of each other in the space - with lots of added drama.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这种安排使得埃尔法恩能够在空间中获得两个相邻的高 ceilings 房间，具有大量的戏剧效果。

en: For the mezzanine, a vintage copper light window from Retrouvius looks down over the glamorous living area below.
zh: 对于半台阶，来自Retrouvius的旧式铜制窗户下方俯视着奢华的生活区域。

en: Mirrored gold furniture, silver accents and vintage Serge Mouille lighting all set the style for the scheme.
zh: 反映金色家具，银饰和古典塞吉·莫伊尔（Serge Mouille）照明都为该方案设定了风格。

en: The use of mirrors plays a part in adding theatre, space and light.
zh: Simplified Chinese：镜子的使用在于增添戏剧、空间和光线。

en: A short corridor is mirrored at both ends to make it appear longer.
zh: Simplified Chinese：短 corridors两端都有镜子，目的是让它看起来更长。

en: In the kitchen, the mirrored splashback feels like a window to another room.
zh: 在厨房里，镜面反射的splashback感觉像是一个窗口，进入另一个房间。

en: At the entrance, mirrored units provide storage for all Joanne's cutlery and glassware.
zh: 在入口处，反射镜单位提供了所有乔安的刀具和玻璃器皿的存储空间。

en: Giving the perception of a more glamorous space, the beauty of the living room is being able to close off the kitchen when it's not in use.
zh: Simplified Chinese：让我们为更奢华的空间感受而设想，居住室的美丽在于能够关闭厨房，当它不在使用时。

en: Foldaway kitchens are nothing new.
zh: Simplified Chinese：折叠式厨房并不是什么新鲜事物。

en: What's unique about this one is that it's a garage-style lift-up door.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是一个独特之处，即它是一个车库样式的开门方式。

en: "A bit of engineering went into that," explains Erfan of the steel-reinforced, veneered MDF door.
zh: 一些工程原理就被运用到了那个钢筋加强的、涂层覆盖的MDF门。

en: "It's counter-weighted so that when you push the door up, it glides really easily."
zh: Simplified Chinese：它是平衡的，以至于当你推开门时，它会轻松地滑动。

en: Thanks to clever use of space and storage, Joanne gained an additional 16sq m, an extra bedroom and an improved layout.
zh: Simplified Chinese： thanks to clever use of space and storage，joanne gained an additional 16sq m, an extra bedroom and an improved layout。

en: "At the end of the day, floor space is what you are going to sell - or how your property is valued," Erfan says.
zh: 当天底的时候，地板面积才是你要卖的东西——或者你的房产价值。

en: "In a rudimentary form, a real estate agent will walk in and do a calculation based on floor size."
zh: 在一种简单的形式下，房地产中介人会走进去，并根据楼层面积进行计算。

en: Here they have managed to increase the floor space while using quality materials that give the space its luxurious edge.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们在这里 successfully 增加了地板面积，同时使用高质量的材料，使得空间具有奢华感。

en: "The materials are the things that you touch and therefore help to create an emotional bond in a home," says Erfan.
zh: 物质是你触摸的东西，它们帮助在家中建立情感联系，埃尔法恩说。

en: "You don't fall in love with the electrical feeds in the walls.
zh: Simplified Chinese：你不会因为电线在墙壁上的接线而爱上它们。

en: These are important but they don't pull the heart strings."
zh: Simplified Chinese：这些很重要，但它们不会拉动心脏strings。

en: It goes to show that through good design and increased square metreage, a flat can turn from something standard into something quite amazing.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这表明通过良好的设计和增加的平方米面积，一个平房可以从标准化的东西转变成非常惊人的东西。

en: In fact, like Joanne, you may choose not to leave.
zh: Simplified Chinese：实际上，就像约安，你可能会选择不离开。

en: About a year ago, this Facebook CEO indicated that he wanted to develop an AI system , and has made it his annual personal challenge.
zh: Simplified Chinese：大约一年前，这位Facebook首席执行官表示他想要开发一个AI系统，并将其作为每年的个人挑战。

en: In the history of the Grammy Awards, Beyoncé and Adele are the two female singers who have won the most Grammy Awards in a single year.
zh: Simplified Chinese： Grammy奖的历史中，贝克莱和阿德尔是获得最多格拉米奖的女性歌手。

en: It is understood that the 59th Grammy Awards will be held on February 12, 2017 US local time (morning of February 13, Beijing time), and will be hosted by British comedian James Corden.
zh: 59届格拉米奖将于2017年2月12日（美国当地时间上午）举行，主持人为英国喜剧演员詹姆斯·科登。

en: As telecommunication technology is upgraded and updated, operators require massive website resources when building new networks.
zh: Simplified Chinese：随着通信技术的更新和升级，运营商需要大量网站资源来建造新网络。

en: On May 15, Gao Jianmin, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Executive Vice Governor, surveyed Shanxi Provincial Guoxin Energy Development Group in respect of the company’s work in accelerating the integrated management of the gasification of Shanxi and coalbed methane resources/
zh: 15日，省党委常务委员会委员、副行政府主管官员高建民对公司加快山西气化和煤床天然气资源整合管理工作进行了调查。

en: The Ministry of Land and Resources as well as other relevant departments must take the initiative to serve, consider the overall situation associated with the structural transformation and integrated reform experimental zone program, and actively strive for policy support from the State.
zh: 国土资源部以及其他相关部门必须采取主动措施服务，考虑到结构转型和整合改革试验区方案所关联的整体情况，并积极争取国家政策支持。

en: July 26 news: On July 22, reporters learned from Hongqiao District that the upgrading project of the city’s largest downtown riverside linear park has been completed, and the park will be opened to the public free of charge.
zh: 七月二十六新闻：七月二十二日，记者从香港区了解到市中心最大的一条河畔线性公园的升级项目已经完成，公园将免费对外开放。

en: The entire landscaped zone leveraged the existing natural ecology as well as the strengths of historical and cultural resources, and re-planning as well as upgrading and transformation was carried out on both banks of the South Grand Canal. Five riverside scenic spots along the river were created, namely, “Emperor Yongle’s Ferry Crossing Heritage Park”, “Wellington Plaza”, “Xintiandi Folk Street”, “Tianjin West Railway Station Gallery” and “Shuixi Artistic Heritage Green Corridor”.
zh: 整个景观区利用现有的自然生态系统以及历史文化资源的优势，进行了整体规划、升级和转型，并在南大 canal两岸实施了重新规划、提升和转型。五条河边风景区分别是“永乐帝王渡口遗址公园”、“威尔斯广场”、“新天地民俗街”、“天津西铁路站画廊”和“水秀艺术遗产绿色通道”。

en: Plastic paved pathways of approximately 1,500 meters with distance markers have been built in the green open space on both sides of the river bank between Jinhua Bridge and Xinsantiao Stone Bridge.
zh: 在两座桥梁之间的河bank上，建造了大约1500米长的塑料路面，并且在两侧都有距离标志。

en: In addition to the flowers, plants and trees planted on both sides of the pathway, a children’s playground has been constructed, embellished with various groups of small sculptures.
zh: Simplified Chinese：除了花卉和树木在通道两边种植外，还建造了一个儿童 Playground，装饰有各种小雕塑组。

en: As you walk along, you will see benches, paved pathways, bridges, riverside decks, sand pits for children to play in, and other amenities. These help integrate the green landscape and water sights into one, offering residents another place for leisure, fitness and entertainment.
zh: Simplified Chinese：随着您步行，您会看到 benches、铺路石的通道、桥梁、河边平台、儿童 Playground sand pit、以及其他设施。这些设施有助于将绿色景观和水景融入一个整体中，提供居民另一个放松、锻炼和娱乐的场所。

en: Yesterday, a list of 23 players to participate in the China Cup was released by Chinese national coach Lippi, and caused great controversy in the society.
zh: 昨天，中国国家队教练利皮发布了参加中国杯的23名球员名单，引发了广泛的争议。

en: How to deal with China’s renewable energy vehicle “subsidy fraud” has become a matter of serious concern for the public and even the international automobile industry community after the case was exposed in January this year. The State Council has attached great importance to this issue, and has requested rigorous investigation into such fraudulent conduct.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如何处理中国新能源汽车“补贴欺诈”问题已经成为公众和国际汽车行业的严重关注点，尤其是在今年一月份这一案件被揭露后。国务院高度关注这个问题，并要求对此类欺诈行为进行严格调查。

en: A reason for poor electric vehicle sales is inadequate promotional effort for these products.
zh: 电动汽车的Poor销售原因之一是这些产品的推广力不足。

en: According to the latest national fitness survey bulletin issued in 2014, the number of exercisers has increased by nearly 8 percent points compared with 2007.
zh: 根据2014年发布的最新国家健康 surveillanace通报，近八年来人群体能量活动增加了近80%。

en: Brothers fight over $500 million property empire
zh: Simplified Chinese：兄弟们为5000万美元的财产帝国而争斗。

en: Two brothers are at war over one of Victoria's biggest real estate empires, worth more than $500 million, four decades after their Italian family founded the dynasty.
zh: 两兄弟四十多年来在维多利亚的最大房地产帝国中展开了战争，这个帝国价值超过5 亿美元。

en: Former Carlton Football Club director and developer Colin De Lutis lives in a Toorak mansion three doors from younger brother Paul, who has taken him to the Supreme Court over how their property and business assets will be sliced up.
zh: 前卡尔顿足球俱乐部的董事会成员和开发商科林·德鲁蒂斯住在托拉克大宅，离他的年轻兄弟保罗三间房子。保罗曾将他们的财产和业务资产分割问题带到最高法院。

en: Paul has wanted out of the family business since 2014 but an acrimonious argument is playing out in the Supreme Court over the break-up.
zh: paul从2014年就想离开家族企业，但在最高法院关于分离的争论中，气氛却变得非常恶劣。

en: Together with their mother Anna the brothers own 38 properties worth more than half a billion dollars, amassed since the family bought a Smith Street, Collingwood, shop in 1973.
zh: Simplified Chinese：与母亲安娜一起，兄弟们拥有38处价值超过50亿美元的财产，从1973年家族购买了Collingwood的一家smith街店开始。

en: There, the family founded Westco Jeans and grew it into a chain of 160 retail outlets.
zh: 那里，家族创立了西科珍斯（Westco Jeans），并将其发展成一家160家零售店的连锁。

en: It sold in 1999 for $85 million.
zh: Simplified Chinese：1999年出售价为85万美元。

en: That money was sunk into property and the De Lutis portfolio now includes city offices, Brunswick and Sorrento development sites, Gold Coast and Mt Buller apartments, and suburban shopping centres.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那笔钱都被投入房地产和德鲁蒂斯投资组合中，现在的德鲁蒂斯投资组合包括市政办公楼、布伦瑞克和索伦托开发项目、金海岸和Mt Buller公寓以及郊外购物中心。

en: Under an agreement with their late father, Colin - described by Paul as "the major driving force and the dominant personality" in the De Lutis family - owns about two-thirds of the company assets and Paul about one-third.
zh: 根据他们的晚父的协议，科林（Paul描述为“公司主要动力和主导人格”的）拥有大约两分之三的公司资产，而保罗拥有大约一分之三。

en: A court filing says this translates to Colin owning property worth $316 million and Paul $176 million.
zh: 法院的文件表明，科林拥有的财产价值约为3.16亿美元，而保罗的财产价值约为1.76亿美元。

en: Dividing the properties and cash has proved the sticking point for Paul.
zh: Simplified Chinese：分割财产和现金是保罗的绊住脚石。

en: "The splits proposed by Colin left him with what I considered to be the best properties," he wrote in an initial court affidavit in 2015.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他在2015年的初步法庭证词中写道：“科林提出的分歧使他获得了我认为是最好的财产。”

en: Last Friday, after several failed mediations, the first Supreme Court hearing was held.
zh: 上周五，经过多次谈判失败后，首次最高法院听证会举行。

en: The brothers are also now fighting over who controls the existing business - which Paul alleges Colin has locked him out of.
zh: Simplified Chinese：兄弟们现在还在争论谁控制着现有的业务——保罗声称科林阻止了他进入。

en: Colin argues this is not true, but accuses Paul of incompetently managing some properties.
zh: Simplified Chinese：科林认为这不是事实，但指责保尔不负责任地管理一些财产。

en: In an early affidavit filed by Colin, he says he hopes to resolve the dispute.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在一份早期的承诺书中，科林说他希望解决这一争端。

en: "My Italian heritage dictates that family is the most important priority," he wrote.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我的意大利血统使我认为家庭是最重要的优先事项。

en: Costs are mounting in the case, with hundreds of pages of affidavits, emails and reports by companies including Deloitte, Pitcher Partners and Charter Keck Cramer filed and top barristers including Allan Myers, QC, and senior solicitors retained by both sides.
zh: Simplified Chinese：案件中，诉讼费用不断增加，包括 hundreds of pages 的 affidavit、email 和公司报告，包括 Deloitte、Pitcher Partners 和 Charter Keck Cramer 等公司的文件，以及 top barristers including Allan Myers, QC, 和 senior solicitors 由双方都保留。

en: Ms De Lutis and her late husband Luigi were Italian immigrants who ran milk bars and delicatessens from the late 1950s and in the early 1970s bought a shop in Brunswick.
zh: Ms De Lutis 和她去世的丈夫路易吉是意大利移民，他们从 1950 年后半期开始经营牛奶店和小吃店，直到 1970 年初在布兰斯维克购买了一家商店。

en: They used the collateral to buy the Collingwood property where Colin opened the family's first jeans store.
zh: 他们利用抵押物购买了科林开设家族第一家 Jeans店的科林伍德地产。

en: Colin says he started Westco there when he was "in my final years of high school, when Paul was a young child (around 10 years old)."
zh: Simplified Chinese：科林说他在“我的最后一学年高中时期”开始了西科，Paul是小孩（大约10岁）。

en: Anna De Lutis says she and Luigi, who died in 2012, hoped to pass down their properties to their sons amicably.
zh: 安娜·德·路蒂斯说，她和去年死于2012年的路易吉希望以友好的方式将其财产传给他们的儿子。

en: "Luigi often said to me that he never wanted the brothers to end up in court," she wrote.
zh: Simplified Chinese：路易吉经常对我说，他从不希望兄弟们会被送到法庭，（她写道）

en: Two other brothers, Mark and Luke, are no longer part of the De Lutis group of companies, with Colin saying that Mark was paid $10 million when he left the business, and Luke $26 million.
zh: Simplified Chinese：另外两个兄弟马克和路克不再是德鲁蒂斯集团公司的一部分，科林说马克离开时获得了10万美元的报酬，而路克获得了2600万美元。

en: Both Luke and Mark had become, Paul says, "bitter about the terms of their financial separation."
zh: Simplified Chinese：两位路克和马克都变得，保罗说，他们“对财务分离的条款感到苦恼”。

en: Colin has kept a low profile despite being a former AFL club board member and, according to a 2015 biography of Eddie McGuire, the television star's best friend.
zh: Simplified Chinese：科林在成为前澳大利亚足球俱乐部董事会成员后仍保持低调。根据2015年埃迪·麦基尔的传记，电视明星的最佳朋友。

en: Fairfax Media contacted Colin and Paul De Lutis on Friday, and their lawyers.
zh: Simplified Chinese：法媒 Fairfax Media 在周五联系了科林和保罗·德鲁蒂斯的律师。

en: Only Colin replied, by text message, to say that because the case was before the courts "I really cannot say much."
zh: Simplified Chinese：只有科林回复了，通过短信告诉我，因为案件在法院前，“我真的说不多。”

en: "It's very, very sad that my brother Paul has chosen to sue me and drag our family name through the courts," he wrote.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我很,很伤心，我的兄弟保尔（Paul）决定对我起诉，并把我们的家族名声拖到法庭里。

en: In mid-2016, Colin wrote in one court filing that he had tried to accommodate his brother's requests.
zh: 在2016年中期，科林在一份法院诉讼中写道，他已经尝试 accommodating his brother的要求。

en: "Our father would not have wanted to see Paul and I end up in our current dispute," he said, adding that he was "still hopeful of resolution."
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们的父亲不会让我们和保尔现在的分歧使他失望，他说：“我仍然保持着解决问题的希望。”

en: On Friday, that hope appeared gone.
zh: 星期五，那个希望消失了。

en: "Our matter will be resolved by the courts in the near future," Colin wrote.
zh: 我们的问题很快就会在法院解决。

en: Li Keqiang held a ceremony to welcome Russian President's visit to China.
zh: 李克强举行了迎接俄罗斯总统来访的仪式。

en: Li Keqiang and Russian Prime Minister jointly chaired the 22nd regular meeting between the Premier of China and the Prime Minister of Russia
zh: 李克强和俄罗斯总理共同主持了中俄首相之间的第22次定期会议。

en: Met reporters together and attended the closing ceremony of the China-Russia Year of Media Exchange.
zh: 与记者一起出席，参加了中国与俄罗斯媒体交流年终 Closing Ceremony。

en: The 12th National People’s Congress held the third plenary session of the 30th meeting.
zh: 第十二届全国人大第三次全体会议。

en: Zhang Dejiang presents a report on checking the implementation status of the Law on the Prevention and Control of Environmental Pollution Resulting From Solid Waste.
zh: 张德江出席了关于环境污染的报告。

en: Zhang Dejiang met with the President of Russia.
zh: Simplified Chinese：张德江与俄罗斯总统会面。

en: The closing ceremony of the 23nd meeting of the Standing Committee of the 12th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.
zh: 中国人民政治Consultative会议第12届常务委员会第23次会议闭幕式。

en: Yu Zhengsheng chaired the meeting and gave an address.
zh: Simplified Chinese： Yu Zhengsheng 主持会议并发表演讲。

en: Zhang Gaoli, Wang Yang and Liu Yandong accepted Russia’s Order of Friendship award.
zh: 张国良、王阳和刘延东接受了俄罗斯友谊勋章。

en: Wang Yang met with Sri Lanka’s Minister of Foreign Affairs.
zh: 王阳与斯里兰卡外交部长会面。

en: Wang Huning requested at the Mobilization Meeting of the Central Propaganda Group for studying and implementing the spirit of the 19th CPC National Congress spirit
zh: 王鸿宁在中共中央宣传部动员会议上要求学习和实施第十九次党代会精神。

en: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Russian Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev at Diaoyutai State Guesthouse on November 1.
zh: 中国主席习近平于11月1日在朝阳宫与俄罗斯总理德米特里·梅德韦耶夫会面。

en: Xi Jinping expressed his welcome for Medvedev's immediate visit to China following the perfect conclusion of the 19th CPC National Congress, stressing that Russia is China’s biggest neighbor
zh: xià jīn píng gào xǐ huān mè dú bèi de jiē shì yī zhōng guó lùò yǔ chá fāng biàn, qīng chéng rú nǎi zhōng guó de zuì dà lì lún

en: and strategic cooperation partner.
zh: Simplified Chinese：战略伙伴

en: China's clear goal and firm determination to develop and deepen the China-Russia relations will not change.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国的明确目标和坚定不移的决心发展和深化中俄关系不会改变。

en: China is willing to work with Russia towards expanding mutual cooperation in all fields and all rounds, and deepening mutual coordination in international affairs,
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国愿意与俄罗斯在所有领域和所有阶段进行合作，深化国际事务中的互相协调。

en: Advance the formation of a common destiny for humanity
zh: Simplified Chinese：推进人类共同的命运

en: The strategic partnership between China and Russia will usher in a new opportunity, create a new image and achieve new results based on the new starting point.
zh: 中国与俄罗斯的战略合作将带来新的机会，创造新形象并实现基于新起点的新成果。

en: Xi Jinping pointed out that China and Russia should give full play to the coordination role of regular meeting mechanism between the Prime Ministers, strengthen mutual cooperation in energy, equipment manufacturing, agriculture, aerospace, etc.,
zh: Simplified Chinese：习近平指出，中国和俄罗斯应充分发挥常规会议机制的协调作用，增强能源、设备制造业、农业、航空航天等领域的互利合作。

en: continue enhancing the scientific and technological innovation in mutual cooperation, and taking big data, IoT, smart city and other areas of digital economy
zh: Simplified Chinese：继续加强科学技术创新，增进合作与对接，特别是大数据、IoT、智能城市等数字经济领域。

en: as the new growth point of cooperation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：作为合作的新增长点。

en: He also expressed that China and Russia should make concerted efforts to dock the One Belt One Road with the Eurasian Economic Union, promote the landing of projects like coastal international transport corridors, jointly exploit the Arctic shipping routes
zh: Simplified Chinese：他还表示，中国和俄国应该共同努力将“一带一路”与欧亚经济联盟融合起来，促进沿海国际运输通道等项目的落地，共同利用阿尔泰海航线。

en: and Polar Silk Road,
zh: Simplified Chinese：和极地丝路

en: promote local exchanges and cooperation between the two countries, and further consolidate the public opinion foundation of bilateral relations.
zh: Simplified Chinese：促进两国之间的地方交流和合作，进一步巩固双边关系的公众意见基础。

en: Medvedev conveyed Russian President Vladimir Putin's cordial greetings and best wishes to President Xi Jinping, and expressed his warmest congratulations on
zh: 俄罗斯总统普京（维尔迪·穆拉德·普京）向中国主席习近平致warmest祝福和亲切问候，表示对中国的发展充满热情。

en: the successful closing of the 19th CPC National Congress and Xi Jinping’s re-election as the General Secretary the CPC Central Committee.
zh: 19世纪末的中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会闭幕后，习近平再次当选为中共中央总书记。

en: Making more positive progresses in the fields of economy, energy, investment, innovation, humanity, and the fields docking the One Belt One Road and the Eurasian Economic Union.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在经济、能源、投资、创新、人类和与一带一路和欧亚经济联盟相关的领域取得更大的积极进步。

en: Russia is very satisfied with current progresses, and is willing to further strengthen its exchanges and cooperation with China in various fields and strengthen its communication and coordination with China on major global and regional issues.
zh: Simplified Chinese：俄罗斯对当前进展非常满意，并愿意进一步加强其与中国在各个领域的交流和合作，以及与中国在全球主要和地区性问题上的沟通和协调。

en: Ding Xuexiang and Yang Jiechi attended the meeting.
zh: Simplified Chinese：丁小明和杨洁肊出席会议。

en: Afterwards, the premiers of the two countries viewed march-past.
zh: Simplified Chinese：之后，两国首脑出席军事阅兵式。

en: After the welcoming ceremony, the two prime ministers co-chaired the 22th regular meeting between Chinese and Russian prime ministers.
zh: Simplified Chinese：会上接过迎宾仪式后，两位总理共同主持了中国和俄罗斯总理之间的第22次常规会议。

en: Li Keqiang said that China-Russia relations are bearing new fruits under the jointed efforts of President Xi Jinping and President Putin.
zh: Simplified Chinese：李克强表示，中国与俄罗斯关系在习近平和普京总统共同努力下正在成熟。

en: Just successfully concluded the 19th CPC National Congress
zh: Simplified Chinese：仅刚刚结束了第十九届中国共产党全国代表大会。

en: a new CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core, established Xi Jinping's Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the
zh: Simplified Chinese：新一轮的中共中央新一轮，以 comrade xi jinping 为核心，建立了“中国特色社会主义思想”为新时代的基础。

en: guiding ideology that the Party must follow permanently, and defined clearly China’s development goals for the future.
zh: 指导党的根本意识形态，明确了中国未来发展的目标。

en: As the largest developing country in the world, development has always been the foundation and key to solve all problems in China.
zh: 中国是世界上最大的发展中国家，发展始终是解决所有问题的基础和关键。

en: Both China and Russia are taking each other's development as an important opportunity
zh: Simplified Chinese：两国都把对方的发展看作是一个重要的机会。

en: Their efforts to dock development strategies and deepen all-round cooperation will embrace a broader prospect, and also contribute more to the peace and development of the two countries, the whole region and even the world.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们努力在发展策略上进行 docking，深化各方面的合作，将会展开更广泛的视野，并且也将为两国、整个地区和世界的和平与发展做出更大的贡献。

en: Li Keqiang and Medvedev debriefed to the relevant mechanisms of both countries, as well as the work reports presented by Chinese Vice Premiers Zhang Gaoli, Wang Yang and Liu Yandong, and the Russian chairmen.
zh: 李克强和梅德维夫与两国相关机制进行了回顾，中国副总理张高利、王阳和刘延东的工作报告，以及俄罗斯主席。

en: Creating a brighter tomorrow for the relations between the two countries
zh: Simplified Chinese：为两国之间关系创造一个更加明亮的未来

en: Medvedev congratulated the Communist Party of China on its successful convening of the 19th CPC National Congress, saying that Russia is willing to deepen its cooperation with China in the traditional fields such as energy, infrastructure, production capacity, aviation and aerospace,
zh: Simplified Chinese：俄罗斯总统梅德维耶夫（Medvedev）对中国共产党成功召开第19届全国代表大会表示祝贺，并表明俄罗斯愿意在传统领域如能源、基础设施、生产能力、航空航天等方面加深与中国的合作。

en: open up cooperation in emerging areas like e-commerce and small-and- medium enterprises, foster closer the people-to-people exchanges, and push forward the continuous progressing of comprehensive strategic partnership between Russia and China.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在电子商务和中小企业等新兴领域进行合作，促进人与人之间的交流，推动俄中全面战略伙伴关系的持续发展。

en: After the meeting, Li Keqiang and Medvedev signed a Joint Communique of the 22th Meeting of the Chinese and Russian Prime Ministers, and witnessed the signature of nearly 20 documents concerning the bilateral cooperation
zh: 会后，李克强和梅德维德签署了中国和俄罗斯总理第22次会议的联合公报，并 chứng kiến近20份涉及双方合作的文件的签字。

en: on energy investment, local cooperation, humanity, agriculture, customs, quality control, aerospace, finance, etc..
zh: 关于能源投资、地方合作、人性、农业、习俗、质量控制、航空航天、金融等方面。

en: After the signing ceremony, the two prime ministers met with reporters and answered their questions.
zh: 签约仪式后，两位总理与记者会面，并回答了他们的提问。

en: Li Keqiang introduced the outcomes of this meeting, and stressed that China is willing to continue promoting the China-Russia relations and their mutual cooperation in all fields, propelling the establishment of a new international relationship with win-win cooperation as the core
zh: 李克强在会上介绍了会议的结果，并强调中国愿意继续推进中俄关系和两国之间各领域的合作，推动建立新型国际关系，以互利共赢为核心。

en: on the basis of mutual respect, equality, and joint development,
zh: Simplified Chinese：基于相互尊重、平等和共同发展的原则。

en: and creating more growth points on cooperation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：并且创造更多合作点。

en: To achieve this, it would require not only giving full play to the large and strong enterprises of the two countries and strengthening their cooperation on large strategic projects in the fields of energy, aerospace, aviation and cross-border infrastructure, but also making good use of the flexible small-and-medium enterprises and encouraging
zh: 要实现这一点，需要不仅充分发挥两国大型强大的企业的优势，而且加强他们在能源、航空航天和跨境基础设施等领域的大型战略项目合作，还要善用小中型企业的灵活性，鼓励

en: them to open up new areas of cooperation and create an innovation accelerator for pragmatic cooperation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：让他们开启新的合作领域，创立实用合作的创新加速器。

en: That afternoon, Li Keqiang and Medvedev jointly attended the closing ceremony of the China-Russia Media Exchange Year and made a speech,
zh: 那天下午，李克强和梅德韦德夫妇共同出席了中国与俄罗斯媒体交流年终活动，并发表演讲。

en: giving their high appraisal to the positive outcomes and social repercussions achieved in this Media Exchange Year.
zh: Simplified Chinese：对本媒体交流年取得的积极结果和社会影响给予了高评价。

en: Li Keqiang said in his speech that two years ago, the heads of state of China and Russia jointly decided and announced the start of China-Russia Media Exchange Year,
zh: 李克强在演讲中提到，两年前，中国和俄罗斯总统共同决定并宣布启动了中国-俄罗斯媒体交流年。

en: showing that China and Russia, as comprehensive strategic partners, have shared a high degree of mutual trust in politics, a cultural connection on the soul level, as well as an objective and friendly attitude towards each other.
zh: 中国和俄罗斯作为全面战略伙伴，已经共享了高程度的政治信任、文化联系以及对彼此的客观友好态度。

en: building up important bridges and ties. Li Keqiang pointed out that both China and Russia are possessed of long-standing cultural traditions and profound cultural heritages.
zh: 建立重要的桥梁和关系。李克强指出，中国和俄罗斯都有长久的文化传统和深厚的文化遗产。

en: Medias of the two countries also have their own characteristics.
zh: Simplified Chinese：两国媒体各有其独特之处。

en: Thanks to the media exchange year, mutual understanding and friendship between the two countries have been deepened, and mutual learning between the medias have been enhanced,
zh: thanks to the media exchange year，两国之间的理解和友好关系得到了深化，而媒体之间的互学也得到增强。

en: and the media exchange year itself has also become a distinctive move in the history of international medial exchanges.
zh: Simplified Chinese：而媒体之间的交流年份本身也已经成为国际媒体交流史上的一个独特的举措。

en: This closing ceremony is not an end, but a new start, signifying the start of a new chapter in the history of China-Russia media cooperation, and raising a new sail for the people-to-people exchanges.
zh: 这个闭幕式并不是结束，而是一场新开始，标志着中国与俄罗斯媒体合作的历史新篇章的开启，并为人与人之间的交流提出了新的 sails。

en: Pushing forward the China-Russia relations towards a new journey of consolidated friendship between generations
zh: Simplified Chinese：推动中俄关系向新的凝聚友谊之旅

en: Injecting new connotations and creating new opportunities to the relations of the two countries, and fully reflecting the degree of friendship between the two peoples as well as the strategic significance of the bilateral relations.
zh: Simplified Chinese：加强两国关系的新含义和创造新的机会，全面反映两国人民之间的友谊程度以及双方关系的战略意义。

en: On the afternoon of November 1 , the 30th Session of the Standing Committee of the 12th National People's Congress held its third plenary session in the Great Hall of the People, Beijing.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在11月1日下午，中国国民大会第十二届常务委员会第三次全体会议在人民大会堂大厅举行。

en: Chairman Zhang Dejiang attended the meeting
zh: Simplified Chinese：张德江主席出席会议

en: and made a report on the inspected enforcement of the Law of the People’s Republic on the Prevention and Control of Environmental Pollution by Solid Waste (hereinafter, Solid Waste Law).
zh: Simplified Chinese：并且做了关于检查实施人民Republic的环境污染防止和控制法（以下简称废物污染防止和控制法）的报告。

en: In May this year, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress started the inspection of the enforcement of Solid Waste Law.
zh: 在今年五月，国务院常务委员会开始了废除垃圾处理法的检查。

en: Zhang Dejiang reported the inspection results on behalf of the inspection team of law enforcement.
zh: 张德江代表执法队伍的检查团报告了检查结果。

en: He said that since the 18th CPC National Congress, the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core
zh: 他说自从第十八届中共全国代表大会以来，中共中央以 comrade xi jinping 为核心。

en: had conscientiously implemented the legal provisions, and achieved striking progresses in the prevention and control of solid waste.
zh: Simplified Chinese：认真地执行法律规定，并取得了预防和控制固体废物的显著进展。

en: Zhang Dejiang pointed out that according to the inspection results, there were also some outstanding problems in the enforcement of Solid Waste Law as well as the prevention and control of solid waste pollution.
zh: Simplified Chinese：张德江指出，根据检查结果，还存在一些在废物管理法的执行中和防止、控制废物污染方面存在突出的问题。

en: These problems must arouse enough attention.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这些问题必须引起足够的关注。

en: We must conscientiously implement the spirit of the 19th CPC National Congress, completely and accurately implement the Solid Waste Law, further promote the prevention and control of solid waste pollution.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们必须认真地落实第十九届中央委员会的精神，完全准确地实施废物法，进一步促进废物污染的预防和控制。

en: Pushing forward the treatment of industrial solid waste, improving the supervision mechanism of solid waste, and strengthening the scientific and technological support for the prevention and control of solid waste pollution.
zh: Simplified Chinese：推动工业固废物处理，完善固废物监管机制，加强预防和控制固废物污染的科学技术支持。

en: The Minister of Agriculture Han Changfu, under the entrust of the State Council, made a report on grassland ecological environment protection.
zh: 农业部长韩长福，受国务院委托，对草地生态环境保护做了报告。

en: Han Changfu said
zh: Simplified Chinese：韩春福说

en: Continuously raising the level of grassland conservation and construction
zh: Simplified Chinese：不断提高草原保护和建设水平。

en: The meeting heard and examined a report presented by Cao Jianming, the Chief Procurator of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, on comprehensively deepening the judicial reform.
zh: Simplified Chinese：会议听取并审查了高级人民检察院首席检察官曹建明关于全面深化司法改革的报告。

en: After reporting on the current progresses, achievements and problems, Cao Jianming expressed that the next step would be to deepen the comprehensive reform of the judicial system,
zh: 后来，关于当前进展、成就和问题的报道结束后，曹建明表示，下一步将是深化司法系统的全面改革。

en: fully implement the judicial responsibility system, strengthen the policy interpretation and reform propaganda, deepen the research and demonstration, and promote the judicial reform to the depth of development.
zh: 全面实施司法责任制，强化政策解释和改革宣传，深化研究和示范，推动司法改革到发展的深层次。

en: Vice Chairman Chen Zhu presided over the meeting.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国国务院副主席陈柱主持会议。

en: Carrying out in-depth the exchange of experiences and mutual learning concerning the management and governing of the country, and the legislative control, so as to ensure the smooth development of mutual cooperation in the areas docking the One Belt one Road with the Eurasian Economic Union at the legislative level.
zh: 在深入开展关于管理和治理国家、立法控制以及相互学习和交流的经验，确保一带一路与欧洲经济联盟的合作在立法层面上顺畅发展。

en: Strengthening local cooperation and cultural exchanges, and injecting new vitality and momentum to the China-Russia relations.
zh: 加强当地合作和文化交流，加快中国与俄罗斯关系的新动能。

en: Medvedev expressed his congratulations on the successful closing of the 19th CPC National Congress.
zh: 中共19届全国代表大会闭幕成功，俄罗斯总统梅德维耶夫表示祝贺。

en: The Russia-China relations have been progressing very smoothly and made enumerable great achievements.
zh: Simplified Chinese：俄中关系在非常顺利地发展，取得了许多可数的成就。

en: Russia is willing to work with China and push the bilateral relations to a higher level.
zh: Simplified Chinese：俄罗斯愿意与中国合作，推动双方关系到更高的水平。

en: Wang Chen attended the meeting.
zh: Simplified Chinese：王晨参加了会议。

en: In the afternoon of October 31th, Medvedev laid a wreath at the Monument to the People’s Heroes.
zh: 在10月31日下午，梅德韦德夫妇为人民英雄纪念碑献上了花圈。

en: The meeting pledged full support to the report delivered by Comrade Xi Jinping on behalf of the 18th CPC Central Committee.
zh: 我们在这里要强调，自由建制派的恐惧并非出于对特朗普和英国退欧的担忧，而是出于对这种运动的恐惧。

en: Participants hold a strong conviction that the new CPC leadership will live up to the great trust place on and the lofty mission assigned to it and navigate the giant ship bearing the great dream of the Chinese people to a bright future. Attendees agreed that the 19th CPC National Congress is a meeting of great importance taking place during the decisive stage in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and the development of socialism with Chinese characteristics.
zh: 参加者坚信新一代 CPC 领导人将承担起大国之trust，实现中国人民的伟大梦想，带领大家航行在巨大的船上。会员认为19世纪 CPC 全会是建成一个相对富足的社会和发展社会主义与中国特色的关键时期。

en: The report delivered by General Secretary Xi Jinping is a programmatic document radiating the brilliance of Marxism, which puts forth a series of important thoughts, ideas, judgements and measures.
zh: 中共中央总书记习近平的报告是一份具有程序性的文件，充满了马克思主义光辉，它提出了一系列重要思想、观点和措施。

en: There was a consensus among attendees that the political priority of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference at present and in the years to come is to comprehensively study, propagandize and implement the essence of the 19th CPC National Congress.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在会上，参加者普遍认为，中国人民政治Consultative会议当前和未来几年主要的政治重点是全面研究、宣传和实施第十九届中央委员会的核心。

en: Firstly, it is necessary to digest Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and continuously consolidate the common political and ideological basis for unity and struggle.
zh: 首先，必须深入学习和领会习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想，并不断巩固共产党人同一路线上的一致性政治基础和意识形态基础。

en: Secondly, it is necessary to unite and lead the CPPCC members to unswervingly carry out the Party’s basic theories, guidelines and policies.
zh: Simplified Chinese：其次，必须团结并领导CPPCC成员坚决落实党的基本理论、指导方针和政策。

en: Thirdly, it is necessary to focus on the central tasks of the Party and state and contribute ideas and efforts to the victory of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects.
zh: Simplified Chinese：第三，必须集中精力于党和国家的核心任务，并为在所有方面建成富裕稳定的社会而献出思想和努力。

en: Fourthly, it is necessary to give full play to CPPCC’s role as an important channel of consultative democracy and a specialized organization of consultation, implementing consultative democracy throughout the process of performing duties and into all aspects of work.
zh: 第四，必须充分发挥CPPCC的作用作为一个重要的咨询民主渠道和专门组织的咨询机构，实施咨询民主在履行职责过程中以及工作各个方面。

en: Fifthly, it is necessary to fully exploit the power of CPPCC as a united front organization that enables it to mobilize the Chinese nation to fulfill the Chinese dream.
zh: Simplified Chinese：最后，必须充分利用CPPCC作为一个统一阵线的力量，使其能够动员中国人民实现中国梦。

en: Sixthly, it is necessary to reinforce CPPCC’s self-construction with an emphasis on beefing up its competence in performing duties, improve the duty-performing system, and enhance the duty-performing efficiency.
zh: Simplified Chinese：最后，必须加强CPPCC的自我建设，强化其履行职责能力，改进履行职责制度，提高履行职责效率。

en: The meeting adopted the Resolution on Studying
zh: Simplified Chinese：会议通过了关于研究的决议。

en: and Implementing the Essence of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China as well as the Decision on Partial Revision of the Constitution of the Chinese people’s Political Consultative Conference.
zh: 和实施中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会的精神以及中国人民政治Consultative会议宪法部分修订的决定。

en: The meeting asked to summarize well the work of CPPCC and prepare well for the first session of 13th CPPCC National Committee.
zh: 会议要求对CPPCC的工作进行全面总结，并准备好第13届CPPCC全国委员会的第一次会议。

en: On November 1th, Zhang Gaoli, Vice Premier of the State Council, Wang Yang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, and Liu Yandong, Vice Premier of the State Council received the Order of Friendship from Premier Medvedev on behalf of the Russian government at the Great Hall of the People.

zh: Simplified Chinese：有关安全工作的情况怎么样？

en: What are the practical difficulties?
zh: Simplified Chinese：什么是实际上的困难？

en: Xi Jinping asked many details.
zh: 习近平问了很多细节。

en: How do you feel about such routine trainings for combat teams?
zh: Simplified Chinese：你对这种常规训练对战斗团队的感觉是什么？

en: I’d like to report to the Commander that we will always be ready for war, and the aircraft-warning radar and sea-warning radar will be available on a 7*24 basis in order to keep a close eye on the sky and sea and allow us to formulate improved response solutions.
zh: 我想向指挥官报告，我们总是准备好打战，空中警觉雷达和海上警觉雷达在24小时基础上保持清晰的监视，以便密切关注天空和海面，并能够制定出更好的应对方案。

en: Trainings and drills in various aspects such as fighting back and patrol inspection were organized on a regular basis.
zh: 训练和演习在各种方面，如反击和巡逻检查，按照规律进行。

en: Xi Jinping urged them to exercise vigilance and be ready for responding to any emergency.
zh: 习近平要求他们保持警惕，准备应对任何紧急情况。

en: Next, Xi Jinping checked the Djibouti-based Security Base via video.
zh: Simplified Chinese：然后，习近平通过视频检查了位于吉布提的安全基地。

en: This base is the first overseas security base of the Chinese Navy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：此基地是中国海军的第一座海外安全基地。

en: A four-level (including red level, orange level, yellow level and green level) alerting and defense system was built and eight emergency response teams are always ready. Military drills were organized on an irregular basis in order to realize……
zh: 四级（红色、橙色、黄色和绿色）警报和防御系统已建成，八个紧急应急团队始终处于备战状态。军事演习在不规则时间间隔上进行，以实现……

en: Then, Xi Jinping listened to a work report about troop training and war preparation of the whole army and delivered a keynote speech.
zh: 然后，习近平听取了整军大队全体部队训练和战争准备的工作报告，并 deliver了关键演讲。

en: Xi Jinping recognized and appreciated the great result of troop training and war preparation achieved by the whole army since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.
zh: 习近平总统认可和赞赏中国整军大业的全部成果。

en: He stressed that China is developing into a powerful country from a big country in this key stage. China has a promising future on one hand and is also facing severe challenges on the other hand.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他强调，中国正在从一个大国转变为一个强大的国家，在这个关键阶段。中国有一个充满希望的未来，但也面临着严重挑战。

en: It is impossible to achieve the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation simply by doing some easy works and having celebrations.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根本无法通过简单的工作和庆祝来实现中国大国复兴。

en: Military struggle is an important aspect in fighting great battles, and the ability to win battles serves as a strategic ability required for safeguarding national security.
zh: 军事斗争在打大战中是一个重要方面，赢得战争的能力是保护国家安全的战略能力。

en: The whole military should strength awareness of hardship, awareness of crisis and awareness of war fighting, concentrate on fighting war and make every effort to prepare for war.
zh: Simplified Chinese：整个军队都应该增强对困难、危机和战争fighting的认识，集中精力在 warfare上，并尽力准备好应对战争。

en: Improve the ability in war preparation and war fighting as soon as possible
zh: Simplified Chinese：尽快提高战争准备和战斗能力

en: Efforts should be made to fight innovative war and make preparation for war, keep up with evolution in war situation and method of war fighting,
zh: Simplified Chinese：应采取措施打赢创新战争，做好战争准备，跟上战争形势和 warfare 战术的演变。

en: align with war tasks and opponents and arouse a trend of researching on war-related issues
zh: Simplified Chinese：与战争任务和对手一致，引发研究战争相关问题的趋势。

en: Efforts should be made to improve construction of the commanding system and ability in joint operation, emancipate mind, make innovations in practice and work harder, build a strong and high-efficiency...
zh: Simplified Chinese：努力在改善指挥系统的建造和联合操作能力上下功夫，解放思想，实践创新，更加努力地工作，建立一个强大的高效率的体系。

en: Efforts should be made to deepen actual war-based military training and insist on the principle that military training should be performed completely based on requirements of actual war.
zh: Simplified Chinese：努力应使实际战争基础军事训练深化，并坚持原则是军事训练应该完全基于实际战争的要求。

en: Enthusiasm, initiative and creativity of officers and soldiers should be given full play,
zh: Simplified Chinese：官兵的热情、积极性和创造力要得到充分发挥。

en: and an upsurge of military training should be aroused in the whole army
zh: Simplified Chinese：军队整体应引发一场军事训练的爆发

en: Xi Jinping stressed that leading cadres at all levels, especially high-ranking cadres, should play a leading role in war preparation and war fighting.
zh: 习近平强调，所有级别的领导人，尤其是高级别领导人，应该在战争准备和战斗中发挥领导作用。

en: It is necessary to establish proper outlook on career, outlook on power and outlook on position and strengthen their awareness in war preparation and war fighting.
zh: Simplified Chinese：需要建立适当的职业观念、权力观念和职位观念，并加强他们在战争准备和战斗中的意识。

en: Zhang Youxia, Member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the CPC and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, as well as Wei Fenghe, Li Zuocheng, Miao Hua and Zhang Shengmin, Members of the Central Military Commission, participated in the activity.
zh: 张友晓，中共中央政治局委员、中央军事委员会副主席；魏锋海、李卓成、苗华、张盛民、中共中央军事委员会成员参加了活动。

en: According to reports,
zh: Simplified Chinese：据报道

en: Twenty-fifth Informal Leaders Meeting
zh: Simplified Chinese：第25次非正式领导人会议

en: Invited by Nguyen Phu Trong, the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam, Trn i Quang, the Chairman of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and Boungnang, the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and Chairman of the Lao People's Democratic Republic,
zh: 由越南共产党中央委员会总书记 Nguyen Phu Trong邀请，越南社会主义共和国主席Trn i Quang和老挝人民革命党中央委员会总书记 Boungnang老挝人民民主共和国主席。

en: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to Vietnam and Laos from November 12 to 14.
zh: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记和中国国务院主席习近平将于11月12日至14日访问越南和老挝。

en: The Foreign Ministry held a briefing for Chinese and foreign media on the 3rd.
zh: Simplified Chinese：外交部在3日举行了对外媒体和中国媒体的简报会。

en: The relevent officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Commerce announced that General Secretary and President Xi Jinping planned to visit Vietnam.
zh: 相关官员来自外交部和商务部，宣布总统习近平将于越南访问。

en: He will deliver a keynote speech, attend informal leaders meetings and working lunches in two stages, and attend a dialogue between APEC leaders and ASEAN leaders,
zh: Simplified Chinese：他将在两阶段中为会场做出主持人发言，参加非正式领导人会议和工作午餐，并参加APEC领导人与ASEAN领导人之间的对话。

en: attend the dialogue between APEC leaders and representatives of the APEC Business Advisory Council, and will meet leaders of relevant economies.
zh: 参加APEC领导人与APEC商业顾问委员会代表之间的对话，并将会与相关经济的领导人相遇。

en: The consensus reached in the meeting will be reflected in the declaration of leaders issued after the meeting.
zh: Simplified Chinese：会议结束后发出的领导人宣言中将反映出会议达成的共识。

en: The third agenda is to jointly draw a new vision for future cooperation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：第三项议程是共同画出未来合作的新视野。

en: The fourth agenda is to jointly promote the smooth flow of trade and the implementation of the resolutions of the Beijing Conference, as well as push forward the creation of the Asia Pacific Free Trade Area.
zh: 第四项议程是共同促进贸易流畅、推行北京会议决议的实施以及推动亚太自由贸易区的建立。

en: China will continue to work with all parties to promote the steady development of economic cooperation in the Asia-Pacific region and promote the development and prosperity of the Asia-Pacific region and the world.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国将继续与所有方合作，促进亚太地区经济合作的稳定发展，并推动亚太地区和世界的发展繁荣。

en: The first visit of the top leader of Chinese CP and the country will open a new chapter of peripheral diplomacy with Chinese characteristics in a new era.
zh: 中国共产党的最高领导人首次访问，标志着该国与周边国家建立新型外交关系。

en: During his visits to Vietnam,
zh: Simplified Chinese：在他访问越南的过程中，

en: General Secretary and President Xi Jinping will hold talks with General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong, Chairman Trn i Quang, Prime Minister Nguyen Xuan Phuc and Congress chairwoman Nguy n Th Kim Ngan
zh: 中共中央总书记和国家主席习近平将会与中共中央总书记阮普同、国务院副总理陈春福、国会主席黄明安等人进行会谈。

en: separately.
zh: 单独地

en: They will have in-depth discussions on relations between the two parties and countries, pragmatic cooperation in various fields, as well as regional and international issues of common interest.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们将进行深入讨论两国之间的关系、各自领域的实用合作以及共同关心的地区和国际问题。

en: The leaders of the two parties and countries will also jointly attend the groundbreaking ceremony for a Chinese aid project related to the livelihood of Lao people.
zh: 两党和国家的领导人还会共同参加有关老挝人民生活相关的中国援助项目的开工仪式。

en: The development of Sino-Vietnam and Sino-Laos relations and the mutually beneficial and win-win cooperation between China and Southeast Asian countries have brought new opportunities and injected new impetus.
zh: 中国与越南和中国与老挝关系的发展，以及中东南亚国家之间的互利合作，带来了新的机会和注入了新动力。

en: According to reports,
zh: Simplified Chinese：据报道，

en: During the 19th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party and after Comrade Xi Jinping was elected General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, many political parties and governments of foreign countries,
zh: Simplified Chinese：在中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会期间和共产党中央委员会总书记习近平被选举为中央委员会常务副主席后，许多外国政党和政府都对此表示关注。

en: international organizations, non-governmental organizations and their leaders, diplomatic envoys in China, international friends, overseas Chinese, and compatriots from the Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR and Taiwan
zh: 国际组织、非政府组织和其领导人、中国外交代表、国际朋友、海外华人和香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区和台湾同胞。

en: sent congratulatory messages to the General Assembly, CPC Central Committee, and newly elected leaders, expressing warm congratulations and best wishes.
zh: 送祝贺信给联合国全体会议、中国共产党中央委员会以及刚当选的领导人，表达热情祝贺和最好的祝愿。

en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the International Department of CPC Central Committee were entrusted by the CPC Central Committee and General Secretary Xi Jinping
zh: Simplified Chinese：中共中央总party部办公室和中共中央国际部被中共中央和中共中央总书记习近平任命为其负责人。

en: to express sincere thanks.
zh: Simplified Chinese：表达真诚的感谢。

en: Intensifying the basic construction for farmland water conservancy is an urgent requirement and basic guarantee for deepening the structural reform of the agricultural supply side as well as realizing the goal of empowering and enriching peasants.
zh: 加强农田水利基础设施是深化农业供应侧结构改革的紧急要求和基本保障，也是实现 peasant empowerment 和富民化的关键。

en: Since the party’s 18th National Congress, all regions and relevant departments have conscientiously implemented the decisions and policies of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, have made solid progress in improving water conservancy for farmland and have achieved remarkable results.
zh: Simplified Chinese：自党的十八大以来，所有地区和相关部门都认真落实了中共中央和国务院的决定和政策，取得了农田水利改善方面的坚实进展，并取得了显著成果。

en: This has laid a solid foundation for maintaining good harvest year after year, continuously increasing farmers' income, and sustaining healthy economic and social development in rural areas.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这为年年保持良好的收获，连续增加农民收入，并在农村地区维持健康的经济和社会发展奠定了坚实的基础。

en: It is imperative to study in depth and implement the spirit of the Nineteen National Congress of the CPC, and take guidance from Xi Jinping's socialist ideology with Chinese characteristics in the new era
zh: 深入学习和实施中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会精神，并从习近平新时代社会主义意识形态中寻求指导。

en: in a bid to accelerate improvement of the water conservancy infrastructure network and water governance system, and to make efforts to fill the gap in water conservancy, and further increase the comprehensive agricultural production capacity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：为了加速水利基础设施网络和水管制系统的改造，进一步填补水利领域的空白，并增加综合农业生产能力。

en: We must improve the disaster prevention and mitigation capabilities as well as the capability to conserve and better use water resources in order to make new contributions to the development of modern agricultural and to the cause of building a well-off society.
zh: 我们必须提高灾害防御和减轻能力以及水资源的节约和更好利用能力，以便为现代农业发展和建造富裕社会做出新的贡献。

en: Wang Yang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the meeting and delivered a speech.
zh: 王阳，中共中央政治局常务委员会委员长、国务院副总理，在会议上出席并发表了演说。

en: He stressed that the video and telephone conference for the construction of farmland water conservancy infrastructure in the winter and spring was held after the party’s 19th National Congress
zh: Simplified Chinese：他强调了农田水利基础设施冬春季的视频会议和电话会议是在党的19大之后举行的。

en: and made the arrangement.
zh: Simplified Chinese：并且做了安排。

en: Premier of the State Council Li Keqiang met with TerraPower Chairman and Microsoft Founder Bill Gates on the morning of the 3rd at Tower of Violet Light, Zhongnanhai
zh: Simplified Chinese：中共中央国务院总理李克强上午三日与地球能公司董事长和微软创始人比尔盖茨会面于紫光塔，中南海

en: Gather the wisdom and power of the people, leverage international cooperation to drive disruptive advancement in technology, and achieve sharing for the better benefit of humanity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：集结人民的智慧和力量，利用国际合作推动技术突破，实现共同发展以促进人类福祉。

en: Bill Gates said that next-generation nuclear power is of great significance to the development of future energy technology. We cherish cooperation with Chinese enterprises
zh: 比尔·盖茨说，下一代核电的发展对未来能源技术的发展具有极大的重要性，我们很重视与中国企业的合作。

en: The 103rd meeting of the Council of Chairmen of the 12th NPC Standing Committee of the PRC was held on the afternoon of the 3rd in Beijing at the Great Hall of the People. Chairman Zhang Dejiang presided over the meeting.
zh: 第103次国务院常务委员会十二届人大常委会会议于北京市人民大会堂大礼堂上午第三天举行，中国共产党中央委员会副主席张德江主持会议。

en: The meeting members heard the report of the director of the National People's Congress Law Committee, Qiao Xiaoyang, on the opinion as regards the deliberative draft to the revision of the draft amendment for three laws including the Law Against Unfair Competition.
zh: 会员们听了国民大会法委员会法制委员会主任_qiao xiaoyang报告的意见，关于审议草案的修订草案，其中包括不公平竞争法等三项法律的修订草案。

en: The report on the outcome of the deliberation on the draft of Amendment (X) to the Criminal Law, and the report on the outcome of the deliberation on the draft amendment of 11 laws including the Accounting Law.
zh: 关于刑法修正案（X）草案讨论结果报告，以及关于包括会计法在内的11项法律修正案草案讨论结果报告。

en: Report on the status of the draft decision of national laws
zh: Simplified Chinese：关于国家法律草案的报告

en: The meeting members heard the report of the director of the National People's Congress Foreign Affairs Committee, Fu Ying, on the status of deliberation on relevant foreign treaties and decision draft.
zh: Simplified Chinese：会议成员听了国务院外事委员会副秘书长富英的关于相关外交条约和决议草案审议状态的报告。

en: Report on the status of the report on the outcome of the deliberation on delegate motions separately proposed by four special committees including the Foreign Affairs Committee, and the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee
zh: Simplified Chinese：关于四个专门委员会，包括外交事务委员会和农业和乡村事务委员会提出的代表选项的讨论结果报告。

en: Report on the deliberation of the representative capacity of individual representatives and report on the state of the appointment and removal case, among others
zh: Simplified Chinese：关于代表人代表能力的报告和任免案件状态等其他事项的报告

en: The Council of Chairmen confirmed that, pursuant to the deliberation opinion of the Standing Committee meeting, upon further deliberation on and amendments of the aforesaid motions and drafts
zh: Simplified Chinese：议会主席会议确认，根据立法委员会会议讨论的意见，进一步讨论并修改上述提案和草案。

en: A submission shall be made to the 104th Council of Chairmen to decide whether it shall be handed over for a vote at the closing ceremony of the 30th meeting of the 12th NPC Standing Committee of the PRC.
zh: 提交给第十四届主席会议的决定，是否将该案件交由闭幕式投票。

en: Presented a report
zh: Simplified Chinese：呈现了报告

en: In his report, Wang Xiaohui systematically summarized the historic achievements and historical changes that have taken place in the past five years.
zh: 王小惠在他的报告中，系统地总结了过去五年的历史成就和历史变革。

en: He expounds on the times, background, core essentials, innovative ideas and major contributions of Xi Jinping’s socialist ideology with Chinese characteristics of the new era, elaborates on socialism with Chinese characteristics,
zh: Simplified Chinese：他阐述了习近平新时代社会主义思想的时代、背景、核心内容、创新理念和主要贡献，详细阐述了以中国特色的社会主义。

en: and on how the CPC has overcome countless difficulties with extraordinary courage and tenacity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：和 CPC 在面对无数困难时的出色勇气和坚韧。

en: The report uses vivid data and cases to get the message across in a systematic and easy-to-understand manner, triggering strong resonance among the audience.
zh: Simplified Chinese：报告使用了鲜明的数据和案例来传达信息，采用系统化的方式，使得观众产生强烈的共鸣。

en: Many representatives expressed their resolve
zh: Simplified Chinese：许多代表人表达了他们的决心。

en: to study and implement the spirit of the Nineteenth National Congress of CPC as required by the CPC Central Committee, to keep in line with the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core,
zh: 按照中共中央的要求，学习和实施第十九次全国代表大会精神，保持与中共中央核心领袖习近平总书记一致。

en: and turn the spirit of the Nineteenth Congress and the goals into a common understanding and firm action.
zh: Simplified Chinese：并将第十九届国会的精神和目标转化为共同理解和坚定行动。

en: Today's report gives us deeper understanding of the spirit of the Nineteenth Congress and the spiritual essence of Xi Jinping’s socialist ideology with Chinese characteristics
zh: 今天的报告给我们提供了关于第十九届国会精神和习近平新时代社会主义思想精神本质的更深入理解。

en: including the process of its formation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：包括其形成过程。

en: The report was hosted by Li Zhiyong, deputy secretary of the working committee of the Central State Organs.
zh: 报告由李志勇主持，中央国家机构工作委员会副秘书。

en: About 3,000 people, including party and government cadres stationed in Beijing, officials from central enterprises, relevant responsible persons in colleges and universities, teachers and students from colleges, theorists and people from all walks of life took part in the report meeting.
zh: 大约有3000多人，包括在北京驻扎的党政干部、中央企业官员、相关负责人在大学和大学生、大学教师和学生、理论家和来自各行各业的人参加了报告会。

en: Good presentation helps the whole society to reach a consensus and form a better ideological foundation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：良好的演讲能够帮助整个社会达成共识并形成更好的意识形态基础。

en: According to reports, Xinhua News Agency broadcast an editorial today calling for the integration of personal ideals into national causes, arousing a wave of enthusiasm among intellectuals and young CPC members in colleges in studying and implementing the spirit of the Nineth Congress of CPC.
zh: Simplified Chinese：据报道，新华社今天发表了一篇编辑文章，呼吁将个人理念融入国家事业中，引起了在大学里学习和实施九大代表大会精神的青年 CPC成员和知识分子中产生了热潮。

en: In recent days, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, together with the People's Bank of China and the China Banking Regulatory Commission, have jointly made arrangement for regulating the home financing, in a bid to intensify the anti-money laundry effort in real estate industry.
zh: 近期，住建部与中国人民银行和中国银监委员会联合制定了房地产融资管理的安排，以加强对房地产行业的反洗钱努力。

en: All localities are required to intensify efforts to investigate and punish the practice of providing illegal home financing,
zh: Simplified Chinese：所有地方都必须加强调查和惩处非法提供家贷的努力。

en: and intensify the scrutiny of the source of down payment funds and the authenticity of the borrower’s income proof.
zh: Simplified Chinese：并加强对付款来源的审查和借贷者收入证明的真实性。

en: Today, the Ministry of Civil Affairs issued the first
zh: 今天，民政部发布了第一个

en: Unified Social Credit Code certificate for the special legal person, a grassroots autonomous organization in Beijing.

en: has become a shopping-rush fruit, and has even been exported abroad.
zh: Simplified Chinese：已成为购物狂果，甚至被export到国外。

en: Trump's new chief of staff plans to restrict the president's media diet.
zh: Simplified Chinese：特朗普的新总统助手计划限制总统的媒体饮食。

en: Others have tried and failed.
zh: Simplified Chinese：其他人也尝试过了，但都失败了。

en: Maybe John F. Kelly can actually do it.
zh: Simplified Chinese：也许约翰·费利（John F. Kelly）真的能做到。

en: If so, he will be the first.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果是这样，他将是第一个。

en: Politico reports that the new White House chief of staff plans to restrict the flow of information to President Trump - including news media reports - in the hope of keeping the boss on a more even keel.
zh: Simplified Chinese：政治家报导，新白宫总统助手计划限制向总统传递信息的流动，包括新闻媒体报道，以期保持总统更加平衡。

en: Here's a bit from reporter Josh Dawsey:
zh: Simplified Chinese：这里是记者Josh Dawsey的一段话：

en: "When new White House Chief of Staff John F. Kelly huddled with senior staff on his first day at work, he outlined a key problem in President Donald Trump's White House that he planned to fix: bad information getting into the president's hands.
zh: 当新白宫首席事务官约翰·费利（John F. Kelly）第一次上任时，与高级人员聚会，他就提出了一个关键问题：总统唐纳德·特朗普的白宫中存在着坏信息进入总统手中的问题。

en: Kelly told the staff that information needed to flow through him - whether on paper or in briefings - because the president would make better decisions if given good information."
zh: Simplified Chinese：凯利告诉员工，信息必须通过他流动——无论是纸质的还是简要 briefing——因为总统会做出更好的决定，只要得到良好的信息。

en: Kelly's diagnosis makes perfect sense, but others have tried and failed to tame Trump by monitoring his media diet.
zh: Simplified Chinese：凯利的诊断看似合理，但其他人试过了，试图控制特朗普，但他们都失败了。

en: President Trump's relationship with television goes back decades - and now that he's in the White House, his TV-watching habit is still going strong.
zh: Simplified Chinese：总统特朗普与电视的关系已经有几十年了——现在他在白宫后，他仍然坚持看电视。

en: "If candidate Trump was upset about unfair coverage, it was productive to show him that he was getting fair coverage from outlets that were persuadable," Sam Nunberg, a former campaign adviser, told Politico in February.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果候选人特朗普对不公平的报道感到不满，很有必要让他知道，他从那些可以说服的媒体中得到的报道是公平的。

en: Politico's Tara Palmeri wrote at the time that "the key to keeping Trump's Twitter habit under control, according to six former campaign officials, is to ensure that his personal media consumption includes a steady stream of praise."
zh: Simplified Chinese：政治家塔拉·帕莱里（Tara Palmeri）在当时写道：“保持特朗普的推特习惯控制住，根据六位前竞选官员的说法，是要确保他的个人媒体消费包括一条稳定的赞扬流。

en: Okay.
zh: Simplified Chinese：好。

en: But the idea that Trump's Twitter habit has ever been "under control" is laughable.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但 trump 的推特习惯从来没有被控制过，根本不值得笑话。

en: Maybe these campaign officials know something the rest of us don't - that Trump's tweets would have been even more inflammatory if not for their interventions.
zh: Simplified Chinese：也许这些竞选官员知道了我们没有的那点东西——特朗普的推文如果没有干预，会更加激进。

en: We'll probably never know about tweets that Trump didn't send.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们可能永远不知道特朗普没有发过的推文。

en: If his staffers managed to him out of trouble even a few times, then their efforts were worthwhile.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果他的团队能够帮助他脱离困境至少有一两次，那么他们的努力是值得的。

en: But no one has been able to consistently prevent Trump from stirring up controversy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但没有人能够持续地阻止特朗普引发争议。

en: Part of the problem is that in a White House composed of competing factions, people invariably try to advance their agendas by presenting Trump with material - which may or may not be reliable - that promotes their worldviews.
zh: Simplified Chinese：问题之一在于，白宫中存在多个派系的竞争环境下，人们总是会试图通过向特朗普呈现物质 — —可能或不可能可靠的 — 的信息来推进自己的议程。

en: Politico - all over this story - reported in May on advisers' penchants for strategically feeding dubious information to the president.
zh: Simplified Chinese：政治家杂志（politico）在5月份报道了关于顾问倾向于策略性提供疑似信息给总统的故事。

en: This was one example, described by reporter Shane Goldmacher:
zh: 这是一个例子，记者尚恩·戈尔德马赫（Shane Goldmacher）所描述的。

en: "Current and former Trump officials say Trump can react volcanically to negative press clips, especially those with damaging leaks, becoming engrossed in finding out where they originated.
zh: Simplified Chinese：现任和前总统特朗普的官员表示，特朗普对负面新闻片段的反应往往是激烈的，尤其是那些有损性的泄露，会深入调查出这些信息的来源。

en: That is what happened in late February when someone mischievously gave the president a printed copy of an article from GotNews.com, the website of Internet provocateur Charles C. Johnson, which accused deputy chief of staff Katie Walsh of being 'the source behind a bunch of leaks' in the White House.
zh: 在二月末，某人故意给总统送了一份关于“网红”查尔斯·C·约翰逊（Charles C. Johnson）网站GotNews.com的文章的印刷品，文章指责白宫副首席助理凯蒂·沃尔什（Katie Walsh）是“一系列泄密事件”的源头。

en: No matter that Johnson had been permanently banned from Twitter for harassment or that he offered no concrete evidence or that he had lobbed false accusations in the past and recanted them.
zh: Simplified Chinese：无论Johnson是否永久被Twitter禁言，或者他没有提供具体证据，还是在过去抛出虚假指控，并后悔了。

en: Trump read the article and began asking staff about Walsh."
zh: 特朗普读了文章后开始询问 Walsh的员工。

en: Goldmacher added that then-chief of staff Reince Priebus and White House staff secretary Rob Porter "have tried to implement a system to manage and document the paperwork Trump receives."
zh: Simplified Chinese：金马赫（Goldmacher）表示，前白宫总干事里恩斯·普里布斯（Reince Priebus）和白宫幕僚长罗伯·波特（Rob Porter）试图实施管理和记录特朗普接收的文件的系统。

en: How'd that work out?
zh: Simplified Chinese：那是怎么回事？

en: Kelly is trying to do the same thing, three months later.
zh: Simplified Chinese：凯利试图做同样的事情，三个月后。

en: Perhaps he will prove a more effective manager than Priebus, but Trump is still his impulsive self, and his aides are still vying for influence.
zh: Simplified Chinese：也许他会证明比普里布斯（Priebus）更有效的经理，但特朗普仍然是他的冲动性人格，且他的助手们仍在争夺权力。

en: Those immutable factors will make Kelly's mission very difficult.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那些不可变的因素会使凯利的任务变得极其困难。

en: Walking through the Anchang Ancient Town in Shaoxing, you can see hoop buckets, bamboo knitting, ironmaking, shoes stitching, lace making, cotton spinning and other traditional handicraft techniques almost everywhere, which fully represent the intangible cultural heritage of the Anchang Ancient Town. Tourists all over the world are enchanted to experience the folk customs and feel the atmosphere of Shaoxing's historical and cultural experience.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在浙江绍兴的安창古镇，步行可以看到木桶、竹子编织、铁冶、鞋子缝制、 Lace 制成、棉纱绕结等传统手工艺几乎处处可见，这些技巧完全体现了安昌古镇的非物质文化遗产。来自世界各地的游客都被迷住了，想要体验当地民俗和感受绍兴历史文化的氛围。

en: It is reported that during the three-day New Year's holiday, more than 65,000 tourists visit Anchang Ancient Town.
zh: 据报道，在三天的新年假期里，超过65000名游客来到安昌古镇。

en: In Zhejiang, a town with a unique style such as Anchang Ancient Town is scattered all over like stars. The glittering waves of Jiaxing Xitang is flowing with the warmth and gratefulness of the lower reaches of the Yangze River in the south; the white walls of Quzhou's Nianbadu Ancient Town convey to us the changes over time in the town; and the murals of fishermen in Shitang, Taizhou draw a picture of their life, both traditional and modern. These towns are the "palm treasure" of Zhejiang tourism and also the favorites of tourists from all regions.
zh: 在浙江，散落着像星星一样的独特风格，如安昌古镇；贡献了贾兴西塘的闪亮波浪与长江下游的温暖感；清华的念八渡古镇的白墙传递给我们的是时间的变迁；和在台州shitang渔民壁画描绘他们的生活，既有传统又有现代。这些古镇是浙江旅游的“椭圆宝藏”，也是来自各地游客的喜爱之处。

en: In recent years, with the promotion of tourism construction throughout the whole region, the potential of Zhejiang’s small towns have been gradually awakened.
zh: Simplified Chinese：近年来，随着整个地区旅游业建设的推动，浙江小镇潜力逐渐被唤醒。

en: In 2016, the provincial government office issued the "The implementation of the creation of a tourist town in Zhejiang Province”, which proposed that the province would accept and name about 100 tourist towns with strong folk customs, beautiful ecological environment and rich tourism industries after 5 years or so.
zh: 2016年，浙江省政府办公室发布了《浙江省旅游小镇创业实施方案》，提出了该省将在五年左右接受和命名约100个具有强有力民俗、美丽生态环境和丰富旅游业的旅游小镇。

en: Today, these little towns have become key destinations for visitors to Zhejiang who come to admire the natural scenery, savor Zhejiang culture, and feel nostalgic about Zhejiang. They will also become key drivers to help the Province create “Picturesque Zhejiang”, China’s most beautiful tourist destination.
zh: 今天，这些小镇已经成为浙江来欣赏自然风光、品尝浙江文化和怀念浙江的游客的热门目的地。他们也将成为帮助省会创建“美丽浙江”（ Picturesque Zhejiang ）的关键驱动力。

en: The responsible people of the Provincial Tourism Bureau established that with the rise of these tourism style towns, we must now pay more attention to the construction of the personalized tourism industry and new tourism projects and formats emerging one after another. These have brought rich experiences to tourists and earned glowing reputations.
zh: Simplified Chinese：负责人是省旅游局的官员，他们确认了随着这些旅游风格小镇的兴起，我们必须现在更加关注个人化旅游业的建设和新型旅游项目和格式的出现。这些已经为游客带来了丰富的体验，并获得了光荣的声誉。

en: Emphasis on promotion
zh: Simplified Chinese：强调推广

en: Recently, directed by the Zhejiang Provincial Tourism Bureau and Zhejiang Daily Press Group, the Tourism Full Media Center of the Zhejiang Daily Press Group hosted the “Towns × Future artists" sharing session and the 2017 promotion season of Zhejiang style tourism towns, "Poetic Zhejiang, Towns with folk customs”. The closing ceremony took place in the Zhejiang exhibition hall.
zh: 近期，由浙江省旅游局和浙江日报新闻集团主办的《浙江日报新闻集团旅游媒体中心》主持了“镇市×未来艺术家”分享会和2017年浙江风格旅游小镇促销季——“诗情浙江，towns with folk customs”。闭幕式在浙江展览馆举行。

en: “A style town has artistic beauty and living warmth.
zh: 一个风格小镇拥有艺术美和生活温暖。

en: The style of the towns lies in the original sense, flavor and township, which represents the original purity.
zh: 镇上的风格在于原始的意义、味道和乡村，代表着原始的纯粹。

en: Xie Hanfeng, a teacher at the School of Film and Television Animation Arts of China’s Academy of Art, the domestic A-list film and television advertising director, and Professor Xu Xianghong, the dean of the School of Art and Communication at China Jiliang University, talked about the cross-border stories of towns through Towns in the lens and Reconstruction of small village.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国艺术院电影电视动画学院的老师Xie Hanfeng，国内A级电影电视广告导演，中国美术学院通信学部主任Professor Xu Xianghong，在关于小镇的跨境故事通过“小镇在镜头”和“小村重建”的话题上进行了讨论。

en: Many scenic tourist towns in Zhejiang have deep cultural resources. Dong Xinjian, a town deputy from Nanxun, Huzhou, appeared in the site in person and interpreted Nanxun as a traditional Chinese painting.
zh: 许多浙江的风景区都有深厚的文化底蕴。南昆镇的代表人物董新健在现场出席并以自己为代表的南昆镇解释为一幅传统的中国画。

en: The style of towns in the south of the lower reaches of the Yangze River have been popular with painters since ancient times. Nowadays, the Nanxun Ancient Town is developing in-depth cooperation with art academies such as the China Academy of Art.
zh: 南Yangze河下游的小镇风格从古代就被画家所青睐。现在，南昆古镇正在与中国艺术学院等艺术院校进行深入合作。

en: Tourism style towns must be equipped with elements of style, tourism, service and the environment.
zh: Simplified Chinese：旅游风格小镇必须具备风格、旅游业、服务和环境元素。

en: Among these, tourism service facilities and the environment are very important.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这些方面中，旅游服务设施和环境是非常重要的。

en: If the tourists are handed in an umbrella on a rainy day, they can better experience the town’s style.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果游客在雨天被给予一把伞，他们就能更好地体验这座城镇的风格。

en: In the era of sharing, the Tourism Full Media Center of the Zhejiang Daily Press Group teamed up with the hottest shared umbrella company to customize a number of shared umbrellas in “Poetic Zhejiang” style, hoping to promote the concept of “Sharing and Green”, spread the awareness of civilized tourism and public morality among tourists and residents, and create a shared, beautiful tourist environment.
zh: 在分享时代，浙江日报集团旅游全媒体中心与热门的共享伞公司合作，打造了几款“诗情浙西”风格的共享伞，希望推动“分享和绿色”的概念，提高公众对文明旅游和社会道德的认识，创造出一片共享、美丽的旅游环境。

en: This has become a bright spot in the 2017 promotional season of Zhejiang’s tourism towns, "Poetic Zhejiang, Towns with folk customs”.
zh: 这已经成为2017年“诗歌浙江”和民俗小镇的宣传季度的亮点。

en: Expecting wonders
zh: Simplified Chinese：期待奇迹

en: Up to now, Zhejiang Province has released the list of the first 21 provincial-level tourism towns that will ultimately culminate in a grand total of 115 provincial tourism towns.
zh: Simplified Chinese：截至目前，浙江省已经发布了第21个省级旅游小镇的名单，这将最终达到总计115个省级旅游小镇。

en: As the prior area for the development of rural tourism during the “13th Five-Year Plan” period, the style towns will eventually be built into tourist attractions with a grade of 3A or higher, becoming a new model for tourism product diversity, tourism benefits and industrial integration.
zh: 作为“13个五年计划”的农村旅游发展的前沿地区，风景小镇最终会被提升为3A级或以上的旅游景点，成为一种新型旅游产品多样性、旅游收益和工业融合的新模式。

en: What makes tourism style towns attractive is their authenticity and originality.
zh: Simplified Chinese：旅游风格小镇的吸引力在于其真实性和原创性。

en: The beauty of the tourism style towns not only stems from the misty bridges and rivers, but also from a long history of cultural tradition; the revitalization of the country is due to cultural self-confidence.
zh: Simplified Chinese：旅游风格小镇的美丽不仅来自雾水的桥梁和河流，也来自于文化传统的长久历史；国家的复兴是由文化自信的力量所驱动。

en: Throughout the world, the tulips of the Netherlands’ Lisse Town, the salt of Austria’s Hallstatt Town, and the pumpkins of Pumpkin Town in France, have been attracting a large number of tourists from all over the world each year. This has allowed the realization that tourism could help the economic growth of smalls towns as well.
zh: 全世界，荷兰利斯镇的 Tulips ，奥地利Hallstatt镇的盐 ，法国Pumpkin Town 的 Pumpkins ，每年都吸引了来自全球各地的大量游客。这种现象使人们意识到旅游业可以帮助小型城镇的经济发展。

en: For the style towns, the point “Emphasis on characteristics and retention of nostalgia” has given the towns a distinct personality and soul, further providing cultural permeation, carrying local cultural traditions, and highlighting native civilizations.
zh: Simplified Chinese：对于风格小镇，强调特点和怀旧的保留，这给了小镇带来了独特的人格和灵魂，进一步促进了文化渗透，传承当地文化传统，并突出本土文明。

en: Tourism style towns, with culture and nostalgia as the link and humanities and scenery as the carrier, connect tourists all over the world while inherit and innovate the traditional customs and cultures in the co-construction and sharing process.
zh: 旅游风格的镇市，文化和怀旧感作为连接线，人文和景观作为载体，将全球游客联系起来，同时继承并创新传统习俗和文化在共同建设和分享过程中。

en: Essentially speaking, the tourism style town is a complex open-style tourism area, and it should be a shared living space for local residents, exotic tourists and even sojourners.
zh: Simplified Chinese：基本上，旅游风格小镇是一个复杂的开放式旅游区，应该是当地居民、异国人和甚至游客共同生活的空间。

en: As the main battlefield for tourism growth in the future, tourism style towns will change the rural ecological landscape, economic and social development patterns, and the flow direction of industrial factors. Additionally, they will play an important role in eliminating the urban-rural infrastructure gap, hastening rural cultural recovery.
zh: 旅游风格小镇将成为未来旅游增长的主要战场，会改变农村生态环境、经济和社会发展模式以及工业因素流动方向。同时，它们也将在消除城市乡村基础设施差距方面发挥重要作用，加速农村文化恢复。

en: In the wake of accelerating revitalization of the countryside, Zhejiang tourist towns will receive a more abundant and wonderful story.
zh: 在农村复兴加速的后期，浙江旅游小镇将获得更加丰富和美好的故事。

en: Figures indicate that 70% of China’s travel demand is concentrated within a 3km radius. On this basis, the short-distance travel market will become a bike sharing paradise sooner or later.
zh: 短途旅行市场会在不久的将来成为自行车共享天地。

en: A report in “The Nikkei” claimed that inflationary pressure will increase because of the expansionary fiscal policies of the next Trump administration. The pace of interest rate hikes will also accelerate in 2017.
zh: Simplified Chinese：《日经》的一份报告称，下一任特朗普总统的扩张性财政政策会导致通胀压力增加。2017年利率上调速度也将加快。

en: The annual International Consumer Electronics Show (CES), held between January 9 (January 10, Beijing time) and 12, opened in Las Vegas, USA.
zh: 每年国际消费电子展（CES），于1月9日至12日（北京时间1月10日）在美国拉斯维加斯开幕。

en: According to the list of exhibitors published by the official CES website, the 51st CES attracted 4,577 corporate participants from around the world.
zh: 根据官方CES网站发布的展商名单，第51届CES吸引了来自世界各地的4,577家公司参加。

en: Compared to the massive 13,000 TV dramas broadcast by satellite TV each year, these “terminated dramas” are but a drop in the ocean.
zh: Simplified Chinese：与卫星电视每年播出的大型13,000部电视剧相比，这些“终止的电视剧”只是海洋中的小波。

en: Travellers negotiate trench, return to 'Millionaire's row'
zh: Simplified Chinese：游客在沟壕上谈判，返回“百万富翁行”

en: Some of the West Midlands' wealthiest homeowners are again at loggerheads with determined travellers who have negotiated a council-dug trench to reclaim a field outside their mansions.
zh: Simplified Chinese：西米德兰的富裕家庭中的一些人再次与坚定的旅行者发生冲突，他们已经在 councils digging 的沟渠中占据了外面大房子的土地。

en: The travellers have parked their 20 caravans in a field outside a prosperous street of Solihull dubbed 'millionaire's row'.
zh: Simplified Chinese：游客们把他们的20辆车厢停在了一个富有的索利赫尔街（Solihull）外围的田野上，后者被称为“一万万美元行”（Millionaire's Row）。

en: Bringing horses, babies and an army of vans, they have returned after being kicked out only in May, undeterred by a moat dug by the council to prevent their incursions.
zh: Simplified Chinese：带着马、婴儿和一大群车，他们已经在五月被踢出了，只是因为有一个城镇委员会挖的水坝阻止了他们的侵略。

en: The tactful group found a gap in the defences, squeezing their vehicles though a section left unbarricaded to accommodate a pathway.
zh: Simplified Chinese：敏感的团队发现了防御体系的一个空隙，挤过未被封锁的部分以容纳一条通道。

en: Furious residents have savaged Solihull Council saying it was 'useless at dealing with the problem'.
zh: 愤怒的居民们对索利霍尔市政局说它“无用”地处理这个问题。

en: One anonymous resident said: 'They moved there on Monday night after being moved on from Bentley Heath where they were throwing rocks at passers by.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一个匿名的居民说：“他们在星期一晚上搬到那里，因为他们从伯灵顿赫斯（Bentley Heath）被移出，他们在那里扔石头向 passerby。

en: The council needs to be shamed into action as they are useless at dealing with the problem.
zh: Simplified Chinese：议会需要被批评和唤起行动，因为他们在解决问题方面完全无用。

en: The travellers were there in May, were moved on and now they are back again.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们在五月份出发，随后被移除，现在他们又回来了。

en: More arrived last night, probably even more today.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：昨晚又来了一些，可能今天甚至会有更多的。

en: She added: 'Birmingham council knows how to deal with this by getting long injunctions to protect their parks.
zh: Simplified Chinese：她说：“伯明翰市政局知道如何处理这一事务的方法是通过获得长期禁令来保护公园。

en: I live on Streetsbrook road and I'm not happy to continue paying my council tax when the council can't even stop this.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：我住在斯ตรीट斯布洛克路上，我不想继续支付当地政府税款，因为当地政府不能甚至阻止这种情况。

en: One local resident who did not wish to be named said: 'It is ridiculous, we have only just seen the last round of these travellers leaving, only to be blighted by another round.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一位不愿透露姓名的当地居民说：“这简直是可笑的，我们刚刚看到最后一轮这些旅客离开，结果又被另一次轮次困扰了。”

en: The numbers have increased this time and a horse has even been seen grazing on the parkland.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：这次数字增加了，甚至有马被看到在公园里放牧。

en: A spokeswoman for Solihull Council said: 'We are aware of an unauthorised encampment on land off Streetsbrook Road and working alongside Solihull Police, we are undertaking the necessary legal actions to move them on as quickly as possible.
zh: Simplified Chinese：Solihull Council的一位发言人说：“我们知道有一个未经授权的露营地，位于街头路上，我们与solihull警察一起合作，正在采取必要的法律行动来移除它尽快。”

en: To support our evidence gathering it is very important that as many local residents as possible report any anti-social or criminal behaviour to the police by calling 101.
zh: Simplified Chinese：为了支持我们的证据收集，必须尽可能多地让当地居民报告任何不良社会行为或犯罪行为给警察打电话。

en: This helps build a picture of the situation for the court to consider when we present our case to them.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：这有助于我们在向法院呈现我们的案件时，为他们考虑的情况建立一个图景。

en: The Fifth Session of the 12th National People's Congress held its closing ceremony at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on March 15.
zh: 第十二届全国人民代表大会的第五次会议在北京市大 hall of the people上举行了闭幕式，于 2023年3月15日举行。

en: This is an interview with Ma Junsheng, Director-General of the State Post Bureau.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是与马俊生，国家邮政局总干事的采访。

en: Xinhua News Agency/Chen Yehua/CRI Online: The Fifth Session of the 12th National People's Congress held its closing ceremony at the Great Hall of the People at 9am on March 15.
zh: 中国新闻社/陈叶华/中国国际广播电台：第十二届全国人民代表大会的第五次会议于2023年3月15日上午九点在人民大 hall举行闭幕式。

en: Prior to the closing ceremony, Ma Junsheng, Director-General of the State Post Bureau, expressed during an interview at the “ministers’ passage” that the State will strengthen supervision over prominent issues that currently exist in the express delivery industry such as late delivery and loss of or damaged parcels, and guide and enhance self-discipline in the industry.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在闭幕式之前，国家邮政局局长马俊生，在“大臣通行道”进行的采访中表示，国家将加强对当前存在的重要问题的监督，如延迟送达和包裹丢失或损坏等，指导和增强行业自律。
