en: In particular, online retail sales of physical goods amounted to approximately RMB5.08 trillion, while online retail sales of services amounted to nearly RMB1.49 trillion.
zh: Simplified Chinese：特别是，电子商务的销售额中，物理商品的销售额约为人民币5.08万亿元，而服务类电子商务的销售额接近人民币1.49万亿元。

en: This comprised 13.6% of total retail sales of consumer goods, up nearly 3 percentage points year-on-year.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这占总 Retail销售量的13.6%，与去年同期相比，增加了近3个百分点。

en: Wake up, students. It’s time to highlight the key points. Online retail sales of services was definitely a major contributor!
zh: Simplified Chinese：醒来，学生们。现在是要突出关键点的时刻。在线零售服务的销售额绝对是一个重要贡献者！

en: Elsewhere, per capita online shopping of French netizens who are obsessed with online shopping amounted to US$1,925. Goods they purchased online are primarily clothing, worthy of being called a nation of fashion lovers.
zh: Simplified Chinese：而且在其他地方，法国网民对在线购物的个人消费额为每人US$1,925。他们购买的主要是服装，值得称之为一国之风尚爱好者。

en: Who says those who love online shopping most must be young?
zh: Simplified Chinese：谁说那些喜欢在线购物的人一定是年轻人呢？

en: The start-ups that will help your company avoid becoming the next Uber
zh: Simplified Chinese：帮助你的公司避免成为下一个Uber的起点企业

en: Amy Errett wanted to gauge employee happiness at her e-commerce start-up, but surveys weren't working.
zh: Amy Errett 想要在她的电子商务 startup 中评估员工的满意度，但调查并没有起作用。

en: Responses were often vague, unhelpful or, worse, deceitful.
zh: Simplified Chinese：回应往往是模糊的，无助于解决问题的，或更糟糕的是，甚至是欺骗性的。

en: And even if she promised anonymity, some workers didn't trust the process.
zh: Simplified Chinese：即使她保证了匿名，许多工人仍然不信任这个过程。

en: "It just never had consistency and objectivity," said Errett, who runs the 75-person San Francisco e-commerce hair care company Madison Reed.
zh: 它从来没有有规律和客观性，埃里特说，Madison Reed是一家由75人组成的San Francisco电子商务美发公司。

en: So she called in outsiders for help.
zh: Simplified Chinese：所以她就叫来外人帮忙。

en: A new breed of human resources start-ups is cropping up to help companies figure out how their employees feel.
zh: Simplified Chinese：新型人力资源 startups 正在冒出，帮助公司了解员工感受。

en: By building and licensing software that has the specific purpose of measuring employee engagement, they allow companies to do snap polls, target specific teams and demographic groups, offer employees anonymity and complaint hotlines, and in some cases allow whistle-blowers to bypass C-suite executives and go straight to the board of directors.
zh: 通过开发并授权专门用于衡量员工参与度的软件，公司可以进行快速投票、针对特定团队和人群、提供员工匿名性和抱怨热线，并在某些情况下允许 whistleblowers绕过首席执行官直接向董事会。

en: "You've now got tools such as Strava and Fitbit for tracking your health, but where's the Fitbit for your company?" said Jim Barnett, co-founder and chief executive of Redwood City start-up Glint, whose software analytics tools are used by companies to measure employee engagement.
zh: 你现在已经拥有了像 Strava 和 Fitbit 这样的工具来跟踪你的健康，但公司里 Fitbit 到ไหน呢？ said Jim Barnett，Glint 的联合创始人和首席执行官，他的软件分析工具被公司用来衡量员工参与度。

en: Errett said she gained more insight into what her employees were thinking and feeling in three years using Glint.
zh: 埃尔雷特说，她在三个年头中使用Glint，获得了更多关于她的员工思想和情绪的见解。

en: In addition to the snap surveys and polls of specific teams, it offers a heat map of the company showing at a glance which units have the most complaints and which managers have low approval scores - allowing her to drill down on why.
zh: Simplified Chinese：除了对特定团队的快速调查和poll外，它还提供了公司在一眼看过去哪个部门有最多的投诉，哪些经理的得分较低，从而让她能够深入了解。

en: Companies are coming to realize they must stay on top of their workplace culture, lest they become the next Uber, which has been enmeshed in scandal since a former employee published a blog post describing an environment of harassment where those who spoke out were punished.
zh: Simplified Chinese：公司们正在意识到他们必须保持在工作环境中保持稳定，否则就可能成为下一个Uber， Uber从来没有避免过与性骚扰有关的丑闻，甚至有员工在一篇博客中描述了一个被迫沉默的环境。

en: For start-ups such as Glint, this desire for oversight is a lucrative business opportunity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：对于像Glint这样的初创公司来说，这种监管的渴望是一个有利可图的商业机会。

en: The global governance, regulation and compliance industry could be worth more than $118.7 billion by 2020, according to finance tech insights website Let's Talk Payments.
zh: Simplified Chinese：全球治理、监管和遵守行业的价值将在2020年超过1.18万亿美元，根据财tech见解网站Let's Talk Payments的预测。

en: Denver, Colo., start-up Convercent, which helps companies prevent and detect bad behavior, saw an uptick in interest and activity earlier this year amid Uber's fall into disrepute.
zh: Simplified Chinese：丹佛，科罗拉多州，起源于Convercent的初创公司，帮助公司预防和检测不良行为，在Uber陷入了不受欢迎的状态时，早期今年看到了一定的兴趣和活跃性。

en: Convercent has nearly 600 clients, including Airbnb, Microsoft, and Tesla.
zh: Simplified Chinese：Convergent 有近600位客户，包括Airbnb、微软和特斯拉。

en: Uber recently signed up as a client.
zh: Uber最近成为客户。

en: Like Glint, Convercent lets companies send customized "pulse" surveys, gather confidential responses in real time, and view heat maps of its problem areas.
zh: Simplified Chinese：像Glint一样，Convercent允许公司发送定制的“脉冲”调查，实时收集机密回应，并查看其问题区域的热图。

en: It also offers an anonymous texting hotline that lets employees report bad behavior.
zh: Simplified Chinese：此外，还提供了一个匿名短信热线，让员工可以报告坏行为。

en: And if the chief executive is implicated, complaints go straight to the board of directors.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果首席执行官被指名，投诉就直接上交董事会。

en: "The court of public opinion has usurped regulators," said Patrick Quinlan, the founder and chief executive of Convercent.
zh: Simplified Chinese：公众舆论的法院已经取代了监管机构，Patrick Quinlan说。

en: If a company is found to treat its employees poorly or behave unethically, even if regulators don't step in, it can face costly consequences from consumer boycotts, employee attrition and lawsuits, Quinlan said.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果公司被发现对员工不公平或不道德地行为，甚至当监管机构不介入时，它也可能面临消费者 boycot、员工流失和诉讼的高昂后果。

en: Ruby Tuesday, the restaurant chain with more than 25,000 employees across 500 locations, has used Convercent for more than a year to ensure employees are aware of policies and procedures and offer an easy way to reach its corporate headquarters.
zh: ruby tuesday，拥有超过 25000 名员工的餐厅网络中，有 500 个地点使用了convercent 多年来确保员工了解政策和程序，并提供一个方便的方式与公司总部联系。

en: Previously, if an employee wanted to report a problem, he or she had to find a phone number or email for corporate headquarters, lodge a formal complaint, and hope it was taken seriously.
zh: Simplified Chinese：以前，如果员工想报告问题，他或她必须找到公司总部的电话号码或电子邮件，提出正式投诉，并希望被认真对待。

en: It was often an intimidating and uncomfortable experience, said James Vitrano, Ruby Tuesday's general counsel, who said there was no good way of tracking employee complaints.
zh: Simplified Chinese：James Vitrano，Ruby Tuesday的总法务官说，这是一种常常令人毛骨耸然、不适感的经历。

en: Now that the company is using Convercent, though, problems that were previously hidden from executives who sat in offices cities or states away - such as discrimination, harassment or unfair wage practices - can be more quickly identified and addressed.
zh: Simplified Chinese：现在公司已经使用了Convercent，尽管如此，之前被远离执行者的那些问题仍然会出现，比如歧视、性骚扰或不公平的工资实践等。

en: "I can get closer to that holistic, 360-degree view into the employment experience," said Vitrano, who oversees Ruby Tuesday's risk management group.
zh: Simplified Chinese：Vitrano说：“我可以更接近于全面、全方位的就业体验视角。”他负责Ruby Tuesday风险管理团队。

en: "And we're protecting our shareholders from employment litigation."
zh: Simplified Chinese：而我们正是保护股东免受雇佣诉讼的。

en: Companies started taking ethics, values and employee engagement more seriously in 2002 after accounting firm Arthur Andersen collapsed because of ethical violations from the Enron scandal, Quinlan said.
zh: Simplified Chinese：2002年，公司开始更加严肃地对待道德、价值观和员工参与性，尤其是因为会计 firm阿瑟安德森因与恩ロン事件相关的道德违规而倒下。

en: But it wasn't until "social media came into its own" that companies realized they couldn't stop their dirty laundry from going viral online.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但直到“社交媒体真正成熟”后，公司才意识到他们无法阻止自己的脏事从网上传播。

en: "Prior to using technology to monitor ethics, people used hope as a strategy," he said.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在使用技术监测伦理之前，人们曾用希望作为策略。

en: Both Glint and Convercent offer their software as a service, charging companies recurring fees to use their products.
zh: Simplified Chinese：Glint 和 Convercent 都提供软件作为服务，向公司收取定期费用的方式。

en: It's a business model and opportunity that has the approval of venture capital investors, who have propped up both start-ups.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是一个业务模型和机会，得到了风险投资家支持，他们都在扶持起新创公司。

en: Convercent raised $10 million in funding in February from firms such as Sapphire Ventures and Tola Capital, bringing its total capital raised to $47 million.
zh: Convercent 在二月份从如 Sapphire Ventures 和 Tola Capital 这样的公司中筹集了 1亿美元的资金，总资本筹集额达到了 4.7亿美元。

en: Glint secured $10 million in November from Bessemer Venture Partners, bringing its total funding to $60 million.
zh: 金霸尔在11月从贝塞默投资伙伴获得了10亿美元的资金，总共增加了60亿美元的投资。

en: These investments hardly come as a surprise, given the interconnected nature of companies, culture and venture capital.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这些投资并不是什么惊喜，考虑到公司、文化和风险资本之间的相互联系。

en: There's a growing body of research showing today's employees expect more from their workplaces than before.
zh: Simplified Chinese：目前的员工越来越多地期望他们的工作场所提供更好的服务。

en: In competitive markets such as Silicon Valley, high salaries and interesting projects are merely table stakes.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在竞争性市场如硅谷，高薪和有趣的项目只是表面上的要求。

en: Employees want to feel that they're accepted and valued and that they're giving their time to a company with a positive mission.
zh: Simplified Chinese：员工希望感到被接受和价值得到了认可，并且他们的时间是为一个有正面使命的公司捐献的。

en: "When people are happy to be at a company, feel their voices are heard, and that the work they are doing is rewarding, they are more committed to making that company successful," said Nina McQueen, vice president of global benefits and employee experience at LinkedIn, which uses both Convercent and Glint.
zh: 当人们感到在公司中有满足感，觉得他们的声音被听到，并且他们所做的工作是有价值的时，他们更容易坚持为公司成功而努力。

en: Investors achieve returns when their portfolio companies do well; companies do well when employees are committed and engaged.
zh: 投资者获得回报是因为其投资公司的表现好；公司的表现好是因为员工的承诺和参与度高。

en: If third-party analytics tools promise to increase employee commitment and engagement, it's no wonder they're finding backing.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果第三方分析工具承诺可以提高员工的忠诚度和参与度，它就不奇怪他们会找到资金支持。

en: Having data on employee engagement is important, according to workplace culture experts.
zh: Simplified Chinese：了解员工参与度的数据对于工作场所文化专家来说非常重要。

en: But the data are useless unless a company's custodians take action.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但是数据无用，除非公司的管理者采取行动。

en: In fact, if a company asks employees for their feedback, it can set an expectation that change is on the way.
zh: Simplified Chinese：实际上，如果公司要求员工提供反馈，那么它就可以设定一个期望，即改变正在发生。

en: And if change doesn't come fast enough, or at all, it can breed disappointment and make employees disengaged.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果没有快速或根本的变化，改变可能会导致失望和员工脱离参与。

en: "If you're going to ask for 4,000 suggestions, you need to be prepared to have 4,000 conversations," said Russell Raath, president of consulting at business management firm Kotter International, who has seen companies make the mistake of relying too much on data collection.
zh: 如果你要向我们提出四千个建议，你就需要准备好和我们进行四千次对话。

en: "Because if you don't follow through, employees will wonder, 'Did you really hear me?
zh: Simplified Chinese：因为如果你不坚持，员工会疑问：“你真的听到了吗？

en: Do you care?
zh: Simplified Chinese：你关心吗？

en: And if you don't care, why should I care?' "
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果你不关心，那么为什么我要关心呢？

en: Madison Reed, which now does monthly employee surveys, has been able to take action the same day a problem is reported on Glint, according to Errett.
zh: Simplified Chinese：马迪逊·里德（Madison Reed），现在每月进行员工调查，能够在问题报告到Glint那天就采取行动。

en: And, after gathering feedback from employees frustrated by the speed of decision-making and the quality of communication, she was able to reorganize several teams within the company and add communication training to address the issues.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但是，通过从员工中收集反馈，他们对决策速度和沟通质量感到 frustrate 的情绪后，她能够重新组织公司内的几个团队，并且添加了沟通培训来解决问题。

en: Over at Ruby Tuesday, the company is getting new insight on its employees, and it's hoping that in the long run, this will convert to better retention of workers in an industry known for high turnover.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在拉比三日，公司正在获得员工的新见解，并希望在长期内，这将转化为更好的员工留任率，尽管该行业以高离职率而闻名。

en: "If you're not committed to creating a culture of transparency, you're going to lose people," Vitrano said.
zh: 如果你不愿意创造透明度的文化，你就会失去人们。

en: "And if you lose people, you're going to lose customers.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果你失去人工，你就要失去客户。

en: And when you lose customers, you're going to lose companies."
zh: Simplified Chinese：当你失去客户时，你就要失去公司了。

en: This year the swimming events of World Cup will return to the 25-meter short pool. It will consist of 9 sub-station races and one more European station than 2015.
zh: 这个赛季世界杯游泳比赛将回归25米短池，会有9个分站赛和比2015年多一个欧洲站。

en: As a world-class player who defeated Ding Junhui in Snooker Project of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games and won the gold medal in this project, Marco Fu should be the most famous Snooker player among the active athletes in Hong Kong.
zh: 作为2010年广州亚运会Snooker项目的世界级选手，Marco Fu在此项目中击败丁俊辉，并获得金牌，应该是香港活跃运动员中最著名的Snooker球手。

en: The unveiling ceremony of “Taking Stock of the Chinese Language 2016”, jointly hosted by the National Language Resources Monitoring and Research Center, Commercial Press and people.cn, was held in Beijing today.
zh: 今天在北京举行了“中国语言2016”展览的开幕式，国家语言资源监测和研究中心、商务出版社和人民网联合主办。

en: Sterling's controversial goal defeated Arsenal, which is really a timely and inspiring attempt for Manchester City after losing two battles in the three matches before.
zh: Simplified Chinese：斯特林的争议性目标击败了阿森纳，这实际上是一个适时和鼓舞人心的尝试，给曼彻斯特城带来了希望，因为他们在前三场比赛中失去了两场战役。

en: (Reporter: Lu Bo) On May 12, Deputy Mayor Chen Lvping arrived at Yongchuan to inspect the status of the implementation of rectifications from the feedback and opinions of the Central Environmental Inspection Group as well as the comprehensive treatment of river basins by the region, as well as to hold a forum. It was understood that Yongchuan had set up a task force for the purpose of conscientiously carrying out the rectification task resulting from the feedback and opinions of the Central Environmental Inspection Group. The rectification task was broken down into 21 regional-level leading departments, and 23 leading towns and streets. The relevant rectification has fully commenced.
zh: (记者：路波) 2019年5月12日，中部地区副市长陈立平来到永川进行了反馈和意见中心环境检查组反馈的整改情况的调查，并举行了会议。据了解，永川已经建立了一项专门负责认真完成反馈和意见中心环境检查组反馈引发的整改任务的工作小组。整改任务分为21个地区级别领导部门和23个市区街道。相关整改工作已经全面开始。

en: Urban romance-business drama “Feather Flies To The Sky” has been a big hit on Jiangsu Television. The drama tells the story of the arduous and passionate entrepreneurial history and romance of three generations of people.
zh: Simplified Chinese：都市爱情商业剧“飞天之旅”在江苏电视台取得了巨大的成功。该剧讲述了三代人世的艰难而激情的企业史和爱情故事。

en: This director of plays, who was born in the 1940s, is a highly respected elder in the performing arts circle. He was a winner of the Golden Lion Award, and was entitled to special subsidy from the State Council.
zh: 这个演出导演，出生于20世纪40年代，是表演艺术界的高尚老人。曾获得金lion奖，并获得国家委员会的特殊补助。

en: In the men's 50-meter backstroke, Koga Junya from Japan won the champion with 22'85 and Chinese athlete Xu Jiayu ranked eighth with 23'54.
zh: 在男子50米背泳比赛中，日本的高加亚Junya夺得冠军，成绩22秒85；中国选手徐家宇排名第八，成绩23秒54。

en: The NCAA's elimination of two-a-day practices makes for a long day for the Bruins
zh: nCAA取消了每天两次训练，导致布鲁因队的日子变得很长。

en: It's pushing 11 p.m. as a throng of UCLA football players linger to chat on one side of the team's new on-campus practice fields.
zh: Simplified Chinese：11点快到了，一群 UCLA足球运动员在团队新校园练习场的一侧聊天不肯走。

en: Some have peeled off their jersey tops, revealing backs slick with sweat from the toil of the first day of training camp.
zh: Simplified Chinese：有些人脱掉了他们的球衣上衬，暴露出汗水湿润的背部。

en: For a good chunk of the team, these idle minutes constitute a midday break.
zh: 这些空闲的分钟对于团队的一半来说就是中午休息。

en: Players enrolled in summer classes will head back to their dorms after the three-hour practice to study for final exams before returning to the Wasserman Football Center for meetings at 6:30 the following morning.
zh: 参加夏季课程的球员在三小时的练习后，会回到宿舍进行最后期考试的复习，然后第二天早上六点半去与足球中心的会议室进行会议。

en: "This is a grind for these guys the next three days," Bruins coach Jim Mora said not long before Monday turned into Tuesday.
zh: 这三天对这些人来说是一个苦力劳动。

en: The NCAA's elimination of two-a-day practices, designed to lighten the load on players, has actually lengthened their days - at least until finals end Friday.
zh: Simplified Chinese：NCAA取消了每天两次训练，旨在减轻球员的负担，但实际上却使他们的日子更长——至少直到决赛结束于周五。

en: That's why UCLA's first three practices were scheduled to begin at 7:15 p.m. to accommodate players' already crammed schedules.
zh: 因为这样， UCLA 的第一三个练习会在 7:15 p.m. 开始，以适应球员的已经很满的日程。

en: The trade-off from no two-a-days is more one-a-days, the Bruins pushing up the start of camp nearly a week from last season and holding practices during summer school for the first time during Mora's six seasons in Westwood.
zh: Simplified Chinese：从没有两天的代价是更多的一天，布鲁斯人推迟了训练营的开始大约一周，最后一次赛季的前几天，并且在莫拉六个赛季的西伍德期间第一次进行夏季学校的实践。

en: They are scheduled to hold 18 practices through Aug. 20 before beginning formal game preparations for their opener against Texas A&M on Sept.
zh: 他们将在8月20日前进行18次练习，然后开始正式对阵德克萨斯A&M的开 season准备。

en: Mora said he supported the NCAA's rule change even if it did add another item to players' busy itineraries.
zh: 莫拉说他支持NCAA的规则变化，即使这会在球员的繁忙日程中添加一个新项目。

en: "We're putting this enormous load on them for three or four days and it's very challenging," Mora said.
zh: 他们把这种巨大的负担放在他们身上三、四天，这是非常困难的。

en: "And they've just pushed through it; they grind, they're great kids.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们只是通过了它；他们努力工作，很好地对待孩子。

en: I think once we get to Saturday and we'll have more time, it will really be great."
zh: Simplified Chinese：我认为一旦周六到来，我们会有更多时间，真的会很好。

en: UCLA will close its practices once camp is finished, no easy task given the clear sight lines of its fields from an adjacent parking lot and the adjoining Luskin Center, an upscale hotel that has already been pelted with footballs that cleared a protective net behind a goalpost.
zh: Simplified Chinese： UCLA将在野球营结束后关闭其训练场，任务并不轻，因为它的田径场从邻近的停车场可以清晰地看到，而且附近的卢斯金中心是一家高端酒店，它已经被足球用来打破防护网后的目标。

en: Bruins players are scheduled to occupy the hotel beginning this weekend, but Mora acknowledged that there could be an issue once those rooms are vacant during the season.
zh: 球员们将从这个周末开始占据酒店，但莫拉承认，等到赛季结束时那些房间空置后，就会出现问题。

en: "We will have security," Mora said.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们会有安全。

en: "That is a real concern and it's not far-fetched to think that people can rent a room and sit up there and videotape a practice.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那是真实的担忧，而且不太难想象人们可以租房子上去，坐在那里 videotape练习。

en: If you have videotape of a practice, it's a pretty good deal.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果你有练习录像带，那就很值得一看。

en: But we'll have security there and we'll have security up in Parking Lot 8.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但我们会在那里有安全，我们会在停车场8号处有安全。

en: We'll do the best we can with what we got.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们尽力做到最好的。

en: I'm not going to worry too much about it.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我不会太担心它。

en: We have a plan in place."
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们有计划。

en: Figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) revealed that in the second quarter of this year, residential property prices in Australia nationwide rose by an average of 1.5% to 2%, and were 3.5% higher on an annual basis, the lowest annual growth rate since March 2013.
zh: 根据澳大利亚统计局（Australian Bureau of Statistics，ABS）的数据，在本年第二季度，全国各地居住房价格上涨平均1.5%至2%，是过去一年最高的增长率，低于2013年3月以来的历史最低。

en: Just when real estate agents were looking forward to selling more real estate during the holiday season, growth rate of residential property prices was the lowest since 2013.
zh: 在房地产中介人员期待在节假期间出售更多房产时，住宅房价增长率却是自2013年以来的最低。

en: IT Home reported this morning that Wall Street Journal claimed that AT&T has canceled plans to sell Huawei’s new flagship smart phone in the US.
zh: IT-home报导今天，华尔街日报称AT&T决定取消在美国出售海富新旗舰智能手机的计划。

en: Huawei’s original plan was to announce this partnership at the CES this week, but AT&T canceled the partnership at the last minute.
zh: 华为最初的计划是在本周的CES上宣布这一合作伙伴关系，但AT&T在最后一分钟取消了这一合作伙伴关系。

en: In a January 9 response to a Bloomberg reporter as regards this turn of events (January 9 US local time), Huawei said that it would release its new product and specific listing information to the US market.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在1月9日，随着这一系列事件的发生（美国时间），华为表示将在美国市场发布新产品，并提供具体的listing信息。

en: Huawei indicated that in the past five years, it has already launched high-end products worldwide and in the US market, proving its strength and competence.
zh: 华为表示，在过去的五年里，它已经在全球范围内和美国市场上推出高端产品，证明了其实力和能力。

en: According to the earlier IT Home report, Huawei will unveil the “best smartphone you’ve never heard of” in the afternoon of January 9 at the CES held in Las Vegas. The battery life of this model could support two days of continuous use.
zh: Simplified Chinese：据早期的IT-home报导，华为将在1月9日下午在拉斯维加斯举办的CES上宣布“你从未听说过的最好的手机”。该手机的电池寿命可以支持连续使用两天。

en: Industry insiders generally believe that the flagship mobile phone Huawei will soon unveil is the Huawei Mate 10 Pro equipped with Android Oreo.
zh: 工业内人普遍认为，马斯克旗舰手机华为即将发布的新机型是配备Android Oreo 的华为Mate 10 Pro。

en: Yangcheng Evening News reporter Wang Li. The film “I Am Not Madame Bovary” starring Fan Bingbing, as well as Guo Tao, Da Peng, Zhang Jiayi and others, will be released nationwide on September 30.
zh: 杨城晚报记者王利。电影《我不是 Madame Bovary》由范冰冰、郭涛、达鹏、张家宜等主演，将于9月30日全国上映。

en: Yesterday, the film held a workshop with the theme “Sorrow in Comedies” in Beijing. Feng Xiaogang, Ning Hao and Da Peng attended the event.
zh: 昨天，北京举办了一场关于“喜剧中的悲伤”的主题工作坊。冯小刚、宁浩和达鹏出席了活动。

en: Alternating circular and square image composition; the director was simply willful What was special about “I Am Not Madame Bovary” was the alternating circular and square image compositions. In particular, the circular frames shot with a hooded lens were fresh and interesting.
zh: Simplified Chinese：交替使用圆形和正方形图像的组成；导演只是任性。“我不是 Madame Bovary ”的独特之处在于交替使用圆形和正方形图像的组成。特别是，使用 hooded 照了圆形框架的镜头，效果新鲜有趣。

en: Feng Xiaogang explained, “ This theme was very similar to Director Zhang Yimou’s “The Story of Qiu Ju”, so it’s very easy for many to lump the two together. So I started to think how I should shoot the film using a method no one has used before. Actually, it wasn’t really a very special idea. I just thought it’d be fun to do something a little different.”
zh: Simplified Chinese：冯小刚解释说，“这部片的主题与导演张艺谋的《秋菊香》非常相似，所以很多人容易把两者混淆。所以我开始思考一下如何用一种从未尝试过的方法拍摄这部电影。实际上，这个想法并不是特别独特的。我只是觉得做点不同会很有趣。”

en: Feng Xiaogang said he regarded the work as his maiden work, and learned how to shoot circular frames from the camera people. He even spent a few million to allow the camera people to shoot a 10-minute pilot.
zh: 冯小刚说他把这部作品当作自己的第一部工作，并从摄影师那里学到了如何拍圆形框架。甚至他花了几百万美元让摄影师拍了一段十分钟的试制片。

en: Facebook to step up fact-checking in fight against fake news
zh: Simplified Chinese：facebook要加强事实核查来对抗虚假新闻

en: Facebook is to send more potential hoax articles to third-party fact checkers and show their findings below the original post, the world's largest online social network said on Thursday as it tries to fight so-called fake news.
zh: Simplified Chinese：facebook将向第三方事实检查机构发送更多的潜在谎言文章，并在原始帖子下方展示其发现，facebook表示周四它正在努力打击所谓的虚假新闻。

en: The company said in a statement on its website it will start using updated machine learning to detect possible hoaxes and send them to fact checkers, potentially showing fact-checking results under the original article.
zh: Simplified Chinese：公司在其网站上发布了一份声明称，将开始使用更新的机器学习技术来检测可能的欺诈行为，并将它们发送给事实检查者，潜在地显示出事实核查结果。

en: Facebook has been criticized as being one of the main distribution points for so-called fake news, which many think influenced the 2016 U.S. presidential election.
zh: Simplified Chinese：facebook被批评为是传播所谓的假新闻的一个主要渠道，很多人认为这可能影响了2016年的美国总统选举。

en: The issue has also become a big political topic in Europe, with French voters deluged with false stories ahead of the presidential election in May and Germany backing a plan to fine social media networks if they fail to remove hateful postings promptly, ahead of elections there in September.
zh: Simplified Chinese：欧洲也认识到了紧缩的局限性，因此采取了不少欧洲解决方案。国民阵线在2017年或2022年的大选中获胜已不再是不可想象的事情，果真如此的话，将摧毁欧洲工程。-2.2哪怕罗塞夫被弹劾，她的继任者是否具有政治意愿和支持做出必要的经济变革也远未可知。在过去十年中，东欧和中亚国家进步抢眼，它们依靠的雄心勃勃的市场和公共部门改革。

en: On Thursday Facebook said in a separate statement in German that a test of the new fact-checking feature was being launched in the United States, France, the Netherlands and Germany.
zh: 在本周四，Facebook在德语中发布了一份独立声明称，将在美国、法国、荷兰和德国进行新事实核查功能的测试。

en: "In addition to seeing which stories are disputed by third-party fact checkers, people want more context to make informed decisions about what they read and share," said Sara Su, Facebook news feed product manager, in a blog.
zh: Facebook新闻feed产品经理萨拉·苏（Sara Su）在一篇博客中说：“除了看到第三方 fact checkers 验证的故事外，人们想要更多背景信息，以便做出明智的决定。”

en: She added that Facebook would keep testing its "related article" feature and work on other changes to its news feed to cut down on false news.
zh: Simplified Chinese：她表示Facebook将继续测试其“相关文章”功能，并在新闻feed上进行其他改动，以减少虚假新闻。

en: Building a graphic novel: A Castle in England's story
zh: 建造一个动画：一座在英格兰的故事

en: In its recent past, the diminutive Scotney Castle has featured in a Squeeze music video and been a bolthole for Margaret Thatcher during the 1970s and 1980s.
zh: 在最近的历史中，狭小的斯科蒂尼城堡（Scotney Castle）出现在一首Squeeze音乐视频中，并成为玛格丽特·撒切尔（Margaret Thatcher）的避难之所，在1970年代和1980年代。

en: But Scotney has witnessed 700 years of tumultuous history from its cosy seat in Bewl River valley in Kent, now inspiration for a graphic novel written by Jamie Rhodes, a mop-haired Yorkshireman with a penchant for historical documents.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但斯科尼已经看到了700年的动荡史，从肯特的比尔河谷坐着温暖的椅子，成为Jamie Rhodes一部关于历史文本的漫画小说的灵感。

en: "I find it so beautiful to look at the handwriting of someone who has been dead for 300 years," he says wistfully.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我发现那些已经死了三百年的人的手写是如此美丽的。

en: "What a personal connection, to hold that letter in my hand."
zh: Simplified Chinese：看来我手里握着一封信，真的是很个人化。

en: Spanning the middle ages to the Edwardian era, A Castle in England documents the families that lived in Scotney, with each story illustrated by a different, upcoming UK artist - Isaac Lenkiewicz, Briony May Smith, William Exley, Becky Palmer and Isabel Greenberg.
zh: 中世纪到爱德华时代，英国的城堡（A Castle in England）记录了在斯科蒂尼（Scotney）的家庭生活，各个故事都由不同的即将上市的英国艺术家（Isaac Lenkiewicz、Briony May Smith、William Exley、Becky Palmer和Isabel Greenberg）绘制。

en: It is not Rhodes's first book based on an archive: he also wrote 2014's Dead Men's Teeth and Other Stories, a collection inspired by documents in the British Library - a project he found unexpectedly emotional.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他不是罗德斯的第一本基于档案的书，他还写了2014年的《死人牙齿和其他故事》 ，这是一部由英国国会图书馆中的文件为灵感而成的短篇小说集—a 项目他发现意外情感深切。

en: "I welled up at just the thumbprint on the side of a letter, written by a double agent in the 1700s who was working for the Jacobites," he says.
zh: 我看到一道小印记在一封信的边缘上，写的是1700年代的一名双重间谍，他说。

en: "That's his thumbprint!
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是他的指纹！

en: And letters always smell like smoke because, back then, you lit a fire for light.
zh: letters always smell like smoke，因为当时你点燃火焰来为光。

en: To someone 300 years in the future, the smell makes it feel like they're there, too.
zh: Simplified Chinese：对于300年后的某个人来说，气味使他们感到像自己就在那里。

en: Ah, I love archives!"
zh: Simplified Chinese：啊，我爱收藏！

en: For someone so smitten with old papers, getting support from the National Trust and Arts Council England and living in a castle for almost four months ("I overstayed my welcome a little bit, to be honest") seems too good to be true.
zh: Simplified Chinese：对于如此痴迷于旧纸张的人来说，获得国家 trusts 和艺术理事会的支持，并居住在一个城堡里大约四个月（“我有点超时了，诚实地说”）似乎太过理想。

en: Rhodes spent his days exploring the Victorian "new" castle, going through the archives and studying the manor's many treasures and curios, such as the mounted hyena heads on the walls and bottles that had spent centuries in the moat.
zh: Simplified Chinese：罗得斯在日子里探索维多利亚式的“新”城堡，翻看档案室和研究城堡的很多珍贵品和奇事，如墙上的悬挂的狮子头和长达世纪的瓶子。

en: He wandered the grounds and the ruins of the old castle, talking to rangers, gardeners and sometimes the artists at work on his book's illustrations.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他漫步于古堡的grounds和废墟中，交谈了与游客、园丁和在他的书画插图上工作的艺术家。

en: Then at night, he'd "drink whiskey and get writing."
zh: Simplified Chinese：那晚他会“喝威士酒，写作”。

en: The intimate history of Scotney is relatively unknown, as the National Trust had only gained full access in 2006 when the final heir, Elizabeth Hussey, died.
zh: 斯科蒂尼（Scotney）的私人历史相对不为人知，因为直到2006年，国家 trusts获得了完全的访问权，而最后一位继承者伊丽莎白·休西（Elizabeth Hussey）去世。

en: When Rhodes arrived a decade later, staff were only starting to tackle the archive, which he describes as "hundreds of years of aristocrats going: 'Oh, stick it in the loft'."
zh: Simplified Chinese：当罗得斯十年后到来时，员工们还只刚开始处理档案，这些档案他描述为“上百年的贵族说：‘把它放在 loft里’”。

en: Diaries, letters from the days of the English empire, maps outlining who owned what: "You'd think land disputes would be boring," says Rhodes, "but there was this one birch tree two families were fighting over.
zh: 日记、英国帝国时期的信件、地图上显示谁拥有什么：“你会想，土地纷争应该很枯燥”，罗德斯说，“但有一个birch树，两家人都在争夺。

en: Just let it go, guys!"
zh: Simplified Chinese：就让它去吧！

en: Some of the stories in the collection use the castle as a jumping-off point to delve more broadly into English history, including The Labourer, which follows a man who leaves the newly built castle to join the 1381 Peasants' Revolt.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这本集中的故事中，有些故事使用了城堡作为跳出点，深入探讨英国历史，包括《劳工者》这篇小说，讲述一个离开新建的城堡加入1381年农民起义的人。

en: "There is a record of a riot happening at the castle in 1380, in this book called the Knightly Families of Kent and Sussex," says Rhodes.
zh: Simplified Chinese：据说，1380年在这个书中叫做“肯特和苏塞克斯骑士家族”的书里，有一份记录说，在城堡发生了暴动。

en: "The Peasants' Revolt started in that area and I thought, a riot is a good place to start.
zh: 农民起义在那一带开始了，我觉得暴动是一件好事。

en: Maybe the two are connected?"
zh: Simplified Chinese：或许这两者之间有联系？

en: Other stories are rooted firmly in the history of the castle - such as The Priest, which tells the tale of the Jesuit priest whom the Darrell family hid for seven years during the English Reformation.
zh: Simplified Chinese：其他故事根植于城堡的历史，例如《神父》一书，讲述了当时英格兰教会改革期间，达雷尔家族为七年 HID着一位耶稣会神父。

en: Or The Smuggler, which features 18th-century contrabander Arthur Darrell, who is thought to have staged his own funeral by filling a coffin with rocks (a discovery made years later when his coffin was unearthed).
zh: 或《海盗》这部作品，讲述了18世纪的贩运商阿瑟·达雷尔（Arthur Darrell），被认为是自己 staged funeral 的人。

en: The Darrells are Rhodes's favourite Scotney family: "The gentlemen seemed to be quite roguish, always getting into debt and spending money on things they couldn't afford.
zh: 达雷尔斯家族是罗德斯的最喜欢的斯科蒂尼家族： “他们似乎很骚乱，总是陷入债务中，并在不能承担的东西上花费钱。

en: Different generations of Darrell men solved their debt crises by marrying rich old women - I imagine them as a bunch of handsome guys, with a knack for wooing heiresses."
zh: Simplified Chinese：不同世代的达雷尔人解决了债务危机的方法是结婚富有的老年女性——我想他们像一群英俊的男士，善于追求高门贵女。

en: With his assignment in the castle over, Rhodes is on the hunt for other singular writing experiences.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他在城堡的任务完成后，罗德斯开始寻找其他独特的写作经历。

en: He has completed a two-week stint in the Finnish wilderness for a graphic novel about Elämänmäki, the site of an early 20th-century sanatorium that has since been reclaimed by nature.
zh: 他在完成了关于芬兰野外的两周探险，用于绘制关于埃拉姆纳基（Elämänmäki）的漫画书。

en: But Scotney holds a special place for him.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但斯科尼对他却有着特别的关怀。

en: "I was sad to leave," he says.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我很伤心要离开。

en: "It was like: 'Ah, I've got to go deal with fucking real life now.'"
zh: Simplified Chinese：像这样：“啊，我必须去处理 Fucking 的现实生活了。”

en: Bloomberg reporters learned that ZTE Smart Auto’s headquarters will be established in Zhuhai, and the company will be headed by Tian Wenguo, Executive Vice President of ZTE Corporation.
zh: Bloomberg记者们得知，ZTE Smart Auto的总部将在珠海设立，并由ZTE公司执行副总裁田文国领导。

en: All large energy companies are “extremely wealthy”. So which energy company in the world makes the most money?
zh: Simplified Chinese：所有大型能源公司都是“极度富有”。那么哪家能源公司在世界上赚的最多呢？

en: Yesterday, PFC Energy published its 2011 list of the Top 50 largest listed energy companies. US oil and gas producer ExxonMobil retained its top position with a market valuation of US$406.3 billion, closely followed by PetroChina and Royal Dutch Shell.
zh: 昨天，PFC Energy 发布了2011年最大的上市能源公司名单。美国石油和气体生产商埃克森摩尔在市场价值达到 406.3 亿美元后再次占据首位，紧随其后的是石油中国和皇家荷兰石油。

en: PetroChina topped the PFC rankings twice in 2007 and 2009, while ExxonMobil ranked first place position for the other years.
zh: Simplified Chinese：石油中国在2007年和2009年两次夺得PFC排名第一，埃克森摩尔则以其他年份的首位位置。

en: Three companies from Mainland China made the 2011 Top 50 list. In addition 2nd place PetroChina, Sinopec and CNOOC were ranked 9th and 15th, respectively.
zh: 三家公司来自中国大陆进入了2011年top 50名。另外，第2名的石油中国、四化石油和中诺号排名第九和第十五。

en: According to PFC’s statistics, ... Nonetheless, although current oil prices are far higher than that four years ago, PFC Energy’s CEO said that the lower combined market valuation was attributable to a number of factors, including lower North American natural gas prices, and less buoyant global stock markets.
zh: 根据PFC的统计数据，... 不过，尽管当前石油价格远高于四年前，但PFC能源 CEO表示，低合并市场价值主要是由多种因素推动的，包括北美天然气价格下降，以及全球股市表现较为平淡。

en: Xinhua News Agency reported that heavily polluted weather will descend on Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei and surrounding regions from the 16th and worsen by the 19th. The AQI of three cities in Hebei, namely Shijiazhuang, Xinji and Handan, will be dramatically high.
zh: 新华社报道，北京、天津、河北和周边地区将于16号开始受到严重污染的气候，到19号日会更加严重。河北省三座城市——石家庄、辛集和邯登的空气质量指数将大幅升高。

en: Washington Changes the Green Card Rules
zh: Simplified Chinese：华盛顿改变了绿卡规定

en: There is going to be new US immigration plan to modify Green Card rules, President Donald Trump said, quoted by the media.
zh: 美国将推出新的移民政策，修改绿卡规定，这是总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）在媒体报道中说过的。

en: It envisages reducing legal immigrants to 50,000 per year, stricter rules for obtaining temporary work visas and restrictions on family-oriented visas.
zh: envisioning 每年移民人数减少到 5 万，获得暂时工作签证的规定变得更严格，限制家庭型签证。

en: The new rules are proposed by the Republicans and are supported by the president.
zh: Simplified Chinese：新规则由共和党提出了，并且由总统支持。

en: The draft law is due to be discussed in the two chambers of Congress.
zh: 立法草案将在国会两院进行讨论。

en: "This law will reduce poverty, raise wages and save billions of dollars for taxpayers, and will do this by changing the way the US issues Green Cards to citizens from other countries.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这项法律不仅可以减少贫困，提高工资，还能节省数十亿美元的税收资金，并且通过改变美国向来自其他国家的公民发放绿卡的方式来实现这一点。

en: The law will reduce chain migration and replace the current scheme.
zh: Simplified Chinese：法律将减少链式移民，取代现行方案。

en: This new application process will benefit candidates who speak English, have financial resources to support themselves and show skills that will benefit our economy," said Trump, quoted by the American media.
zh: 这个新申请流程将会对那些能说英语、有足够的财务资源支持自己并展示将对我们的经济产生积极影响的候选人有益。

en: The inaugural China Fireworks and Firecracker Safety and Environmental Protection Expo will be held in Liuyang on May 29.
zh: 第一届中国烟火安全和环境保护展会将于5月29日在淀江举行。

en: The two-day event will be focused on the theme “Technology, Safety, Environmental Protection”. Then, the most advanced fireworks and firecracker machinery, the safest and most environmental friendly fireworks and firecracker raw and auxiliary materials as well as new products in China’s fireworks and firecracker industry will gather at Liuyang.
zh: 两天的活动将聚焦于主题“技术、安全、环境保护”。然后，中国火works和烟花行业最先进的爆炸器材、最安全且环保友好的爆炸器材原料和辅助材料以及新产品将在湖南醴阳集结。

en: A large number of experts and entrepreneurs will be invited to this Expo to carry out academic exchanges in the fireworks and firecracker industry, and to share the latest technological achievements on fireworks and firecracker safety and environmental protection.
zh: 大量专家和企业家将会被邀请到此expo，进行火works和烟花行业的学术交流，并分享最新的火works和烟花安全性和环境保护技术。

en: In particular, the exhibition for mechanized equipment for the production of fireworks and firecrackers as well as safe and eco-friendly products will be held at Dayao Town. Key exhibits include technologically sophisticated mechanical equipment that uses explosive substances to produce fireworks and firecrackers that have been appraised by relevant technology and passed safety verification; low sensitivity, low blast and other safe pyrotechnic compositions; as well as sulfur-free, light smoke and other safe and eco-friendly personal fireworks and firecrackers.
zh: Simplified Chinese：特别是，爆炸物质生产火work和烟花的机械设备以及安全、环保的产品展览将在Dayao Town举办。重点展品包括使用爆炸性物质生产出经过相关技术评估并通过安全验证的 fireworks 和 firecrackers 的高科技机械设备；低敏感度、低爆炸力等安全 pyrotechnic 组成；以及硫化物-free、轻烟和其他安全环保的个人 fireworks 和 firecrackers。

en: Meanwhile, safe and eco-friendly fireworks and firecracker products used for fireworks displays collectively sponsored by 16 Liuyang fireworks enterprises will be carried out in two phases - product selection and product fireworks display. Excellent new products that passed the early stage of the competition will be used for the fireworks displays at the Liuyang Fireworks Viewing Platform and the Gold Beach Display Site on May 29.
zh: 同时，安全环保的烟花和爆竹产品，由16家联阳烟火企业联合赞助的烟花表演中使用的总体会分为两个阶段——产品选择和产品烟花表演。早期竞争阶段通过的优秀新品将于5月29日在联阳烟花观展平台和金滩表演场景中进行烟花表演。

en: When 2017, which was just around the corner, was mentioned, Zhao Lei said, “After the tour ends next year, I want to go away and be alone to take stock for a while, and write more new works.”
zh: Simplified Chinese：当2017年提到时，赵雷说，“下一年结束后，我想独自离开去一段时间，重新回顾一下，然后写更多的新作品”。

en: For the purposes of optimizing the environment of scenic areas, and building a beautify Nanyue, the “636” voluntary service team of the Nanyue District Tobacco Monopoly Administration (Branch Company) carried out a “hiking to protect our forests and love our hometown” environmental protection event.
zh: 为了优化风景区环境，建立美丽的南 Yue，南 Yue区烟草专卖局（分公司）“636”自愿服务团队组织了“保护我们的森林和爱我们的故乡”的环保活动。

en: The event received the support of all the cadres and staff of the district Tobacco Administration, and also attracted retired cadres as well as the staff’s families, who came to participate in the environmental protection activities. Three generations of people from the elderly to children worked together, hiked up the mountain to protect the forests, and cleaned up rubbish, contributing their own effort to building a “beautiful Nanyue”.
zh: 事件获得了地区烟草管理局所有干部和员工的支持，并且也吸引了退休干部以及员工家庭，来参加环境保护活动。从老年人到小孩三代人一起工作，登山保护森林，清理垃圾，为建造“美丽的南 Yue”贡献自己的努力。

en: This voluntary service event was aimed at protecting the scenic resources of Nanyue, and propagating the voluntary service concept of “care for others, care for society, and care for nature”. It also served to teach and pass on to the next generation the virtue of voluntary service.
zh: 这个自愿服务活动的目的是保护南 Yue 的景观资源，并推广自愿服务的概念，即“关心他人、关心社会和关心自然”。它也为下一代传递了自愿服务的美德。

en: It is understood that since the “636” voluntary service team was founded in early April this year, the 16 members have carried out a series of voluntary service activities including visiting needy retail customers, helping tobacco farmers care for tobacco leaves, and making donations to the Ya’an earthquake victims, and have become a team of committed voluntary service activists that convey positive energy from their hearts.
zh: 自从“636”志愿服务团于今年四月初成立以来，16名成员已开展了一系列的志愿活动，包括为需要帮助的零售客户提供服务、帮助烟草农民照顾烟草叶子以及捐赠地震受害者，成为一支充满热情的志愿服务团体。

en: In the eyes of reporters who have been reporting on table tennis and badminton all year long, “Tibetan mastiff” Zhang Jike has already had the potential to become the next Lin Dan.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在报道桌球和乒乓球一年多的记者眼里，“藏族犬”张杰已经有了成为下一代林丹的潜力。

en: The Information Office of the Ministry of National Defense revealed that upon friendly consultations, China and the US successfully completed the transfer of the US unmanned undersea vehicle at the relevant region in the South China Sea on the afternoon of December 20.
zh: 中国国防部信息办公室透露，友好consultation后，中国和美国成功完成了在南海南方地区的无人机潜水车的转移于12月20日下午。

en: The rise of sex robots is real, and we should be concerned
zh: Simplified Chinese：性robots的兴起是真实的，我们应该关注这个问题。

en: Just when you thought 2017 couldn't get any weirder along comes a new report on the technological developments in the sex robot sector.
zh: Simplified Chinese：正当你以为2017年已经很奇怪的时候，突然又出了一份关于性 robots技术发展的报告。

en: Yep.
zh: Simplified Chinese：是的。

en: Sex robots are a big deal right now.
zh: 性爱机器人现在是一个很大的问题。

en: Recently, the Foundation for Responsible Robotics (FRR) released a report looking at the development of sex robots over the next five to 10 years.
zh: 最近，负责负责任机器人（Foundation for Responsible Robotics）发布了一份报告，关注了未来五年到十年的性机器人发展。

en: According to Noel Sharkey, emeritus professor of robotics and artificial intelligence at the University of Sheffield and co-founder of the FRR, we need to start taking their rise seriously.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根据诺埃尔·沙克利的说法，谢菲尔德大学robotics和人工智能教授（emeritus）和FRR联合创始人，我们需要开始认真对待他们的兴起。

en: Customers can choose the robot's eye colour, nipple shape and fingernail type.
zh: Simplified Chinese：客户可以选择机器人眼睛的颜色、乳头形状和指甲类型。

en: "People snigger about them, but the companies are actually shipping quite a lot and we are going to see them a lot more," Mr Sharkey said at the launch of the new report.
zh: Simplified Chinese：人们嘲笑他们，但实际上公司正在大量运输，我们将看到更多这样的情况，Mr. Sharkey在新报告发布时说。

en: Modern sex dolls have evolved out of their blow-up counterparts into robots with a silicon skin that is warm to the touch - with deliberately human-like responses achieved by artificial intelligence.
zh: Simplified Chinese：现代性doll的发展已经超越了其充气的对应者，成为具有silicon皮肤的机器人，具有人工智能的故意模仿人类反应。

en: The user can also "customise" their robot to suit their persuasions, choosing everything from the robot's eye colour, nipple shape to fingernail type or colour.
zh: Simplified Chinese：用户还可以根据自己的偏好“定制”自己的机器人，选择从机器人的眼色、乳头形状到指甲颜色或类型。

en: But it gets even more disturbing, with many of the robots possessing "personalities" that would make a Stepford Wife look progressive.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但这还更令人不安，许多机器人拥有“个性”使得一位步夫妻看起来是进步的。

en: Modern sex dolls have evolved into robots with a silicon skin.
zh: 现代性doll已经演变成具有silicon皮肤的机器人。

en: The RealBotix robot, for example, allows users to customise their robots according to the traits they find appealing, such as shyness.
zh: Simplified Chinese：RealBotix机器人，例如，允许用户根据他们喜欢的特质来定制机器人，比如羞怯。

en: Then there are the Roxxxy Gold sex robots, developed by True Companion, which come with pre-programmed personalities, including "Frigid Farrah" that gives the impression of shyness and "Wild Wendy" with an "adventurous" personality.
zh: Simplified Chinese：然后就有罗克斯基·金色性robots，True Companion开发的，这些 robots 有预设的人格，包括“冷 FARAH”给人的印象是 bashy 和 “野野心”WENDY 的人格。

en: "Roxxxy Gold has a personality which is matched as much as possible to your personality," the True Companion website enthuses.
zh: Simplified Chinese：罗克斯基·金的个性与你的个性相匹配到最大程度，真伴网站如此激动。

en: So she likes what you like, dislikes what you dislike, etc.
zh: Simplified Chinese：所以她喜欢你喜欢的东西，讨厌你讨厌的东西等。

en: She also has moods during the day just like real people!
zh: Simplified Chinese：她也会在一天中出现不同的情绪，像真正的人一样。

en: She can be sleepy, conversational or she can 'be in the mood'!"
zh: 她可以嗜睡、交谈，也可以“在情绪上”！

en: There are many disturbing aspects to the rise of sex robots - not least of which is the replacement of real, human relationships - but the subservient female traits, the rapey connotations of making a move on Frigid (read: resistant) Farrah, are the most concerning.
zh: Simplified Chinese：性robots的兴起有很多令人不安的事实，但其中最值得关注的是，人工智能取代了真实的人类关系，而那些被视为 subservient 的女性特征，以及在 Frigid（也就是抵抗性的）Farrah 上做出任何moves 的含义是最令人担忧的。

en: On its website, True Companion likened Roxxxy to a vibrator, but for men.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在其网站上，True Companion将Roxxxy与男性使用的振动器相似。

en: "If woman (sic) can have a vibrator, why can't men have a Roxxxy?" the website states.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果女性可以拥有振动器，为什么男性就不能拥有罗克斯基（Roxxxy）？

en: However, these sex robots are not a mere fetish or just another sex toy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：然而，这些性robots并不是仅仅是一种性癖或另一种性玩具。

en: Their emergence and increasing sophistication points to something darker and deeper within our culture, a retreat from the ideal of gender equality toward a desire for sex with subjugation as an optional add-on.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们的出现和发展越来越复杂，表明了我们文化中更深层次的问题——一种从性别平等理想退一步，追求性行为的压迫性附加。

en: Most men, naturally, are not going to keep sex robots, and while the FRR noted their increasing popularity, they remain, for now, on the outskirts of consumer culture.
zh: Simplified Chinese：大多数男性，自然而然，不太可能拥有性机器人，而FRR注意到这种趋势的增加，但目前仍处于消费文化的边缘。

en: But what seeps in from the fringes can be highly instructive as to the tenor of the era we're living in.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但是从边缘处渗透出来的东西，能够非常有益地教导我们关于我们生活在什么时代的本质。

en: And many people aren't weird or offensive until the free market gives them the permission to be so.
zh: Simplified Chinese：很多人直到自由市场给他们开了绿灯，才变得奇怪或冒犯。

en: There is little coincidence that these sophisticated sex robots have emerged at a time when women's rights are under threat across the globe, when there is a president in the White House who has bragged about sexually assaulting women.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在女性权利面临全球威胁的同时，高级性robots也出现在了人们面前。

en: The most chilling aspect of the TV series The Handmaid's Tale isn't the graphic imagery, the noosed bodies and gouged eyes, but just how realistic that vision feels.
zh: Simplified Chinese：手maid的故事中最令人寒心的方面并不是那些血腥图像、被绳子勒死的身躯和眼睑凹陷的眼睛，而是这种想法看起来多么真实。

en: The Republic of Gilead is a leap, but, right now, it doesn't feel like a large one.
zh: Simplified Chinese：共和国吉列亚的革命是一个跳跃，但现在它还不像一个大跳跃。

en: The aim behind these sex robots is to create as much of a physical likeness to actual women (albeit with porn star proportions) as technologically possible.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这些性robots的目标是尽可能地模仿实际女性（尽管使用了色情演员比例），在技术上做到最大限度。

en: Their creators want them to feel human to the touch, for them to mimic the movement of a real body.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们的创造者希望它们能够让人通过触摸感到人类，模仿一个真正人的运动。

en: But, pointedly, when it comes to their "personalities" the robots do not represent real women.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但，明显的是，当它来到他们的“个性”时，机器人并不是真实的女性。

en: They cannot break up with their companion, or walk out.
zh: 他们不能与伴侣分手，也不能离开。

en: They have no agency or back-story, nothing to suggest independence or anything that may disrupt the fantasy of total servitude.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们没有任何代理或 backstory，什么也不能表明独立或者可能破坏服务幻想的任何东西。

en: They are pleasant slaves, in other words.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他们是有益的奴隶，换句话说。

en: Or to put it into 2017 parlance: handmaidens.
zh: Simplified Chinese：或者用2017年的语言来说：女婢

en: “The Great Wall” tells the story of a Chinese elite troop in ancient times that battled valiantly against the monster Taotie on the world renowned Great Wall of China.
zh: Simplified Chinese：《长城》讲述了古代中国精英部队在抗击世界著名的中国长城上的monster Taotie。

en: The last episode of “Hurry Up, Brother” Season 4 has been recorded. Deng Chao, leader of the “Running Man Team” was interviewed via WeChat by the reporters of Shenyang Evening News and syd.com on May 30. From “Super Scholar” in “Running Man” to “Funny Villain” in “Devil and Angel” to “Decadent Guy” Chen Mo, the impression Deng Chao gives to the audience is that of a “flexible transformer”, constantly changing.
zh: 最后一集的“快乐大 Brother”第四季的录制已经完成。《快乐大 Brother》团队的领袖邓超在5月30日接受了沈阳晚报和syd.com的记者通过微信采访。从《超级学霸》到《devil and angel》中的“笑点王”到《 decadent guy》陈莫，邓超对观众的印象是“灵活变形机”，不断变化。

en: Deng Chao said, “I won’t do the same thing over and over again in my acting career. I want to renew myself constantly.”
zh: Simplified Chinese：邓超说：“我不会在我的演员生涯中重复同样的东西。我想不断更新自己。”

en: Trump's great feat?
zh: Simplified Chinese：特朗普的伟大成就？

en: Making Mitt Romney seem the epitome of common sense
zh: Simplified Chinese：让密特·罗姆尼成为普通人的典型

en: It has become a truism of the Trump era that the political divisions that have polarised the US electorate have, on a micro-scale, torn families apart.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在特朗普时代，政治分裂已经成为一种真理，即微观上的分裂导致了家庭的分离。

en: Around Christmas and Thanksgiving, newspapers in the US abounded with advice columns on how to deal with the horror of Trump-voting relatives.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在圣诞节和感恩节期间，美国的报纸充满了关于如何处理特朗普投票亲人恐怖的建议栏目。

en: We are all supposedly straining to burst our filter bubbles.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们都被假设在努力破裂我们的过滤泡沫。

en: Less remarked on is the power of Trump to bring families together.
zh: Simplified Chinese：人们很少提到特朗普的能力是如何让家庭团聚。

en: I mention this because my cousin, a left-leaning poet who lives in Chicago and who's long been at loggerheads with Republicans in our family, has been visiting me in New York this week.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我提到这一点，因为我的表弟，一个左翼诗人，他住在芝加哥，长期与我们的共和党成员发生冲突，我们这周他来到了纽约。

en: She reminded me that unity against a common enemy can have a powerful effect.
zh: Simplified Chinese：她告诉我，面对共同敌人的团结可以产生强大的影响。

en: With Trump in the White House, everyone she knows, including the Republican sibling she had been bickering with about politics for decades, is suddenly and peculiarly on the same side.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当特朗普在白宫里时，所有她知道的人，包括她多年争论政治的共和党兄弟姐妹，现在都突然和奇怪地站在同一边。

en: Around the dinner table this is surely a good thing; but it strikes me that, in a broader context, it carries significant risks.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在餐桌上，这是肯定是一个好事；但我认为，在更广泛的背景下，它带来了一定的风险。

en: The left has been invigorated by Trump, but the warping effect of his presidency has the power to push us all rightwards.
zh: Simplified Chinese：左翼被特朗普激发了活力，但他的总统任期的弯曲效应有能力推动我们所有人向右转。

en: When we talk about "normalisation" and Trump, we are referring to the scary possibility that his antics may one day cease to appal.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当我们谈论“正常化”和特朗普时，我们是指他可能会有一天不再引人恐惧。

en: There is an even scarier long-range scenario, however, in which what Trump "normalises" are rightwing Republicans who, held up against his standards, suddenly seem the epitome of reasonable.
zh: Simplified Chinese：然而，甚至更令人毛骨耸然的远程场景是，特朗普“正常化”的右翼共和党人，他们在他标准下突然变得非常合理。

en: I find myself actively nostalgic these days for Mitt Romney's quaint version of crazy - the dog on the car roof, the 14% income tax (but at least we knew what his tax return looked like) - both of which, compared to Trump, seem very mild offences indeed.
zh: Simplified Chinese：我最近对米特·罗姆尼（Mitt Romney）古典的疯狂版本感到怀念，例如狗在车顶、14%的收入税（至少我们知道他的税表是什么样）-与特朗普相比，这些都是相当温和的罪行。

en: When Trump goes, the next Republican candidate will merely have to be sane to qualify as an immeasurable improvement.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当特朗普离开时，下一个共和党候选人只需要保持正常状态，就可以被视为无可比拟的改进。

en: While my cousin was in town, we took our kids to the carousel in Central Park, the biggest of the carousels run by the New York parks department, and the best three bucks you can spend in the city if you don't require caffeine.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当我表弟在这座城市里时，我们带着孩子们去中央公园的马车上，中央公园最大的马车，是由纽约公园管理局经营的，最便宜的三美元可以在这个城市中买到，如果你不需要咖啡。

en: The horses are thunderously huge, the fibre-glass designs on the central cylinder - all gurning clowns and animals twisting to look over their own shoulders in terror - utterly sinister, and the tinkling music oddly transporting.
zh: Simplified Chinese：马匹的体型巨大，中间柱上的纤维玻璃设计 – 都是扭着看后背的恐惧和面具般的笑容，总是让人感到可怕。

en: So many of the cliches of a city disappoint: views from tall buildings get old, skylines grow too familiar to offer much of a thrill, and the reality of the city doesn't live up to the dream.
zh: Simplified Chinese：那么，城市的很多常识都让人失望：高楼上的视角会老化，天线变得过于熟悉，无法给人带来太多刺激，而城市现实与梦想之间的差距也不会减小。

en: Thirty-five years later and I'm still not entirely over the day I discovered Swiss Cottage is not, in fact, a Swiss cottage - the theme pub, Ye Olde Swiss Cottage, doesn't count - but a large roundabout in north London.
zh: 三十五年后，我仍然没有完全消除我发现瑞士小屋不是真正的瑞士小屋——而实际上是一座主题酒馆“耶·奥尔德·瑞士小屋”（Ye Olde Swiss Cottage），但其实是一个北伦敦的大圆abouts的事。

en: The Central Park carousel, however, is still a weirdly magical experience, to the extent that two two-year-olds, an 11-year-old and two women in their 40s can go on it and all have a great time.
zh: 中央公园马车旋转台，尽管如此仍然是一个奇怪而神秘的体验，到得 extent 两个两岁的孩子、一个11岁的孩子和两个40多岁的女性都可以上去享受。

en: If I could have rated the carousel I would have given it full marks, but thankfully nobody asked.
zh: Simplified Chinese：如果我能给旋转车评分的话，我会给它满分，但幸好没有人问。

en: In a department store this week, on the other hand, I was required, before swiping my credit card, to rate my transactional "experience" on a scale of one to five stars.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在一家商店里，这个星期，我另一方面需要在刷信用卡之前，评估我的“交易体验”在五星级的等级上。

en: In the coffee shop at the corner of my street it's the same thing, plus the option to match the rating with a 15% tip - this for buying something over the counter.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在我街角的咖啡店里，这也一样，除了可以根据评分选择15％的补贴，这是为了购买物品时。

en: The effect of this is not only to slow down what should be a neutral exchange, but to put pressure on the server to inject personality into a situation where none is required.
zh: Simplified Chinese：此影响不仅会减缓应该是中立的交易速度，而且还会使服务器施加压力，将非必要的人格注入一个没有人格需要的情况。

en: The poor woman in the department store stood grinning apologetically while, wearily, I gave the experience of handing her my credit card five stars.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在商店的贫穷女性面对着一张笑容，而我疲惫地给了她手上我的信用卡五星。

en: Oscar Pistorius taken from jail to hospital with chest pains
zh: 奥斯卡·皮斯特里乌斯从监狱中被送往医院，胸痛

en: This is the second time Pistorius has left jail for a hospital visit.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这是彼斯特里乌斯第二次离开监狱去看病。

en: Last year he was taken to the hospital for treatment to cuts on his wrists, which prison authorities said he sustained after falling in his cell.
zh: Simplified Chinese：去年他因手腕切口被送往医院治疗，监狱管理人员说，他是在他的细胞里跌倒后受伤的。

en: Pistorius was convicted of murder after an appeal by prosecutors against an initial manslaughter verdict.
zh: 本案的定罪是由检察官对初步判决为杀人未成就罪（manslaughter）的上诉所致。

en: He killed Steenkamp in the early hours of Valentine's Day 2013 by shooting her multiple times through a toilet cubicle door at his Pretoria home.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他在2013年圣 Valentine的早晨，通过射击她多次从浴室隔间门中射杀了斯坦克amp。

en: Pistorius claimed he mistook his girlfriend for a nighttime intruder hiding in the cubicle.
zh: Simplified Chinese：波斯蒂里乌斯声称，他误认为自己的女朋友是夜间侵入者躲在小隔室中。

en: Prosecutors have announced their intention to appeal again, this time against Pistorius' six-year sentence, which they say is too lenient.
zh: 检察官宣布再次提出上诉， 이번次是针对普利斯托里乌斯六年定罪的决定，他们认为太过宽容。

en: The National Prosecuting Authority said it will appeal to South Africa's Supreme Court, and the appeal could be heard this year.
zh: Simplified Chinese：国家检察院表示将向南非最高法院提出上诉，上诉可能在今年听取。

en: Pistorius faces having his sentence increased to 15 years if prosecutors are successful.
zh: Simplified Chinese：皮卡索斯面临着如果检察官成功的话，他的刑期将会增加到15年。

en: There is no death penalty in South Africa.
zh: Simplified Chinese：南非没有死刑。

en: Given the general financial and economic environment, alcohol related e-commerce merchants are holding fast to upstream resources while actively planning their own brands so as to seek breakthroughs in performance.
zh: Simplified Chinese：基于总体的财务和经济环境，酒类相关的电子商务商家正在坚持上游资源，同时积极规划自己的品牌，以寻求性能突破。

en: Chen Haifeng, a 26-year old actor with the Wenzhou Yue Opera Troupe, is the only female in the class who plays a painted face character.
zh: Simplified Chinese：陈海峰，26岁的演员，属于温州越剧团，是唯一一位在班级中扮演有面 paint 的女生。

en: Two Bulgarians Were Detained For Illegal Camping in Greece
zh: 两名保加利人因在希腊非法露营而被拘留。

en: Two Bulgarians were detained for illegal camping in Greece, the Foreign Affairs Ministry announced, quoted by bTV.
zh: Simplified Chinese：两名保加利人因在希腊非法露营而被拘留，外交部公布，据bTV报道。

en: A group of illegally camping people, including the two Bulgarians, was detained by the police in Sithonia in the morning of August 1.
zh: 一群非法露营的人，包括两名保加利人，被警察在8月1日上午的斯蒂诺尼亚拘留。

en: The same day they were released, while an investigation is currently underway.
zh: Simplified Chinese：同一天他们发布后，正在进行调查。

en: The ministry of foreign affairs reported bTV that Bulgarians were later released.
zh: 外交部报告称，保加利亚人后来被释放。

en: The Greek authorities have tightened control over free camping and are already imposing serious fines on anyone who is caught resting in a place not intended for the purpose.
zh: 希腊当局已经加强了自由露营的控制，并且正在对未经意图停留的地方处罚严重的罚款。

en: Checks will continue throughout the season.
zh: Simplified Chinese：检查将继续整个赛季。

en: The ministry said that the court may impose a fine.
zh: Simplified Chinese：政府表示法院可能会对其进行处罚。

en: On May 18, the Ministry of Finance issued the “Administrative Measures for Special Rewards and Subsidies for the Structural Adjustments of Industrial Enterprises”, and will arrange special rewards and subsidies amounting to a total of RMB100 billion to help advance reduction of overcapacity in the coal and steel industries.
zh: May 18日，财政部发布了《特殊奖励和补贴管理条例》，将总计1000亿人民币的特殊奖励和补贴安排用于帮助煤炭和钢铁行业的过剩产能减少。

en: Recently, many local governments including that of Shanghai, Shanxi, Shandong, Jiangsu and Heilongjiang have proposed reform opinions on reducing overcapacity.
zh: Simplified Chinese：近期，上海、山西、山东、江苏和黑龙江等地的多个地方政府都提出减少过度产能的改革意见。

en: In particular, many provinces have even proposed to actively lobby the Central Government for fiscal support to reduce overcapacity in their respective provinces.
zh: Simplified Chinese：特别是，许多省份甚至提出了积极向中央政府lobby财政支持，以减少他们各自省份的过剩产能。

en: One proof is that the overcapacity reduction target for coal announced by a mere eight provinces already account for 90% of the coal overcapacity reduction plan nationwide.
zh: Simplified Chinese：一方面，仅八省的煤炭过剩减量目标已经占全国煤炭过剩减量计划的90%。

en: At an interview with reporters, Lin Boqiang, Dean of China Institute for Studies in Energy Policy at Xiamen University, believed that merely relying on the Central government’s RMB100 billion to “reduce overcapacity” in the steel and coal industries is far from sufficient. More funds should come from local governments and enterprises. How should that be done?
zh: Simplified Chinese：在采访记者时，林博强，厦门大学中国能源政策研究院院长，认为仅凭中央政府的100亿人民币来“减少过剩产能”在钢铁和煤炭行业是远远不够的。更需要从地方政府和企业中获取资金。如何实现这个目标呢？

en: In the detailed implementation rules for reducing surplus coal capacity issued recently by Shanxi Province, it was proposed that Shanxi Coking Coal Group should be restructured and transformed into a state-owned capital investment company, its assets and businesses should be reorganized and consolidated, and a new business model constructed.
zh: Recently, Shanxi Province issued detailed implementation rules for reducing surplus coal capacity, proposing the restructuring and transformation of Shanxi Coking Coal Group into a state-owned capital investment company, reorganizing its assets and businesses, and constructing a new business model。

en: The actual funding gap could be 3 times that of the subsidy. Earlier, Yin Weimin, Minister of Human Resources and Social Security, said that initial calculations showed that a total of 1.3 million employees in the coal industry and 500,000 in the steel industry were required to be resettled as a result of “reducing overcapacity”.
zh: 实际的资金短缺可能是补贴的三倍。早期， Yin Weimin 人力资源和社会保障部部长表示，初步计算显示，由于“减少过剩产能”，总共需要1.3万名煤炭行业员工和5万名钢铁行业员工进行重新定居。

en: Nanfang Daily news (Reporter/Xie Qingyu) The reporter learned from the provincial environmental protection office today that the 2012 results of the environmental protection credit rating of key sources of pollution are being published.
zh:
Simplfied Chinese:
南方日报新闻（记者/谢青愉） 
记者从今天的省级环境保护办公室了解到，2012年环境保护信用评分的主要污染源结果正在发布。

en: Ratings showed that of the 1,251 enterprises listed on the environmental protection credit management register, 134 were not rated temporarily because of production stoppage, not having been checked and accepted, having been shut down, and/or other reasons.
