zh: Simplified Chinese：与发达国家相比，中国大多数制造业企业仍在采用产品为导的策略。这种方法不仅无法满足客户需求，而且也影响和限制了中国制造业从国内外竞争中受益。

en: I would like to take this opportunity to offer New Year blessings to all citizens of the country, as well as to our fellow country people in the Hong Kong SAR, the Macau SAR and in Taiwan as well as Chinese nationals residing overseas!
zh: 我想在此机会上向本国公民以及香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区和台湾同胞，以及在海外居住的中国人致以新年祝福。

en: The Ministry of Education said that 90% of these students study in English language countries, such as the US, UK and Australia; 70% are pursuing at least a bachelor’s degree.
zh: 教育部表示，90%的学生都在英语语言国家学习，如美国、英国和澳大利亚；70%正在追求至少一学士学位。

en: Today, thanks to the the hard work of the government and all sectors of the community, the protection of ancient villages has become a consensus in general.
zh: 今天，由于政府和整个社会各个部门的努力，保护古村庄的保护已成为普遍共识。

en: There has been further development in the criminal case of Chinese scholar Zhang Yingying who was murdered in the US.
zh: Simplified Chinese：关于中国学者张英英被杀案的进一步发展。

en: It is understood that a major highlight of the China-EU Tourism Year is to recommend unknown European tourist attractions to Chinese tourists.
zh: Simplified Chinese：据了解，中国与欧盟旅游年的一大亮点是推荐未知的欧洲游客景点给中国游客。

en: The 19th CPC National Congress pointed out that protecting and improving people’s livelihood must entail grasping the most direct and most practical issues of interests that citizens are most concerned with.
zh: Simplified Chinese：第十九届中国共产党全国代表大会指出，保护和改善人民生活必然涉及抓住公民最关心的利益问题。

en: China has always played an active and positive role in regional cooperation, which is well recognized by regional countries.
zh: 中国一直在地区合作中发挥着积极和积极的作用，这是地区国家广泛认可的。

en: According to internationally accepted standards on aging, a country or region where the share of the population aged 60 and above accounts for 10% or those aged 65 and above account for 7%, is an aging society.
zh: Simplified Chinese：根据国际接受的老龄化标准，人口中60岁以上的人口占比为10％或65岁以上的人口占比为7％的国家或地区被认为是老龄化社会。

en: There are also negatives related to this education method, including placing physically disabled children in a comparatively isolated environment while growing up. This would impair their ability to integrate into society. More importantly, it would affect the formation of a healthy personality for these children.
zh: Simplified Chinese：同时，这种教育方法也存在负面影响，例如将身体障碍的孩子置于相对孤立的环境中长大，从而影响他们与社会融合的能力。更重要的是，这会影响这些孩子形成健康个性的过程。

en: National defense mobilization is an important link in converting and transferring combat potential into combat competence.
zh: Simplified Chinese：国家防御动员是将战斗力转化为战斗能力的重要连接。

en: Xi Jinping, in a telephone conversation with Trump on the 16th, briefed the latter on his view of the current situation in the Korean peninsular, and pointed out some of the positive changes that have taken place in the peninsular.
zh: 习近平在与特朗普的电话会谈中，16日 briefing 特朗普关于朝鲜半岛当前情况的看法，并指出半岛出现了一些积极变化。

en: Potential risk of conflict in cross-Strait relations would significantly affect the confidence of enterprises looking to invest in Taiwan. Inadequate investment would result in weaker economic growth, which would in turn lead to less employment opportunities, low wages and a series of other issues related to people’s livelihood.
zh: 台湾投资企业的信心会受到两岸关系冲突的潜在风险的重大影响。投资不足将导致经济增长较弱，从而导致就业机会减少，工资低下以及与人民生活相关的一系列问题。

en: For days, relevant departments in the counties have provided 2.838 million RMB of bursaries for over 690 college students from poor families.
zh: Simplified Chinese：近日，县级相关部门为贫困家庭的学生提供了2.838万人民币的奖学金。

en: A fishing vessel sank in the waters near Hong Kong on the night of the 20th after colliding with a cargo vessel. After nearly a day of search and rescue, seven crew members are still missing.
zh: 海上渔船在香港附近的水域晚间发生事故，撞击货运船后沉没。近一天的搜索救援后，仍有七名船员失踪。

en: UK Prime Minister Theresa May made a pledge to the public on the 11th that the UK government will implement a 25-year plan, and will eradicate avoidable plastic waste pollution by 2042.
zh: Simplified Chinese：英国首相特蕾莎·梅在11日向公众宣布，英国政府将实施一个25年的计划，并在2042年消除可避免的塑料污染。

en: Brazil has now attracted the attention of the international oil industry on the back of rich pre-salt oil deposits.
zh: Simplified Chinese：巴西现在吸引了国际石油行业的关注，主要是因为其富有预_salt 石油储备。

en: Zhang Xiang, who was born in Mainland China, will soon be appointed President of the University of Hong Kong. News of the appointment drew heated debate as soon as it was released.
zh: 张翔，出生在大陆中国，将很快被任命为香港大学总统。关于任命的新闻一旦发布，就引发了强烈的争论。

en: Analysts said that aginst the backdrop of rising anti-globalization and protectionism, constructing a comprehensive and high-quality Asia-Pacific Free Trade Zone will inject new impetus into achieving a unified Asia-Pacific regional economy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：分析师表示，在全球化和保护主义的背景下，建立一个全面高质量的亚太自由贸易区将会注入实现统一的亚太地区经济的新动力。

en: Microsoft will convert all Chinese language supported research models into product-oriented core technology, and develop a predictive Swiftkey Chinese smart keyboard.
zh: Simplified Chinese：微软将所有支持中文语言的研究模型转换为产品导向核心技术，并开发出预测性Swiftkey中文智能键盘。

en: The western migration of the ancient Yuezhi (or Rouzhi) people to Central Asia is a major event in the history of the Silk Route. For a long time, Chinese and foreign academics have long held various different views about the hometown of the Yuezhi people before the western migration.
zh: 西方的古代ユーゼジ（或ルウジ）人向中亚迁移是一个丝绸之路史上的重大事件。长期以来，中国和外国学者一直持有关于ユーゼジ人的故乡在西方迁移之前的各种不同观点。

en: Using CRISPR genome editing technology to treat cancer has been recognized as a revolutionary cancer treatment.
zh: Simplified Chinese：使用CRISPR基因组编辑技术治疗癌症已被认可为革命性的癌症治疗。

en: German researchers, experimenting on mice, have found that the immune system, in addition to playing a defensive role, could also assist in the formation of cancer.
zh: Simplified Chinese：德国研究人员在实验室中对小鼠进行试验后发现，免疫系统除了防御作用外，还能帮助形成癌症。

en: The foundation of both Alipay and WeChat Pay is the QR Code. The amount of information these tiny black-and-white squares can store is more than 300 times that of a one-digit code.
zh: QR码是两家支付平台的基础，一个小黑白方块可以存储超过三百个数字。

en: Avandia, which debuted in 1999, is an “insulin sensitizer”, used for treating Type 2 diabetes.
zh: Simplified Chinese：阿瓦尼达，于1999年首次上市，是一种“胰岛素敏感剂”，用于治疗2型糖尿病。

en: He revealed that prior to 2017, most students studied unmanned aerial vehicles for employment prospects as well as out of interest.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他透露，2017年之前，大多数学生都在寻找就业机会和出于兴趣学习无人机。

en: Computer security experts forecast that more cars will be stolen because the number of online networking vehicles is increasing.
zh: 计算机安全专家预测，由于网络连接车辆数量增加，更多的汽车将被盗。

en: The technology sector should never forget that it is our humanity and humility that have made technology a possibility in having a positive impact on human life.
zh: Simplified Chinese：技术行业永远不能忘记，它是我们的人性和谦逊使得技术成为有利于人类生活的可能。

en: On January 17, 2017, UK Prime Minister Theresa May, in a speech on “Brexit”, highlighted that while trade between the UK and the EU was important, the UK was also interested in trade relations with other markets that are growing rapidly in the world.
zh: 2017年1月17日，英国首相特蕾莎·梅在“脱欧”演讲中强调，尽管英国与欧盟之间的贸易很重要，但英国也对其他快速增长的市场进行贸易关系有着兴趣。

en: Recently, a survey of 2008 people conducted by a media entity revealed that more than half of those surveyed have had the experience of being fooled by false information on health care and well being.
zh: Simplified Chinese：最近，一个媒体机构对2008人进行了调查，结果显示超过半数受访者都曾被健康和幸福的虚假信息所欺骗。

en: The 25th Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting was held in the central Vietnam city of Da Nang from the 10th to 11th. The progress of the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific (FTAAP) will be one of the highlights of this meeting.
zh: 25号亚太经济合作组织（APEC）经济领导人会议在越南中部城市大肝市（Da Nang）举行，从第10到第11天。自由贸易区域的进展将成为本次会议的亮点之一。

en: China carrying out peaceful construction activities and laying out the necessary defense facilities on relevant islands and reefs in the South China Sea are matters within the scope of China’s sovereignty.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国在南海相关岛屿和礁石上进行和平建设活动，并建立必要的防御设施，是中国主权范围内的事务。

en: This project gave all educators a new way of thinking - not to teach, but to create a new learning environment for students to allow them to be prepared for life in the future.
zh: Simplified Chinese：这个项目为所有教育者提供了一个新的思考方式——不仅是教书，而是创造一个新学习环境，让学生能够在未来的生活中准备好。

en: Qin Gang elaborated on the spirit of the 19th CPC National Congress, and positively appraised the results of China-Brazil relations, which have developed comprehensively and rapidly in recent years. He also said that given the current international situation, the further strengthening of cooperation between China and Brazil, both of which are major developing countries and all-round strategic partners, has great significance.
zh: 秦刚强调了19届中国共产党全国代表大会的精神，积极评价中巴关系在近年来全面快速发展。 Qin Gang elaborated on the spirit of the 19th CPC National Congress, and positively appraised the results of China-Brazil relations, which have developed comprehensively and rapidly in recent years. 他还表示，由于当前国际局势的变化，中巴两国都是大型发展中国家和全面战略合作伙伴，进一步增强合作具有重要意义。 He also said that given the current international situation, the further strengthening of cooperation between China and Brazil, both of which are major developing countries and all-round strategic partners, has great significance.

en: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings, Inc, on the night of the 19th, announced the latest investigation results of Unit Reactor 2 of the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power station. Nuclear residue from the unit’s reactor after the core melted was found for the first time.
zh: 东京电力公司控股有限公司，19日晚间宣布第二个核反应器单位的最新调查结果。该单位反应器核心融化后残留的核废料第一次被发现。

en: When Associated Press took stock of the 2017 “big winners” in corporate America, Amazon was first on the list.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当时的《联邦新闻社》评估了2017年“大赢家”的公司，亚马逊是首位被列出的公司。

en: Between the 15th and the 19th, 16 invited think tank delegates from 11 countries including Angola, Kenya and South Africa visited China to observe and study the country.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在15世纪至19世纪期间，来自安哥拉、肯尼亚和南非等11个国家的16名邀请的智库代表来到中国观察和研究该国。

en: As an economic information publisher, Thomson Reuters Foundation siad that China imported 7.3 million tonnes of plastic waste in China, accounting for 56% of the world’s total plastic waste import.
zh: 作为经济信息出版商，特纳斯（Thomson Reuters）基金会表示，中国在全球总量中占比56%的塑料废物进口量为7.3万吨。

en: Wang Zhidong, the lawyer representing the family of Zhang Yingying said that the family expressed relief at the decision made by the Attorney General. They thanked him and the local prosecutor for considering and respecting the wishes of the family, and made decisions that were compatible to the wishes of the family.
zh: 王志东，代表张英英的律师说，家属对检察长做出的决定感到宽慰。他们感谢检察长和当地检察官考虑和尊重家属的愿望，并做出符合家属愿望的决定。

en: In 2017, e-commerce giant Amazon.com made frequent moves in the world. It not only successfully launched AI terminals but was also involved in the offline sector, opening a new chapter in new retail.
zh: 在2017年，电子商务巨头亚马逊.com不仅频繁出动于世界市场，也成功推出了AI终端，并参与了线下业务，开启了一章新 Retail。

en: Although China is the world’s second largest pharmaceutical market after the US, some of the most effective modern medicines are not listed for sale in the market.
zh: Simplified Chinese：尽管中国是世界第二大药物市场，但实际上一些最有效的现代药物并未在市场上出售。

en: According to the Forestry Department of Jilin, the 1998 data from a joint monitoring exercise by China, the US and Russia showed that there were only four to six Siberian tigers, and three to five Amur leopards living in the wild in Jilin Province.
zh: 根据吉林省森林部的数据，1998年中国、美国和俄罗斯联合监测活动显示，只有四到六个西伯利亚虎和三到五个阿穆尔狮在野生中生活。

en: Red meat, dairy, and chocolate could help relieve IBD
zh: Simplified Chinese：牛肉、乳制品和巧克力可以帮助缓解IBD

en: Red meat and chocolate may sound like a nightmare for your digestive system.
zh: Simplified Chinese：红肉和巧克力听起来像是对你的消化系统的噩梦。

en: But a new study claims quite the opposite: a diet rich in meat-based protein and dairy treats could help relieve symptoms of sufferers of inflammatory bowel disease.
zh: Simplified Chinese：但新研究表明，富含肉类蛋白质和乳制品的饮食可能有助于缓解因炎症性直肠病患者的症状。

en: The incurable condition, which affects around 1.3 million in the US and 300,000 in the UK, causes stomach cramps and bloating, recurring or bloody diarrhea, weight loss and extreme tiredness.
zh: 患有无法治愈的病症，影响了美国和英国约1300万人和300万人，会引起腹痛、胀气，反复或出血性便秘，体重减轻和极度疲劳。

en: While sufferers are usually advised to dodge meat and dairy to soothe their symptoms, researchers at Washington University found protein's essential amino acid tryptophan helps develop immune cells that foster a tolerant gut.
zh: Simplified Chinese：而且，研究人员发现华盛顿大学的研究人员发现蛋白质中的必需氨基酸色氨酸（tryptophan）有助于发展免疫细胞，从而促进一个耐受的肠道。

en: Lead investigator Dr Marco Colonna explained immune cells patrol the gut to ensure that harmful microbes hidden in the food don't sneak into the body.
zh: Simplified Chinese：免疫细胞的首席调查员马科罗·科隆纳解释说，免疫细胞在肠道巡逻，以确保食物中隐藏的有害微生物不能进入身体。

en: Cells that are capable of triggering inflammation are balanced by cells that promote tolerance, protecting the body without damaging sensitive tissues.
zh: Simplified Chinese：能够引发炎症的细胞被平衡的细胞促进耐受性，保护身体而不损伤敏感组织。

en: When the balance tilts too far toward inflammation, inflammatory bowel disease can result.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当平衡过度倾向于炎症时，炎症性肠病就可能产生。

en: In experiments it was found a kind of tolerance-promoting immune cell appears in mice that carry a specific bacterium in their guts.
zh: Simplified Chinese：在实验中发现，一种耐受性促进的免疫细胞出现在携带特定细菌的老鼠体内。

en: And the bacterium needs tryptophan - one of the building blocks of proteins - to trigger the cells' appearance.
zh: Simplified Chinese：细菌需要嘧啶胺（一种蛋白质的基本成分）来触发细胞的出现。

en: Professor Colonna said: 'We established a link between one bacterial species - Lactobacillus reuteri - that is a normal part of the gut microbiome, and the development of a population of cells that promote tolerance.
zh: 我们建立了一个连接一种正常存在于肠道微生物群落中的细菌-乳酸杆菌（Lactobacillus reuteri），并与促进耐受性的细胞群的发展之间的联系。

en: The more tryptophan the mice had in their diet, the more of these immune cells they had.'
zh: 试图摄入更多的色氨酸，老鼠体内的免疫细胞数量会增加。

en: He suggested if the same works in humans, a combination of L. reuteri and a tryptophan-rich diet may foster a more tolerant, less inflammatory gut environment.
zh: Simplified Chinese：他建议如果同样的方法在人类身上有效，L. 久特里和富含色氨酸的饮食组合可能会促成一个更加容忍的、炎症较少的肠道环境。

en: Postdoctoral researcher Dr Luisa Cervantes-Barraganwas studying a kind of immune cell that promotes tolerance when she discovered that one group of study mice had such cells but another group of the same strain but housed separately did not.
zh: 研究生德鲁·路易莎·塞尔瓦斯-巴拉加纳在研究一种促进耐受性的免疫细胞时，发现了一种类型的免疫细胞，但另一组同样strain的实验鼠却没有这种细胞。

en: She suspected the difference had to do with the mice's gut microbiomes - the community of bacteria, viruses and fungi that normally live within the gastrointestinal tract.
zh: 她怀疑这种差异与老鼠的肠道微生物群落有关——正常生活在肠道内的细菌、病毒和真菌的社区。

en: The guts of the mice were DNA sequenced and it was found six bacterial species present in the mice with the immune cells but absent from the mice without them.
zh: Simplified Chinese：小鼠的内脏DNA序列被测序后发现，存在六种细菌在免疫细胞中，但在没有它们的小鼠中却不见踪。

en: Mice reared in a sterile environment so they lacked a gut microbiome and do not develop this kind of immune cell were given L. reuteri and the immune cells arose.
zh: Simplified Chinese：小鼠在无菌环境中养大，缺乏肠道微生物群落，并且不产生这种免疫细胞。然后给予L. reuteri后，免疫细胞出现了。

en: To understand how the bacteria affected the immune system, the researchers grew L. reuteri in liquid and then transferred small amounts of the liquid - without bacteria - to immature immune cells isolated from mice.
zh: Simplified Chinese：要了解细菌如何影响免疫系统，研究人员在液体中培养了L. reuteri，然后将无菌液体中的小量转移给从老鼠中分离出的成熟免疫细胞。

en: The immune cells developed into the tolerance-promoting cells.
zh: 免疫细胞发展成耐受促进细胞。

en: When the active component was purified from the liquid, it turned out to be a byproduct of tryptophan metabolism known as indole-3-lactic acid.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当活性成分从液体中去除后，它被证明是由色氨酸代谢产生的已知物质——三羟吡啶酸。

en: When the researchers doubled the amount of tryptophan in the mice's feed, the number of such cells rose by about 50 percent but when tryptophan levels were halved, the number of cells dropped by half.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当研究人员在小鼠的饲养中增加了三氨酸的量时，这种细胞的数量增加了大约50％，但当三氨酸水平降低一半时，细胞数量减少了一半。

en: Dr Cervantes-Barragan explained people have the same tolerance-promoting cells as mice, and most of us shelter L. reuteri in our gastrointestinal tracts.
zh: Simplified Chinese：德·塞尔瓦斯-巴拉加恩博士解释说，人类和老鼠都有促进耐受性的细胞，而大多数人在消化道中都有了L. reuteri。

en: It is not known whether tryptophan byproducts from L. reuteri induce the cells to develop in people as they do in mice, but defects in genes related to tryptophan have been found in people with inflammatory bowel disease.
zh: 然而，尚不清楚L.  鲁特里菌的色氨酸分解产物是否能在人类中诱导细胞发育，就像在老鼠中一样，但有关色氨酸相关基因的缺陷已经被发现于患有炎症性肠病的人群中。

en: She said: 'The development of these cells is probably something we want to encourage since these cells control inflammation on the inner surface of the intestines.
zh: Simplified Chinese：她说：“这些细胞的发展可能是我们希望鼓励的，因为这些细胞控制肠道内表面炎症”。

en: Potentially, high levels of tryptophan in the presence of L. reuteri may induce expansion of this population.'
zh: Simplified Chinese：理论上，L. reuteri 的存在下，高水平的色氨酸可能会促进这种种群的扩张。

en: Jose Mourinho thinks Manchester United have signed a 'genius' in Nemanja Matic
zh: Simplified Chinese：约塞·穆罗赫（Jose Mourinho）认为曼联已经签下了一位“天才”（Nemanja Matic）。

en: Manchester United have signed a "genius" in Nemanja Matic, believes Jose Mourinho, after the midfielder made his debut against Sampdoria on Wednesday evening.
zh: Simplified Chinese：曼彻斯特联队签下了“天才”的内马尼亚·马蒂奇（Nemanja Matic），乔塞·穆里尼奥（Jose Mourinho）认为，这是因为中场球员在周三晚上对sampdoria的比赛中首次亮相。

en: The £40m signing from Chelsea started the 2-1 win in Dublin, United's final preseason game before the Uefa Super Cup against Real Madrid on Tuesday, and impressed in the holding role as the likes of Paul Pogba and Andreas Pereira marauded forward at will.
zh: 英格兰球队在 dublin 的最后一场预赛对阵 real madrid 的 uefa super cup 之前， Chelsea 的 £40m 买入签约人开始了 2-1 的胜利。

en: However, having been left out of the Blues' preseason tour of Asia, Matic was severely lacking match fitness and only managed 45 minutes, something Mourinho admitted needed to be improved before the start of the Premier League season.
zh: Simplified Chinese：然而，参加亚太地区蓝队的预赛旅行中被遗漏后，马蒂克的比赛条件严重不足，只能在45分钟内出场，这是莫里努斯承认需要在首个英超赛季开始前改进的。

en: "He needs time but his experience, intelligence, a genius in the way he thinks - he thinks football," Mourinho said.
zh: 他需要时间，但他的经验、智慧和思考方式的天才，他认为足球。

en: "We will help him to be ready sooner rather than later."
zh: Simplified Chinese：我们会帮助他尽早准备而不是晚点。

en: As well as Matic, fellow new signings Victor Lindelof and Romelu Lukaku also started the game at the Aviva Stadium as Mourinho started to shape his starting XI for the start of the season.
zh: Simplified Chinese：除了马蒂克外，新加盟的维克多林德洛夫和罗梅卢·鲁卡库也在阿维瓦体育场开始了比赛，而穆里诺开始为赛季开启他的首发阵容。

en: The Independent revealed this week that Mourinho still wanted another three signings but he insisted that the club had already done a "fantastic job" of delivering three of his four priority signings.
zh: Simplified Chinese：独立报社这周透露，穆里诺仍然希望再签下三名球员，但他坚称俱乐部已经完成了他的四项首要签约的“fantastic”工作。

en: "To get three out of four I thank the club for that," he added.
zh: 我得到了三分之二，我要感谢俱乐部。

en: "I will be happier if they get me four of four but they did a great effort for me."
zh: 我如果他们能给我四个四，那就更高兴了，但他们对我的努力做出了很好的表现。

en: The global spree of frigates building If China does not build this type of warships, will it fall behind?
zh: Simplified Chinese：全球舰队的快速扩张如果中国不再建造这种类型的战舰，会落后吗？

en: With the recent announcement of the construction of new types of frigates by major naval powers in the world, it seems that frigates have become the focus of attention of the major naval powers overnight. First, Japan has decided to purchase two new frigates in the 2018 annual defense budget, finally making a substantial breakthrough for its DEX frigates program. Later, Lockheed Martin of USA recently published the latest arrangement for the United States FFG frigates program. How about China's plan for building new type of frigates?
zh: 随着世界主要海军大国近期宣布新型巡防舰的建造计划，巡防舰似乎 overnight 成为主要海军关注点。首先，日本决定在2018年的年度防御预算中购买两艘新型巡防舰，这标志着其DEX巡防舰项目取得了重要突破。随后，美国Lockheed Martin公司最近发布了美国FFG巡防舰项目的最新安排。那么，中国关于建造新型巡防舰计划是什么呢？

en: With the launching of the latest model of 054A frigate at the end of 2017, the number of 054A frigate has reached 29, approaching the sum of the 053H series frigates. Since the first 054A was launched in 2006, the history of building 054A has extended to 12 years. Building such a large number of high-performance general purpose frigates is very rare in the history. Apart from China, the only comparable accomplishment was made by the United States in the 1970s and 1980s when it built a host of 'Perry' class frigates.
zh: 2017年上市的最新型054A护航舰的上水式试验成功，目前已有29艘054A护航舰上水，接近053H系列护航舰的总数。自2006年首次上水的第一艘054A以来，建造054A的历史已经延续了12年。建造如此数量高性能一般用途护航舰是历史上的少见之事。除了中国外，1970年代和1980年代美国仅有“佩里”级护航舰的系列 accomplishment。

en: And the reason why it is necessary to build so many 054A frigates is simple, that is, it is affordable, easy to operate, and doing so can make up for the deficiency of Chinese Navel that has beset the Naval for many years.
zh: 而且，建造这么多054A护航舰的原因很简单：成本低廉、操作方便，如此做法可以弥补中国海军长期面临的问题。

en: The 054A frigate has been favored by the Chinese Navy for many years thanks to its high cost performance and good combat effectiveness. With a displacement of 4,000 tons, the warship is equipped with a 76-mm main gun, and shared launching system for 32 HQ-16 and Fish-8 anti-submarine missiles, 8 YJ-83 anti-ship missiles and 1 Z-9 helicopter. Although it was first built in 2006 and was designed even earlier, its combat effectiveness is not too bad even by today's standard. It can be ranked as medium- to high level frigate among all the frigates in the world.
zh: 054A 鱽鱼级护航舰已多年来受到中国海军的青睐，主要是因为其高效率和良好的战斗表现。它的排水量为4,000吨，装备了76毫米主炮，并共享了32枚HQ-16和鱼-8反潜导弹、8枚YJ-83反舰导弹以及1台Z-9直升机。尽管它最初于2006年建造并设计更早，但其战斗表现并不差，甚至在当今标准下也可以算作中级至高级护航舰之一。

en: However, it is a warship designed at the beginning of the 21st century after all. Armaments aside, its propulsion system and electronic radar system lag significantly behind the current mainstream frigates in the world. Considering that similar frigates in Europe have been equipped with full electric propulsion, small multi-function phased array radars and large helicopter decks, it is time to develop new models.
zh: Simplified Chinese：然而，这是一艘20世纪后期建造的战舰，尽管如此。武装方面，推进系统和电子雷达系统远远落后于当今世界主流的巡洋舰。考虑到欧洲类似巡洋舰已经配备了全电动推进、多功能 phased array雷达和大型直升机甲板，这时就该开发新型号了。

en: Then how should China develop its new frigates? This has a direct bearing on its future orientation and the strategic direction of Chinese navy.
zh: Simplified Chinese：然后，中国新舰队的发展方向应该是怎样的呢？这直接影响到中国未来战略方向和海军战略方向。

en: The future development of the Chinese Navy will inevitably aim at becoming the blue water navy, roaming in the vastness of the oceans. It should be able to deploy rapidly in areas that are closely related to China’s vital interests and demonstrate the presence of force. If necessary, it will use powerful combat capabilities to ensure that China’s vital interests in the region are not compromised. So, it seems that the new models of frigates will surely be huge ships that can roam the blue water.
zh: Simplified Chinese：中国海军的未来发展必然会朝着成为蓝水舰队的方向发展，漫游在大洋的广阔中。它应该能够迅速部署到与中国生命线密切相关的地区，并展示力量的存在。如果必要，它将使用强大的战斗能力来确保中国在该地区的生命线不会受到损害。因此，新型巡防舰的设计一定会是巨大船只，可以漫游蓝水。

en: Let's look at the positioning of the new frigates in the future rank and file of Chinese Navy. The future Chinese Navy should be similar to the US Navy. In addition to the necessary offshore defense ships, the other main ships will form an aircraft carrier battle group or amphibious attack group as the situation requires.
zh: Simplified Chinese：让我们看看未来中国海军的新驱逐舰在海军的下层结构中位置。未来中国海军应该类似于美国海军。在必要的情况下，除了必要的沿海防御船只外，其他主要船只将形成航空母舰战斗群或登陆攻击群。

en: The new frigates in the future aircraft carrier battle group should play the primary role in anti-submarine and short-range air defense operations. In the amphibious attack group, they should provide protection to ships. According to these requirements, the new frigates must have strong anti-submarine capability and good mid-range air defense capability.
zh: Simplified Chinese：未来航空母舰部队的新型巡防舰应在潜水攻击和近距离空防方面发挥主导作用。在海上突击部队中，他们应该为船只提供保护。根据这些要求，新型巡防舰必须具有强大的反潜能力和良好的中程空防能力。

en: Based on the above positioning, we can boldly imagine the rough appearance of the new frigates in the future.
zh: Simplified Chinese：基于上述定位，我们可以勇敢地想象未来新舰队的粗略外观。

en: First, the displacement will be increased significantly compared to the current 054A model. It is estimated that the displacement of the new frigate will reach about 5000-6000 tons. The ship will be equipped with a comprehensive electric propulsion system that combines a QC280 modified gas turbine and two diesel engines, improving the maximum speed to around 30 knots and significantly increase the cruise range. As for the weaponry, the 76mm main gun and 1130 near-range anti-aircraft gun will be retained, but a HQ-10 launch system will be added. A shared vertical launching system for 32-48 unit HQ-16 modified missile and Fish-8 missiles will be furnished at the back of the main gun. A large 8-16-unit vertical launching system should be furnished at the middle-to-rear section of the hull for the launch of YJ-18 and new cruise missiles. Hangars and parking platforms will also be expanded for the parking and storage of two 10-ton helicopters. As for the electronic radar systems, the high grade model will be equipped with a small four-sided fixed phase-control array radar developed based on 346A. the low grade model will be furnished with multi-function rotating phased array radar similar to the ones on European frigates.
zh: Simplified Chinese：首先，推动力将比目前的054A模型大幅增加。估计新舰的推动量将达到5000-6000吨。该舰将配备一个全面电动推进系统，结合QC280改造气 turbine和两个柴油机，提高最大速度约30节，并显著增加巡航距离。关于武器，76毫米主炮和1130近程反空中火炮将保留，但将添加HQ-10发射系统。 HQ-10发射系统的共享垂直发射系统将为32-48个HQ-16改造导弹和鱼雷8型导弹提供装备。舰体后部将配备一个大型8-16个单元垂直发射系统，为YJ-18和新巡航导弹的发射提供支持。 Hangars和停车平台也将扩大，以便为两台10吨的直升机停放和存储。关于电子雷达系统，高级别模型将配备基于346A的小型四边形固定相控阵雷达，而低级别模型将装备与欧洲巡洋舰类似的多功能旋转相控阵雷达。

en: Thus, the overall level of the new frigates will edge into the world's top bracket, even comparable to the FFG frigates of the USA.
zh: Simplified Chinese：因此，新型巡洋舰的整体水平将进入世界顶级排列，甚至与美国FFG巡洋舰相比。

en: Of course, these are only the author's conjecture on domestically produced new frigates. Only when the new frigates are launched into the water can we know the truth. Let's anticipate the day.
zh: Simplified Chinese：当然，这只是作者对国内生产的新舰只的猜测。只有当新舰只被推入水中时，我们才能知道真相。我们可以期待那一天。
